3	/** D055: physical maintenance failures are separate from governance failures. */
4	export type SnapshotFailureKind = 'busy' | 'unavailable' | 'capacity' | 'invalid-data' | 'cancelled'
5	
6	export class SnapshotFailure extends Error {
7	  override readonly name = 'SnapshotFailure'
8	  constructor(
9	    readonly kind: SnapshotFailureKind,
10	    options?: { readonly cause?: unknown; readonly residual?: string },
11	  ) {
12	    super(`snapshot maintenance: ${kind}`, options)
13	    this.residual = options?.residual
14	  }
15	  /** Local diagnostic only; never a remote result or a data value. */
16	  readonly residual: string | undefined
17	}
18	
19	export interface SnapshotColumn {
20	  readonly name: string
21	  readonly type: string
22	  readonly notNull: boolean
23	  readonly primaryKeyPosition: number
24	}
25	
26	export interface SnapshotIndex {
27	  readonly name: string
28	  readonly unique: boolean
29	  readonly partial: boolean
30	  /** null denotes an expression rather than a named column. */
31	  readonly columns: readonly (string | null)[]
32	  readonly definition: string | null
33	}
34	
35	export interface SnapshotForeignKey {
36	  readonly table: string
37	  readonly from: readonly string[]
38	  readonly to: readonly (string | null)[]
39	  readonly onUpdate: string
40	  readonly onDelete: string
41	}

43	export interface SnapshotTable {
44	  readonly name: string
45	  readonly columns: readonly SnapshotColumn[]
46	  readonly indexes: readonly SnapshotIndex[]
47	  readonly foreignKeys: readonly SnapshotForeignKey[]
48	  readonly definition: string
49	}

51	export interface SnapshotStructure {
52	  readonly tables: readonly SnapshotTable[]
53	  readonly views: readonly string[]
54	  readonly triggers: readonly string[]
55	}

57	/** Borrowed only during use; the provider waits for already-started reads. */
58	export interface SnapshotView {
59	  readonly inspection: PreflightInput
60	  readonly structure: SnapshotStructure
61	  readonly byteLength: number
62	  read(offset: number, length: number): Promise<Uint8Array>
63	}

65	export type SnapshotCheck = (view: SnapshotView) => Promise<PreflightResult>
66

68	  readonly byteLength: number
69	  readonly chunks: AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>
70	}

72	export interface SnapshotInspectionSession {
73	  /** Run-owned lifetime, including resources obtained by an already-started open after cancellation. */
74	  ownResource(close: () => void | Promise<void>, isClosed: () => boolean): () => Promise<void>
75	  readonly cancelled: boolean

90	}

1	import { open, statfs } from 'node:fs/promises'
2	import { join } from 'node:path'
3	import {
4	  SnapshotFailure,
5	  StorageDefect,
6	  type SnapshotInput,
7	  type SnapshotInspection,
8	  type SnapshotRunOptions,
9	  type SnapshotSession,
10	  type SnapshotView,
11	} from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'
12	import { combineFailure, physicalFailure, withCleanup } from './failure.ts'
13	import { SnapshotResources } from './resources.ts'
14	import { MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, SNAPSHOT_CHUNK_BYTES, useSnapshotView } from './view.ts'
15	import { SnapshotWorkspace } from './workspace.ts'
16	
17	export type SnapshotProducer = (
18	  file: string,
19	  signal: AbortSignal,
20	  resources: SnapshotResources,
21	) => Promise<void>
22	
23	interface Residue {
24	  readonly path: string
25	  readonly resources: SnapshotResources
26	}
27	
28	/** Physical workspace owner, nested under the original source owner when online. */
29	export class SnapshotEngine {
30	  #closed = false
31	  #poisoned = false
32	  #active: Promise<unknown> | undefined
33	  #cancel: AbortController | undefined
34	  #closing: Promise<void> | undefined
35	  #released = false
36	  readonly #residue: Residue[] = []
37	  readonly #runResidue: SnapshotResources[] = []
38	  private constructor(
39	    readonly workspace: SnapshotWorkspace,
40	    private readonly source?: SnapshotProducer,
41	  ) {}
42	
43	  get resourcesSettled(): boolean {
44	    return (
45	      this.#active === undefined &&
46	      this.#residue.every(item => item.resources.settled) &&
47	      this.#runResidue.every(scope => scope.settled)
48	    )
49	  }
50	
51	  get ownershipReleased(): boolean {
52	    return this.#released
53	  }
54	
55	  static async open(workRoot: string, source?: SnapshotProducer): Promise<SnapshotEngine> {
56	    return new SnapshotEngine(await SnapshotWorkspace.open(workRoot), source)
57	  }
58	
59	  run<T>(
60	    fn: (session: SnapshotSession) => Promise<T>,
61	    options: SnapshotRunOptions = {},
62	  ): Promise<T> {
63	    if (this.#closed || this.#poisoned) return Promise.reject(new SnapshotFailure('unavailable'))
64	    if (this.#active !== undefined) return Promise.reject(new SnapshotFailure('busy'))
65	    const controller = new AbortController()
66	    this.#cancel = controller
67	    const abort = () => controller.abort()
68	    options.signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })
69	    if (options.signal?.aborted === true) abort()
70	    const timer = setTimeout(abort, 300_000)
71	    const children = new Set<Promise<unknown>>()
72	    const runResources = new SnapshotResources()
73	    let childFailed = false
74	    let childError: unknown
75	    let live = true
76	    let operation = false
77	    const checkCancellation = () => {
78	      if (controller.signal.aborted) throw new SnapshotFailure('cancelled')
79	    }
80	    const execute = <R>(
81	      work: (file: string, resources: SnapshotResources) => Promise<R>,
82	    ): Promise<R> => {
83	      if (!live || operation)
84	        return Promise.reject(new StorageDefect('snapshot session is ended or already in use'))
85	      operation = true
86	      let cleanupFailed = false
87	      const task = (async () => {
88	        checkCancellation()
89	        return this.#task(work, () => {
90	          cleanupFailed = true
91	        })
92	      })().finally(() => {
93	        operation = false
94	      })
95	      children.add(task)
96	      void task.then(
97	        () => children.delete(task),
98	        error => {
99	          children.delete(task)
100	          // Ordinary validation refusals belong to the caller (e.g. count a bad
101	          // directory candidate and inspect the next). Cleanup failures and defects
102	          // cannot be swallowed, even if the callback catches that child rejection.
103	          if (cleanupFailed || !(physicalFailure(error) instanceof SnapshotFailure)) {
104	            childError = childFailed ? combineFailure(childError, error) : error
105	            childFailed = true
106	          }
107	        },
108	      )
109	      return task
110	    }
111	    const session: SnapshotSession = {
112	      ownResource: (close, isClosed) => runResources.own(close, isClosed),
113	      get cancelled() {
114	        return controller.signal.aborted
115	      },
116	      snapshot: use =>
117	        execute(async (file, resources) => {
118	          if (this.source === undefined) throw new SnapshotFailure('unavailable')
119	          await this.source(file, controller.signal, resources)
120	          checkCancellation()
121	          return useSnapshotView(file, use, resources)
122	        }),
123	      inspect: (input, use) =>
124	        execute(async (file, resources) => {
125	          await this.#import(file, input, resources, checkCancellation)
126	          checkCancellation()
127	          return useSnapshotView(file, use, resources)
128	        }),
129	    }
130	    // Defer the callback so active ownership is installed before any reentrant call.
131	    const task = Promise.resolve()
132	      .then(() =>
133	        withCleanup(
134	          async () => {
135	            checkCancellation()
136	            return fn(session)
137	          },
138	          async () => {
139	            live = false
140	            await Promise.allSettled(children)
141	            await withCleanup(
142	              async () => {
143	                if (childFailed) throw childError
144	              },
145	              async () => {
146	                try {
147	                  try {
148	                    await runResources.close()
149	                  } finally {
150	                    runResources.assertClean()
151	                  }
152	                } finally {
153	                  if (!runResources.settled) {
154	                    this.#poisoned = true
155	                    this.#runResidue.push(runResources)
156	                  }
157	                }
158	              },
159	            )
160	          },
161	        ),
162	      )
163	      .catch(error => {
164	        throw physicalFailure(error)
165	      })
166	      .finally(async () => {
167	        live = false
168	        await Promise.allSettled(children)
169	        clearTimeout(timer)
170	        options.signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort)
171	        this.#active = undefined
172	        this.#cancel = undefined
173	      })
174	    this.#active = task
175	    return task
176	  }
177	
178	  async #task<T>(
179	    work: (file: string, resources: SnapshotResources) => Promise<T>,
180	    failedCleanup: () => void,
181	  ): Promise<T> {
182	    const path = await this.workspace.createTask()
183	    const resources = new SnapshotResources()
184	    return withCleanup(
185	      () => work(join(path, 'snapshot.sqlite'), resources),
186	      () =>
187	        withCleanup(
188	          () => resources.close(),
189	          async () => {
190	            if (!resources.settled) {
191	              this.#poisoned = true
192	              this.#residue.push({ path, resources })
193	            } else {
194	              try {
195	                await this.workspace.removeTask(path)
196	              } catch (error) {
197	                this.#residue.push({ path, resources })
198	                throw error
199	              }
200	            }
201	          },
202	        )
203	          .catch(error => {
204	            failedCleanup()
205	            throw error
206	          })
207	          .finally(() => {
208	            if (resources.closeFailed) failedCleanup()
209	          }),
210	    )
211	  }
212	
213	  async #import(
214	    file: string,
215	    input: SnapshotInput,
216	    resources: SnapshotResources,
217	    check: () => void,
218	  ): Promise<void> {
219	    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(input.byteLength) || input.byteLength < 1)
220	      throw new SnapshotFailure('invalid-data')
221	    if (input.byteLength > MAX_SNAPSHOT_BYTES) throw new SnapshotFailure('capacity')
222	    const space = await statfs(this.workspace.root)
223	    if (space.bavail * space.bsize < input.byteLength * 2 + 268_435_456)
224	      throw new SnapshotFailure('capacity')
225	    const handle = await open(file, 'wx', 0o600)
226	    const close = resources.own(() => handle.close())
227	    let count = 0
228	    await withCleanup(async () => {
229	      try {
230	        for await (const chunk of input.chunks) {
231	          check()
232	          if (!(chunk instanceof Uint8Array)) throw new SnapshotFailure('invalid-data')
233	          if (chunk.byteLength > SNAPSHOT_CHUNK_BYTES) throw new SnapshotFailure('capacity')
234	          count += chunk.byteLength
235	          if (count > input.byteLength) throw new SnapshotFailure('invalid-data')
236	          await handle.writeFile(chunk)
237	        }
238	        if (count !== input.byteLength) throw new SnapshotFailure('invalid-data')
239	      } catch (error) {
240	        if (error instanceof SnapshotFailure || error instanceof StorageDefect) throw error
241	        throw new SnapshotFailure('unavailable', { cause: error })
242	      }
243	    }, close)
244	  }
245	
246	  close(): Promise<void> {
247	    this.#closed = true
248	    this.#cancel?.abort()
249	    this.#closing ??= this.#close()
250	    return this.#closing
251	  }
252	
253	  async #close(): Promise<void> {
254	    // A rejected operation has finished; a pending one still owns all its resources.
255	    await this.#active?.catch(() => undefined)
256	    let failure: unknown
257	    let failed = false
258	    for (const residue of this.#residue) {
259	      try {
260	        await residue.resources.close()
261	        if (residue.resources.settled) await this.workspace.removeTask(residue.path)
262	      } catch (error) {
263	        failed = true
264	        failure ??= error
265	      }
266	    }
267	    for (const scope of this.#runResidue) {
268	      try {
269	        await scope.close()
270	      } catch (error) {
271	        failure = failed ? combineFailure(failure, error) : error
272	        failed = true
273	      }
274	    }
275	    if (
276	      this.#residue.some(item => !item.resources.settled) ||
277	      this.#runResidue.some(scope => !scope.settled)
278	    ) {
279	      // Do not release the workspace lock. The enclosing source owner must also retain its lock.
280	      throw new StorageDefect('snapshot handles remain open; ownership is retained', {
281	        cause: failure,
282	      })
283	    }
284	    await this.workspace.close()
285	    this.#released = true
286	    if (failed) throw failure
287	  }
288	}

290	/** Offline tools receive no source path or snapshot operation. */
291	export async function openSnapshotInspection(workRoot: string): Promise<SnapshotInspection> {
292	  const engine = await SnapshotEngine.open(workRoot)
293	  return {
294	    run: (fn, options) =>
295	      engine.run(
296	        session =>
297	          fn({
298	            ownResource: (close, isClosed) => session.ownResource(close, isClosed),
299	            get cancelled() {
300	              return session.cancelled
301	            },
302	            inspect: <T>(input: SnapshotInput, use: (view: SnapshotView) => Promise<T>) =>
303	              session.inspect(input, use),
304	          }),
305	        options,
306	      ),
307	    close: () => engine.close(),
308	  }
309	}

4	/** Fixed physical checks only. The owner supplies a completed, isolated copy. */
5	function check(file: string): 'ok' | 'invalid-data' {
6	  const db = new DatabaseSync(file, { readOnly: true })
7	  try {
8	    db.exec('PRAGMA query_only = ON')
9	    const integrity = db.prepare('PRAGMA integrity_check').get()
10	    if (
11	      integrity === undefined ||
12	      Object.keys(integrity).length !== 1 ||
13	      Object.values(integrity)[0] !== 'ok'
14	    )
15	      return 'invalid-data'
16	    // Only existence matters. Do not materialize an unbounded list of violations.
17	    try {
18	      return db.prepare('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').get() === undefined ? 'ok' : 'invalid-data'
19	    } catch (error) {
20	      // This fixed pragma diagnoses malformed FK declarations before owner checks.
21	      // Do not classify arbitrary SQLITE_ERROR (including provider SQL bugs) as data.
22	      if (
23	        error instanceof Error &&
24	        'errcode' in error &&
25	        error.errcode === 1 &&
26	        error.message.startsWith('foreign key mismatch - ')
27	      )
28	        return 'invalid-data'
29	      throw error
30	    }
31	  } finally {
32	    db.close()
33	  }
34	}
35	
36	function failure(error: unknown): 'invalid-data' | 'unavailable' | 'defect' {
37	  if (error instanceof Error && 'errcode' in error && typeof error.errcode === 'number') {
38	    const primary = error.errcode & 0xff
39	    if (primary === 11 || primary === 26) return 'invalid-data' // CORRUPT / NOTADB
40	    if ([5, 6, 7, 10, 13, 14].includes(primary)) return 'unavailable'
41	  }
42	  return 'defect'
43	}
44	
45	if (parentPort === null) throw new Error('snapshot inspection requires an owned worker')
46	let status: 'ok' | 'invalid-data' | 'unavailable' | 'defect'
47	try {
48	  const input: unknown = workerData
49	  if (
50	    typeof input !== 'object' ||
51	    input === null ||
52	    !('file' in input) ||
53	    typeof input.file !== 'string' ||
54	    Object.keys(input).length !== 1
55	  )
56	    throw new Error('invalid internal snapshot worker input')
57	  status = check(input.file)
58	} catch (error) {
59	  status = failure(error)
60	}
61	// The database is closed before the result, and the parent also waits for actual exit.
62	parentPort.postMessage({ status })
63	parentPort.close()

116	              error => {

130	          },

134	    async () => {
135	      live = false

16	async function names(path: string, session: SnapshotInspectionSession): Promise<string[]> {

19	  const close = ownResourceAt(
20	    session,
21	    async () => {

25	    () => closed,
26	    path,
27	  )

32	      const entry = await directory.read()
33	      if (entry === null) break
34	      if (!BACKUP_FILE_NAME.test(entry.name)) continue

42	/** Complete validation and center filtering precede all time/durability decisions. */
43	export async function observeBackups(
44	  path: string,
45	  session: SnapshotInspectionSession,
46	  format: SnapshotFormat,
47	  centerId: string,
48	  now: number,
49	): Promise<ObservedBackups> {
50	  return MaintenanceDirectory.use(path, session, true, async directory => {
51	    const candidates = await names(path, session)
52	    let latest: BackupDescriptor | null = null
53	    let invalidCount = 0
54	    for (const fileName of candidates) {
55	      checkCancelled(session)
56	      const source = join(path, fileName)
57	      const info = await lstat(source)
58	      if (!info.isFile() || info.isSymbolicLink()) {
59	        invalidCount += 1
60	        continue
61	      }
62	      try {
63	        const descriptor = await BackupInputFile.use(source, session, async input => {
64	          const metadata = await input.inspect(session, format)
65	          if (metadata.centerId !== centerId) return null
66	          if (metadataTime(metadata.startedAt) > now) throw new MaintenanceFailure('unavailable')
67	          checkCancelled(session)
68	          try {
69	            await input.confirm()
70	            await directory.confirm()
71	          } catch (error) {
72	            if (!(maintenanceFailure(error) instanceof MaintenanceFailure)) throw error
73	            throw new PublicationUnknown(
74	              { status: 'outcome-unknown', fileName, targetLocation: null },
75	              error,
76	            )
77	          }
78	          return { fileName, metadata }
79	        })
80	        if (descriptor === null) {
81	          invalidCount += 1
82	          continue
83	        }
84	        if (
85	          latest === null ||
86	          metadataTime(descriptor.metadata.startedAt) > metadataTime(latest.metadata.startedAt) ||
87	          (metadataTime(descriptor.metadata.startedAt) ===
88	            metadataTime(latest.metadata.startedAt) &&
89	            descriptor.fileName < latest.fileName)
90	        )

92	      } catch (error) {
93	        const failure = maintenanceFailure(error)
94	        if (failure instanceof MaintenanceFailure && failure.kind === 'invalid-backup')

96	        else throw error
97	      }
98	    }
99	    await directory.stable()
100	    return {
101	      status: 'observed',
102	      health:
103	        latest === null
104	          ? 'missing'
105	          : now - metadataTime(latest.metadata.startedAt) > 86_400_000
106	            ? 'overdue'
107	            : 'current',
108	      latest,
109	      invalidCount,
110	    }
111	  })
112	}

40	  while (filled < length) {
41	    const result = await handle.read(buffer, filled, length - filled, offset + filled)
42	    if (result.bytesRead === 0) throw new MaintenanceFailure('unavailable')
43	    filled += result.bytesRead

49	export class BackupInputFile {

51	    private readonly handle: FileHandle,
52	    private readonly initial: Stats,
53	    readonly metadata: Metadata,

58	    path: string,

78	      if (info.size < MAGIC.length + 5) throw new MaintenanceFailure('invalid-backup')

29	export function metadataTime(value: string): number {

31	  if (!('ok' in parsed)) throw new MaintenanceFailure('invalid-backup')
32	  return parsed.ok

34	export function parseMetadata(value: unknown): Metadata {
35	  if (
36	    typeof value === 'object' &&
37	    value !== null &&
38	    'byteLength' in value &&

43	  if (!validMetadata(value)) throw new MaintenanceFailure('invalid-backup')

32	/** Storage may aggregate publication uncertainty with subsequent cleanup failure. */
33	function knownFailures(
34	  error: unknown,

36	  const mapped = maintenanceFailure(error)
37	  if (mapped instanceof MaintenanceFailure || mapped instanceof PublicationUnknown) return [mapped]
38	  if (!(mapped instanceof AggregateError) || mapped.errors.length === 0) return undefined
39	  const failures: (MaintenanceFailure | PublicationUnknown)[] = []
40	  for (const item of mapped.errors as unknown[]) {
41	    const nested = knownFailures(item)
42	    if (nested === undefined) return undefined
43	    failures.push(...nested)
44	  }
45	  return failures
46	}

49	  if (failures === undefined) throw error
50	  const unknown = failures.find(item => item instanceof PublicationUnknown)
51	  if (unknown instanceof PublicationUnknown) return unknown.result
52	  const last = failures.at(-1)
53	  if (!(last instanceof MaintenanceFailure)) throw new StorageDefect('empty maintenance failure')

77	  publishedLocation: string | null,
78	): void {
79	  const visited = new Set<unknown>()
80	  const locations = new Set<string>()
81	  function visit(value: unknown): void {
82	    if (visited.has(value)) return
83	    visited.add(value)
84	    if (value instanceof SnapshotFailure && value.residual !== undefined)
85	      locations.add(value.residual)
86	    if (value instanceof AggregateError) for (const item of value.errors as unknown[]) visit(item)
87	    if (value instanceof Error && value.cause !== undefined) visit(value.cause)
88	  }
89	  visit(error)
90	  for (const temporaryLocation of locations)
91	    report({ event: 'maintenance-residual', temporaryLocation, publishedLocation })
92	}

24	  | 'target-exists'

27	export class MaintenanceFailure extends Error {
28	  override readonly name = 'MaintenanceFailure'

37	export function hasCode(error: unknown, code: string): boolean {
38	  return error instanceof Error && 'code' in error && error.code === code

41	/** Only declared infrastructure failures cross the normal-result boundary. */
42	export function maintenanceFailure(error: unknown): unknown {
43	  if (error instanceof MaintenanceFailure) return error
44	  if (error instanceof SnapshotFailure)
45	    return new MaintenanceFailure(error.kind === 'invalid-data' ? 'invalid-backup' : error.kind, {
46	      cause: error,
47	    })
48	  if (hasCode(error, 'ENOSPC')) return new MaintenanceFailure('capacity', { cause: error })
49	  if (
50	    [
51	      'ENOENT',
52	      'EACCES',
53	      'EPERM',
54	      'EIO',
55	      'ENOMEM',
56	      'EBADF',
57	      'EBUSY',
58	      'EROFS',
59	      'ELOOP',
60	      'ENOTDIR',
61	      'EXDEV',
62	    ].some(code => hasCode(error, code))

68	/** A cleanup failure must not replace a programming defect with an ordinary result. */
69	export async function withCleanup<T>(
70	  work: () => Promise<T>,
71	  cleanup: () => Promise<void>,
72	): Promise<T> {
73	  let outcome: { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: unknown }
74	  try {
75	    outcome = { ok: true, value: await work() }
76	  } catch (error) {
77	    outcome = { ok: false, error }
78	  }
79	  try {
80	    await cleanup()
81	  } catch (error) {
82	    const closing = maintenanceFailure(error)
83	    if (
84	      !outcome.ok &&
85	      outcome.error instanceof PublicationUnknown &&
86	      closing instanceof MaintenanceFailure
87	    )
88	      throw outcome.error
89	    if (
90	      !outcome.ok &&
91	      (!(maintenanceFailure(outcome.error) instanceof MaintenanceFailure) ||
92	        !(closing instanceof MaintenanceFailure))
93	    )
94	      throw new AggregateError([outcome.error, closing], 'maintenance operation and cleanup failed')
95	    throw error
96	  }
97	  if (!outcome.ok) throw outcome.error
98	  return outcome.value
99	}

8	export type OpsRequest =

10	  | { readonly operation: 'backup'; readonly payload: { readonly onlyIfDue: boolean } }
11	export type OpsReading =
12	  | { readonly kind: 'request'; readonly request: OpsRequest }
13	  | { readonly kind: 'invalid-input' }
14	  | { readonly kind: 'exceeds-limit' }

16	/** HT3: opsVersion is independent of the employee protocol version. */
17	export function readOpsRequest(bytes: Uint8Array): OpsReading {
18	  const reading = readJsonText(bytes, {
19	    depth: RECEIVE_LIMITS.jsonDepth,
20	    members: RECEIVE_LIMITS.objectMembers,
21	  })
22	  if (reading.kind === 'exceeds-limit') return { kind: 'exceeds-limit' }
23	  if (reading.kind !== 'value' || reading.duplicates.length !== 0) return { kind: 'invalid-input' }
24	  const value = reading.value
25	  if (
26	    typeof value !== 'object' ||
27	    value === null ||
28	    Array.isArray(value) ||
29	    Object.keys(value).length !== 3 ||
30	    !('opsVersion' in value) ||
31	    value.opsVersion !== '1' ||
32	    !('operation' in value) ||
33	    !('payload' in value)
34	  )
35	    return { kind: 'invalid-input' }
36	  if (value.operation === 'backup' && validBackupInput(value.payload))
37	    return { kind: 'request', request: { operation: 'backup', payload: value.payload } }
38	  if (
39	    (value.operation === 'full-health' || value.operation === 'backup-status') &&
40	    validBackupStatusInput(value.payload)
41	  )

68	    case 'observed':

1	import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'
2	import { SnapshotFailure, StorageDefect } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'

4	/**
5	 * Internal fixed entry. Cancellation never treats a request or message as exit.
6	 * Source execution uses Node24 type stripping; distributed execution uses emitted JS.
7	 */
8	export async function checkPhysicalSnapshot(file: string): Promise<void> {
9	  const url = new URL(
10	    import.meta.url.endsWith('.ts') ? './inspection-worker.ts' : './inspection-worker.js',
11	    import.meta.url,
12	  )
13	  const worker = new Worker(url, { workerData: { file }, execArgv: [], stdout: true, stderr: true })
14	  let result: unknown
15	  let messages = 0
16	  let failed = false
17	  const code = await new Promise<number>(resolve => {
18	    worker.on('message', value => {
19	      messages += 1
20	      result = value
21	    })
22	    worker.on('messageerror', () => {
23	      failed = true
24	    })
25	    worker.on('error', () => {
26	      failed = true
27	    })
28	    worker.once('exit', resolve)
29	  })
30	  if (
31	    failed ||
32	    code !== 0 ||
33	    messages !== 1 ||
34	    typeof result !== 'object' ||
35	    result === null ||
36	    Object.keys(result).length !== 1 ||
37	    !('status' in result)
38	  )
39	    throw new StorageDefect('snapshot worker did not close with one valid result')
40	  switch (result.status) {
41	    case 'ok':
42	      return
43	    case 'invalid-data':
44	      throw new SnapshotFailure('invalid-data')
45	    case 'unavailable':
46	      throw new SnapshotFailure('unavailable')
47	    default:
48	      throw new StorageDefect('snapshot worker reported an internal defect')
49	  }
50	}

2	import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from 'node:path'
3	import { StorageDefect } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'

5	export const ISOLATION_MARKER = '.omne-isolated'
6	export const ISOLATION_CONTENT = 'omne-isolated/1\n'

8	function isMissing(error: unknown): boolean {
9	  return error instanceof Error && 'code' in error && error.code === 'ENOENT'
10	}

12	/**
13	 * D055: every production open checks the real ancestry before opening SQLite.
14	 * A marker of any kind refuses entry; malformed protection is not permission.
15	 * The filesystem owner must not move/remove protection or race path resolution.
16	 */
17	export function assertProductionStoragePath(file: string): string {
18	  const absolute = resolve(file)
19	  let canonical: string
20	  try {
21	    const info = lstatSync(absolute)
22	    if (info.isSymbolicLink()) throw new StorageDefect('storage file must not be a symbolic link')
23	    canonical = realpathSync(absolute)
24	  } catch (error) {
25	    if (!isMissing(error)) throw error
26	    // Only the database itself may be new. A missing parent never becomes a new root.
27	    canonical = join(realpathSync(dirname(absolute)), basename(absolute))
28	  }
29	  for (let directory = dirname(canonical); ; directory = dirname(directory)) {
30	    try {
31	      lstatSync(join(directory, ISOLATION_MARKER))
32	    } catch (error) {
33	      if (!isMissing(error)) throw error
34	      if (directory === dirname(directory)) break
35	      continue
36	    }
37	    throw new StorageDefect('isolated maintenance data cannot be opened as production storage')
38	  }
39	  return canonical
40	}

16	const ABSENT_MARKER = Buffer.from(
17	  'omne-harness-lite storage-sql upgrade marker: the database did not exist before this upgrade\n',

22	export interface SqliteOwnerPaths {
23	  readonly db: string
24	  readonly directory: string
25	  readonly sidecars: readonly string[]

27	  readonly snapshot: string
28	  readonly snapshotTemp: string

32	/** 全部位置由 `file` 派生、固定不变（②据此找得到半成品）；与库同目录，改名才原子。 */

37	    db,

52	export class SqliteOwnerSite implements OwnerSite {
53	  readonly paths: SqliteOwnerPaths

55	  constructor(
56	    file: string,
57	    private readonly logger: StorageSqlLogger | undefined,
58	    private readonly hooks: UpgradeHooks,

69	   * 避免零等待EXCLUSIVE把两名竞争者都拒绝；第二个写事务仍不能取得属主资格。

92	      let removed = false

96	      throw new StorageStartupFailure(
97	        'restore',

101	    }
102	    try {
103	      if (await exists(this.paths.snapshot)) await this.restore()

105	      throw new StorageStartupFailure(
106	        'restore',
107	        `restoring the leftover upgrade snapshot failed: ${describe(error)}`,

113	  /** ③：库文件不存在 ⇒ 在快照位置落「库不存在」标记（临时名 → 落盘 → 改名 → 目录落盘），之后才打开库。 */
114	  async markIfAbsent(): Promise<boolean> {

117	      if (await exists(this.paths.db)) return false

132	  /** ⑥：在线备份把当前已提交状态（含预写日志里的）写成临时名 → 权限同库 → 落盘 → 改名成快照 → 目录落盘。 */

158	  /**

181	      for (const sidecar of paths.sidecars) await removeIfExists(sidecar)
182	      await fsyncDirectory(paths.directory)

189	  snapshotOnDisk(): Promise<boolean> {

193	  /** 确认：删快照或标记，目录落盘之后才算删到。本来就不在 ⇒ false。 */

217	  /** 建快照失败后删半成品；删不掉只记 warn——下一次启动的②会再删它，而它从来不是快照（改名之后才算）。 */

220	      for (const path of [this.paths.snapshotTemp, ...this.paths.snapshotTempSidecars])

222	    } catch (error) {
223	      this.logger?.warn(
224	        'storage-sql: cannot remove the half-written snapshot at %s (the next start removes it): %s',

89	async function destroyHandles(handles: DialectHandles): Promise<void> {
90	  try {
91	    await handles.writeDb.destroy()
92	  } finally {
93	    await handles.readDb.destroy()

99	/** ⑤：一次只读事务里先读表清单与迁移登记，再逐条跑核对；读失败与核对不过都是「核对」阶段。 */
100	async function preflight(
101	  storage: SqlStorage,
102	  handles: DialectHandles,
103	  checks: readonly PreflightCheck[],
104	): Promise<readonly string[]> {
105	  let outcome: {
106	    readonly applied: readonly string[]
107	    readonly rejected: PreflightResult | undefined
108	  }
109	  try {
110	    outcome = await storage.read(async tx => {
111	      const tables: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(await handles.listTables(tx.db))
112	      const applied = tables.has(MIGRATION_REGISTRY_TABLE)
113	        ? Object.freeze(await readMigrationRegistry(tx.db))
114	        : Object.freeze([] as string[])
115	      for (const check of checks) {
116	        const result = await check({ tx, tables, appliedMigrations: applied })
117	        if (!result.ok) return { applied, rejected: result }
118	      }
119	      return { applied, rejected: undefined }
120	    })
121	  } catch (error) {
122	    throw new StorageStartupFailure('preflight', `preflight read failed: ${describe(error)}`, {
123	      cause: error,
124	    })
125	  }
126	  const rejected = outcome.rejected
127	  if (rejected !== undefined && !rejected.ok) {
128	    throw new StorageStartupFailure(
129	      'preflight',
130	      `check "${rejected.check}" refused: ${rejected.detail}`,
131	      { cause: rejected },
132	    )
133	  }
134	  return outcome.applied
135	}

137	/**
138	 * 属主实例的启动：①～⑧。返回的实例 `close()` 即撤除收尾；任一步失败 ⇒ 关句柄 ⇒ 磁盘上有快照或标记即恢复 ⇒ 放排他 ⇒ 抛出。
139	 * 恢复本身失败时抛 `StorageStartupFailure('restore')`，快照不删，带位置。
140	 */
141	export async function openOwnedStorage(input: OwnedStorageInput): Promise<SqlStorage> {
142	  const { site, hooks } = input
143	  const lock = await site.acquire()
144	  let attachment: GuardAttachment
145	  try {
146	    attachment = attachGuard(input.guard, site)
147	  } catch (error) {
148	    await lock.release()
149	    throw error
150	  }
151	
152	  let handles: DialectHandles | undefined
153	  let snapshots: SnapshotEngine | undefined
154	  try {
155	    await hooks.afterAttach?.()
156	    await site.recoverLeftovers()
157	    if (await site.markIfAbsent()) attachment.snapshotTaken = true
158	
159	    await hooks.beforeOpen?.()
160	    const opened = input.openHandles()
161	    handles = hooks.interceptHandles?.(opened) ?? opened
162	    await ping(handles.writeDb)
163	    await ping(handles.readDb)
164	
165	    if (input.maintenance !== undefined)
166	      snapshots = await SnapshotEngine.open(
167	        input.maintenance.workDirectory,
168	        sqliteSnapshotProducer(input.maintenance.sourceFile),
169	      )
170	    const storage = new SqlStorage(
171	      handles,
172	      ownerTeardown(site, attachment, lock),
173	      input.logger,
174	      snapshots === undefined || input.maintenance === undefined
175	        ? undefined
176	        : {
177	            engine: snapshots,
178	            confirmed: () => attachment.phase === 'serving' && attachment.confirmed !== undefined,
179	            onClosed: input.maintenance.onClosed,
180	          },
181	    )
182	    await hooks.beforePreflight?.(handles)
183	    const applied = await preflight(storage, handles, input.checks)
184	
185	    let known: string[]
186	    try {
187	      known = Object.keys(await input.migrations.getMigrations())
188	    } catch (error) {
189	      throw new StorageStartupFailure(
190	        'migration',
191	        `migrations could not be listed: ${describe(error)}`,
192	        { cause: error },
193	      )
194	    }
195	    // 最低防线（架构评审 N-1）：登记里有本次 migrations 不认识的名字 ⇒ 这份数据来自更新的或别的版本，
196	    // 在核对阶段具名失败，不拍快照、不跑迁移。次序是否为前缀由装配的数据格式核对判。
197	    const beyond = applied.filter(name => !known.includes(name))
198	    if (beyond.length > 0) {
199	      throw new StorageStartupFailure(
200	        'preflight',
201	        `check "migration-registry-beyond-known": ${beyond.length} applied migration(s) unknown to this version, first "${beyond[0]}"`,
202	        {
203	          cause: { ok: false, check: 'migration-registry-beyond-known', detail: beyond.join(', ') },
204	        },
205	      )
206	    }
207	    const pending = known.filter(name => !applied.includes(name))
208	    if (pending.length > 0 && !attachment.snapshotTaken && site.takeSnapshot !== undefined) {
209	      await site.takeSnapshot()
210	      attachment.snapshotTaken = true
211	    }
212	
213	    await hooks.beforeMigrate?.()
214	    const migrator = new Migrator({ db: handles.writeDb, provider: input.migrations })
215	    const { error, results } = await migrator.migrateToLatest()
216	    if (results?.some(result => result.status === 'Success') === true) attachment.migrated = true
217	    if (error !== undefined) {
218	      const failed = results?.find(result => result.status === 'Error')?.migrationName
219	      throw new StorageStartupFailure(
220	        'migration',
221	        failed === undefined
222	          ? `migrations could not run: ${describe(error)}`
223	          : `migration "${failed}" failed: ${describe(error)}`,
224	        { cause: error },
225	      )
226	    }
227	
228	    attachment.phase = 'serving'
229	    return storage
230	  } catch (error) {
231	    attachment.phase = 'ended'
232	    if (snapshots !== undefined) {
233	      try {
234	        await snapshots.close()
235	      } catch (closeError) {
236	        input.maintenance?.onClosed('error')
237	        if (!snapshots.ownershipReleased) {
238	          if (handles !== undefined) retainStorageHandles(handles)
239	          throw new StorageStartupFailure(
240	            'preflight',
241	            'maintenance startup cleanup failed; ownership is retained',
242	            { cause: new AggregateError([error, closeError]) },
243	          )
244	        }
245	      }
246	    }
247	    throw await abortStartup(error, site, handles, lock, input.maintenance !== undefined)
248	  }
249	}

251	/** 启动失败的收尾：关句柄 → 有快照或标记即恢复 → 放排他；返回要抛出的失败。 */
252	async function abortStartup(
253	  failure: unknown,
254	  site: OwnerSite,
255	  handles: DialectHandles | undefined,
256	  lock: OwnerLock,
257	  retainOnCloseFailure: boolean,
258	): Promise<unknown> {
259	  let result = failure
260	  // Do not restore data or release source ownership while a native handle survives.
261	  if (handles !== undefined) {
262	    try {
263	      await destroyHandles(handles)
264	    } catch (closeError) {
265	      if (retainOnCloseFailure) {
266	        retainStorageHandles(handles)
267	        return new StorageStartupFailure(
268	          'preflight',
269	          'startup handles remain open; ownership is retained',
270	          {
271	            cause: new AggregateError([failure, closeError]),
272	          },
273	        )
274	      }
275	      await lock.release()
276	      throw closeError
277	    }
278	  }
279	  try {
280	    // ②自己的恢复已经失败过：不在同一次启动里再动那份快照
281	    const restoreAlreadyFailed =
282	      failure instanceof StorageStartupFailure && failure.stage === 'restore'
283	    if (!restoreAlreadyFailed && (await site.snapshotOnDisk())) {
284	      try {
285	        await site.restore()
286	      } catch (restoreError) {
287	        result = new StorageStartupFailure(
288	          'restore',
289	          `startup failed (${describe(failure)}) and restoring the upgrade snapshot failed: ${describe(restoreError)}`,
290	          {
291	            cause: restoreError,
292	            ...(site.location === undefined ? {} : { snapshot: site.location }),
293	          },
294	        )
295	      }
296	    }
297	  } finally {
298	    await lock.release()
299	  }
300	  return result
301	}

303	/**
304	 * 撤除收尾（design.md「成对的装载与撤除」末两行）：①守卫置为已撤 …… ④恢复 ⑤放排他。
305	 * ④失败 ⇒ 快照不删、照样放排他，再以带位置的错误拒绝 `close()`——内核对 disposer 的异常只记日志不上抛，
306	 * 插件的 disposer 自己记 error，装配经 `guard.pending()` 回头看磁盘。
307	 */
308	function ownerTeardown(
309	  site: OwnerSite,
310	  attachment: GuardAttachment,
311	  lock: OwnerLock,
312	): StorageTeardown {
313	  return {
314	    begin() {
315	      attachment.phase = 'disposing'
316	      return attachment.confirming
317	    },
318	    async finish(handlesClosed) {
319	      let failure: unknown
320	      try {
321	        // 句柄没关干净就不替换库文件：快照留在磁盘上，下一次启动的②恢复它
322	        if (handlesClosed && (await site.snapshotOnDisk())) await site.restore()
323	      } catch (error) {
324	        failure = error
325	      } finally {
326	        attachment.phase = 'ended'
327	        await lock.release()
328	      }
329	      if (failure !== undefined) {
330	        throw new Error(
331	          `restoring the unconfirmed upgrade snapshot on dispose failed; snapshot kept at ${site.location ?? '(none)'}: ${describe(failure)}`,
332	          { cause: failure },
333	        )
334	      }
335	    },
336	  }
337	}

2	import { Migrator } from 'kysely/migration'
3	import { z } from 'zod'
4	import { StorageSqlConfig } from './config.ts'
5	import { SqlStorage, ping, type DialectHandles } from './provider.ts'
6	import { openSqlite } from './sqlite/index.ts'
7	import { SqliteOwnerSite } from './sqlite/owner.ts'
8	import { assertProductionStoragePath } from './sqlite/protection.ts'
9	import { openPostgres } from './postgres/index.ts'
10	import { PostgresOwnerSite } from './postgres/owner.ts'
11	import { openOwnedStorage, type StorageSqlLogger, type UpgradeHooks } from './upgrade/owner.ts'
12	
13	export interface OpenStorageOptions {
14	  /** 恢复时的 warn 等诊断记录；插件传 `ctx.logger`。 */
15	  readonly logger?: StorageSqlLogger
16	}
17	
18	function openHandles(config: StorageSqlConfig): DialectHandles {
19	  return config.dialect === 'sqlite'
20	    ? openSqlite({ file: config.file, synchronous: config.synchronous ?? 'normal' })
21	    : openPostgres({ connectionString: config.connectionString })
22	}
23	
24	/**
25	 * 打开一个存储实例（插件体与测试夹具共用）。config 在这里再核一遍，直接调用者同样受「带迁移必须显式给 `upgrade`」约束。
26	 * 失败即抛出：config 错误、打开或 ping 失败、迁移失败，以及属主路径各阶段的 `StorageStartupFailure`。
27	 */
28	export function openStorage(
29	  config: StorageSqlConfig,
30	  options: OpenStorageOptions = {},
31	): Promise<SqlStorage> {
32	  return openStorageWithHooks(config, options, {})
33	}
34	
35	/** 包内测试用：在属主路径的各个时点截住。 */
36	export async function openStorageWithHooks(
37	  config: StorageSqlConfig,
38	  options: OpenStorageOptions,
39	  hooks: UpgradeHooks,
40	): Promise<SqlStorage> {
41	  const parsed = StorageSqlConfig.safeParse(config)
42	  if (!parsed.success)
43	    throw new Error(`invalid storage-sql config: ${z.prettifyError(parsed.error)}`)
44	  const valid = parsed.data
45	  if (valid.dialect === 'sqlite') assertProductionStoragePath(valid.file)
46	  if (valid.migrations !== undefined && valid.upgrade !== undefined && valid.upgrade !== false) {
47	    return openOwnedStorage({
48	      site:
49	        valid.dialect === 'sqlite'
50	          ? new SqliteOwnerSite(valid.file, options.logger, hooks)
51	          : new PostgresOwnerSite(valid.connectionString),
52	      guard: valid.upgrade.guard,
53	      checks: valid.upgrade.checks,
54	      migrations: valid.migrations,
55	      openHandles: () => openHandles(valid),
56	      hooks,
57	      ...(valid.dialect === 'sqlite' && valid.maintenance !== undefined
58	        ? {
59	            maintenance: { ...valid.maintenance, sourceFile: valid.file },
60	          }
61	        : {}),
62	      ...(options.logger === undefined ? {} : { logger: options.logger }),
63	    })
64	  }
65	
66	  const handles = openHandles(valid)
67	  try {
68	    await ping(handles.writeDb)
69	    await ping(handles.readDb)
70	    if (valid.migrations !== undefined) {
71	      const migrator = new Migrator({ db: handles.writeDb, provider: valid.migrations })
72	      const { error } = await migrator.migrateToLatest()
73	      if (error !== undefined) throw error
74	    }
75	  } catch (error) {
76	    await handles.writeDb.destroy().catch(() => undefined)
77	    await handles.readDb.destroy().catch(() => undefined)
78	    throw error
79	  }
80	  return new SqlStorage(handles, undefined, options.logger)
81	}

79	/** 撤除时等在途体检答完的上界：体检里最慢的一项是现探存储（它自己有 2 s 上界）。 */
80	const OPS_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000
81	
82	/**
83	 * 运维面实例：`centerId`、`version`、`startedAt` 只从 `serving` 来，`defectCount` 数 `defect` 通知，都随实例消失
84	 * （契约：重启归零）。应答的门是「见过 `serving`、其后没有 `stopped`」。
85	 */
86	class OpsFace {
87	  readonly #sources: HealthSources
88	  readonly #logger: Logger
89	  readonly #connections = new Set<Http1Connection>()
90	  #notice: ServingNotice | undefined
91	  #open = false
92	  #defects = 0
93	  #closing: Promise<void> | undefined
94	
95	  constructor(
96	    sources: HealthSources,
97	    logger: Logger,
98	    private readonly maintenance: OnlineMaintenance,
99	    private readonly finalized: (failed: boolean) => void,
100	  ) {
101	    this.#sources = sources
102	    this.#logger = logger
103	  }
104	
105	  /**
106	   * 入口层开门（或应 `listening` 重发）。同一个标识 ⇒ 恢复应答，`startedAt` 保留第一次的值；
107	   * 不同的标识是不可能发生的状态：记 error、保留原值、不恢复应答。
108	   */
109	  onServing(notice: ServingNotice): void {
110	    if (this.#notice !== undefined && this.#notice.centerId !== notice.centerId) {
111	      this.#logger.error(
112	        'serving notice carries a different center identifier; ops face stays closed',
113	      )
114	      this.#open = false
115	      this.maintenance.stop()
116	      return
117	    }
118	    this.#notice ??= notice
119	    this.maintenance.serving(notice.centerId)
120	    this.#open = true
121	  }
122	
123	  /** 入口层关门：两张面同时停答；报文还没收齐的连接直接关闭，在途的照答。 */
124	  onStopped(): void {
125	    this.#open = false
126	    this.maintenance.stop()
127	    for (const connection of this.#connections) connection.stopReceiving()
128	  }
129	
130	  onDefect(): void {
131	    this.#defects += 1
132	  }
133	
134	  accept(socket: Socket): void {
135	    const connection = new Http1Connection(socket, RECEIVE_LIMITS, {
136	      accepting: () => this.#open,
137	      answer: async body => {
138	        const notice = this.#notice
139	        if (notice === undefined) return undefined
140	        try {
141	          const reading = readOpsRequest(body)
142	          if (reading.kind === 'exceeds-limit') return undefined
143	          if (reading.kind === 'invalid-input') return responseBytes('{"status":"invalid-input"}')
144	          const request = reading.request
145	          if (request.operation === 'full-health')
146	            return responseBytes(await fullHealthBody(this.#sources, notice, this.#defects))
147	          const result =
148	            request.operation === 'backup'
149	              ? await this.maintenance.backup(request.payload)
150	              : await this.maintenance.backupStatus(request.payload)
151	          return responseBytes(maintenanceResultBody(result))
152	        } catch (error) {
153	          // Also runs if the peer disconnected while the owned operation was pending.
154	          this.#logger.error('ops-internal-defect')
155	          throw error
156	        }
157	      },
158	    })
159	    this.#connections.add(connection)
160	    void connection.closed.then(() => this.#connections.delete(connection))
161	    // 客户端一面开始应答之前（或停收之后），运维面收到连接即关闭，不写任何字节
162	    if (!this.#open) connection.stopReceiving()
163	  }
164	
165	  /** 撤除：停止接受 → 停收 → 有界等在途答完 → 关闭其余连接 → 删掉套接字文件。 */
166	  dispose(server: Server, path: string): Promise<void> {
167	    this.#closing ??= this.#dispose(server, path)
168	    return this.#closing
169	  }
170	  async #dispose(server: Server, path: string): Promise<void> {
171	    this.onStopped()
172	    let failed = true
173	    try {
174	      await withCleanup(
175	        () =>
176	          withCleanup(
177	            () => this.#drain(server),
178	            () => this.maintenance.close(),
179	          ),
180	        () => removeSocketFile(path),
181	      )
182	      failed = false
183	    } finally {
184	      this.finalized(failed)
185	    }
186	  }
187	  async #drain(server: Server): Promise<void> {
188	    const closed = new Promise<void>(resolve => server.close(() => resolve()))
189	    for (const connection of this.#connections) connection.stopReceiving()
190	    let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
191	    const deadline = new Promise<void>(resolve => {
192	      timer = setTimeout(resolve, OPS_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS)
193	    })
194	    await Promise.race([Promise.all([...this.#connections].map(c => c.closed)), deadline])
195	    clearTimeout(timer)
196	    for (const connection of this.#connections) connection.destroy()
197	    await closed
198	  }
199	}

201	export const governanceCenterOpsPlugin = definePlugin<GovernanceCenterOpsConfig>({
202	  name: 'governance-center-ops',
203	  inject: ['storage', 'clock'],
204	  Config: GovernanceCenterOpsConfigSchema,
205	  async apply(ctx: Context, config) {
206	    const logger = ctx.logger('governance-center-ops')
207	    // 服务实例经 inject 取得（`ctx.get` 不带类型）；按各 owner 公开的服务面类型收下
208	    const storage: Storage & { readonly maintenance?: SnapshotMaintenance } = ctx.get('storage')
209	    if (storage.maintenance === undefined) throw new Error('owned snapshot maintenance is required')
210	    const clock: Clock = ctx.get('clock')
211	    const controller: { status: 'pending' | 'clean' | 'error' } = { status: 'pending' }
212	    const maintenance = new OnlineMaintenance({
213	      ...config.maintenance,
214	      workDirectory: join(config.maintenance.backupDirectory, '.quarantine'),
215	      source: storage.maintenance,
216	      clock,
217	      report: diagnostic =>
218	        logger.error(
219	          'maintenance-residual: %s; published: %s',
220	          diagnostic.temporaryLocation,
221	          diagnostic.publishedLocation ?? '(none)',
222	        ),
223	      onClosed: status => {
224	        controller.status = status
225	      },
226	    })
227	    const face = new OpsFace(
228	      {
229	        storage,
230	        clock,
231	        deploymentKey: config.deploymentKey,
232	        deploymentParameters: config.deploymentParameters,
233	        reportProbeDefect: errorName =>
234	          logger.error('storage probe for the full health check failed with %s', errorName),
235	      },
236	      logger,
237	      maintenance,
238	      failed =>
239	        config.maintenance.onClosed(!failed && controller.status === 'clean' ? 'clean' : 'error'),
240	    )
241	    // 先挂三条监听（经 effect 纳管，随本 fiber 撤除）；只订阅事件声明模块里的三个名字
242	    ctx.on(serving, notice => face.onServing(notice))
243	    ctx.on(stopped, () => face.onStopped())
244	    ctx.on(defect, () => face.onDefect())
245	
246	    let path: string
247	    let server: Server
248	    try {
249	      path = await prepareSocketPath(config.socketDirectory)
250	      server = await listenOnSocket(path)
251	    } catch (error) {
252	      await maintenance.close()
253	      config.maintenance.onClosed(controller.status === 'clean' ? 'clean' : 'error')
254	      throw error
255	    }
256	    server.on('connection', socket => face.accept(socket))
257	    // 监听期间的服务器错误（例如接受连接时句柄耗尽）只记下，不让进程因未处理的 error 退出
258	    server.on('error', error => logger.error('ops socket server error: %s', error.name))
259	    try {
260	      ctx.effect(() => () => face.dispose(server, path), 'governance-center-ops socket')
261	    } catch (error) {
262	      // 登记时本 fiber 已被撤（INACTIVE_EFFECT）：自己收掉再重抛
263	      await face.dispose(server, path)
264	      throw error
265	    }
266	
267	    // 握手：开着门的入口层据此重发 `serving`；处理者抛出只记 error（emit 不隔离监听者）
268	    try {
269	      ctx.emit(listening)
270	    } catch (error) {
271	      logger.error(
272	        'a listener of %s threw: %s',
273	        listening,
274	        error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'non-error',
275	      )
276	    }
277	  },
278	})

14	export type MaintenanceCommand =
15	  | {
16	      readonly kind: 'ops'
17	      readonly socketDirectory: string
18	      readonly operation: 'full-health' | 'backup' | 'backup-status'
19	      readonly onlyIfDue: boolean
20	    }
21	  | { readonly kind: 'verify'; readonly sourceLocation: string; readonly workDirectory: string }
22	  | {
23	      readonly kind: 'restore-isolated'
24	      readonly sourceLocation: string
25	      readonly workDirectory: string
26	      readonly targetLocation: string
27	    }
28	
29	export function parseMaintenanceCommand(argv: readonly string[]): MaintenanceCommand | undefined {
30	  const [kind, ...rest] = argv
31	  if (kind !== 'ops' && kind !== 'verify' && kind !== 'restore-isolated') return undefined
32	  const flags = new Map<string, string>()
33	  let operation: 'full-health' | 'backup' | 'backup-status' | undefined
34	  let onlyIfDue = false
35	  for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) {
36	    const word = rest[i]!
37	    if (
38	      kind === 'ops' &&
39	      (word === 'full-health' || word === 'backup' || word === 'backup-status')
40	    ) {
41	      if (operation !== undefined) return undefined
42	      operation = word
43	    } else if (kind === 'ops' && word === '--only-if-due') {
44	      if (onlyIfDue) return undefined
45	      onlyIfDue = true
46	    } else {
47	      const allowed =
48	        kind === 'ops'
49	          ? ['--socket-dir']
50	          : kind === 'verify'
51	            ? ['--source', '--work-dir']
52	            : ['--source', '--target', '--work-dir']
53	      if (!allowed.includes(word) || flags.has(word)) return undefined
54	      const value = rest[++i]
55	      if (!validMaintenanceLocation(value) || !isAbsolute(value)) return undefined
56	      flags.set(word, value)
57	    }
58	  }
59	  if (kind === 'ops') {
60	    const socketDirectory = flags.get('--socket-dir')
61	    if (
62	      socketDirectory === undefined ||
63	      operation === undefined ||
64	      (onlyIfDue && operation !== 'backup')
65	    )
66	      return undefined
67	    return { kind, socketDirectory, operation, onlyIfDue }
68	  }
69	  const sourceLocation = flags.get('--source')
70	  const workDirectory = flags.get('--work-dir')
71	  if (sourceLocation === undefined || workDirectory === undefined) return undefined
72	  if (kind === 'verify') return { kind, sourceLocation, workDirectory }
73	  const targetLocation = flags.get('--target')
74	  return targetLocation === undefined
75	    ? undefined
76	    : { kind, sourceLocation, workDirectory, targetLocation }
77	}

79	/** One request, no retries. Disconnect only abandons the client's wait. */
80	export function callOps(
81	  command: Extract<MaintenanceCommand, { kind: 'ops' }>,
82	  signal: AbortSignal,
83	): Promise<unknown> {
84	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
85	    const socket = connect(join(command.socketDirectory, OPS_SOCKET_NAME))
86	    let done = false
87	    let bytes = Buffer.alloc(0)
88	    const finish = (error?: Error, value?: unknown) => {
89	      if (done) return
90	      done = true
91	      signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort)
92	      socket.destroy()
93	      if (error !== undefined) reject(error)
94	      else resolve(value)
95	    }
96	    const abort = () => finish(new Error('ops-result-unconfirmed'))
97	    signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true })
98	    if (signal.aborted) abort()
99	    socket.on('error', abort)
100	    socket.on('close', () => {
101	      if (!done) abort()
102	    })
103	    socket.on('connect', () => {
104	      if (done) return
105	      const body = JSON.stringify({
106	        opsVersion: '1',
107	        operation: command.operation,
108	        payload: command.operation === 'backup' ? { onlyIfDue: command.onlyIfDue } : {},
109	      })
110	      socket.end(`POST / HTTP/1.1\r\nContent-Length: ${Buffer.byteLength(body)}\r\n\r\n${body}`)
111	    })
112	    socket.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
113	      if (done) return
114	      if (bytes.length + chunk.length > 8192 + 65_536) {
115	        abort()
116	        return
117	      }
118	      bytes = Buffer.concat([bytes, chunk])
119	    })
120	    socket.on('end', () => {
121	      if (done) return
122	      const boundary = bytes.indexOf('\r\n\r\n')
123	      const header = bytes.subarray(0, boundary + 4).toString('latin1')
124	      const match =
125	        /^HTTP\/1\.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application\/json\r\nCache-Control: no-store\r\nContent-Length: (0|[1-9][0-9]*)\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n$/.exec(
126	          header,
127	        )
128	      if (boundary < 0 || match === null || Number(match[1]) !== bytes.length - boundary - 4) {
129	        abort()
130	        return
131	      }
132	      try {
133	        finish(undefined, readOpsReplyBody(command.operation, bytes.subarray(boundary + 4)))
134	      } catch {
135	        abort()
136	      }
137	    })
138	  })
139	}

141	export interface MaintenanceCommandIo {
142	  stdout(text: string): void | Promise<void>
143	  stderr(text: string): void | Promise<void>
144	}
145	export function maintenanceExit(value: unknown): number {
146	  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || !('status' in value)) return 0 // validated full-health
147	  if (value.status === 'outcome-unknown' || value.status === 'unavailable') return 1
148	  if (value.status === 'observed') return 'health' in value && value.health === 'current' ? 0 : 2
149	  return ['completed', 'not-due', 'verified', 'restored-isolated'].includes(String(value.status))
150	    ? 0
151	    : 2
152	}
153	
154	export async function runMaintenanceCommand(
155	  command: MaintenanceCommand,
156	  io: MaintenanceCommandIo,
157	  signal: AbortSignal,
158	): Promise<number> {
159	  const diagnostics: string[] = []
160	  let closingFailed = false
161	  try {
162	    let result: unknown
163	    if (command.kind === 'ops') result = await callOps(command, signal)
164	    else {
165	      let inspection
166	      try {
167	        inspection = await openSnapshotInspection(command.workDirectory)
168	        const offline = createOfflineMaintenance({
169	          inspection,
170	          workDirectory: command.workDirectory,
171	          snapshotChecks: hostSnapshotChecks,
172	          migrationNames: composedMigrationNames(hostMigrationFragments),
173	          // Buffer local diagnostics so every output write is awaited outside the callback.
174	          report: diagnostic => diagnostics.push(JSON.stringify(diagnostic) + '\n'),
175	        })
176	        result =
177	          command.kind === 'verify'
178	            ? await offline.verify({ sourceLocation: command.sourceLocation }, signal)
179	            : await offline.restoreIsolated(
180	                { sourceLocation: command.sourceLocation, targetLocation: command.targetLocation },
181	                signal,
182	              )
183	      } catch (error) {
184	        result = maintenanceFailureResult(error)
185	      } finally {
186	        try {
187	          await inspection?.close()
188	        } catch {
189	          closingFailed = true
190	          diagnostics.push('tenancy-host: maintenance cleanup incomplete\n')
191	        }
192	      }
193	    }
194	    if (
195	      closingFailed &&
196	      typeof result === 'object' &&
197	      result !== null &&
198	      'status' in result &&
199	      ['completed', 'not-due', 'verified', 'restored-isolated', 'observed'].includes(
200	        String(result.status),
201	      )
202	    )
203	      throw new Error('maintenance cleanup incomplete')
204	    for (const line of diagnostics.splice(0)) await io.stderr(line)
205	    await io.stdout(JSON.stringify(result) + '\n')
206	    return closingFailed ? 1 : maintenanceExit(result)
207	  } catch {
208	    try {
209	      for (const line of diagnostics) await io.stderr(line)
210	      await io.stderr(
211	        command.kind === 'ops'
212	          ? 'tenancy-host: ops result unconfirmed\n'
213	          : 'tenancy-host: maintenance failed\n',
214	      )
215	    } catch {
216	      /* Diagnostic output failure cannot turn this operation into success. */
217	    }
218	    return 1
219	  }
220	}

93	interface Deferred<T> {
94	  readonly promise: Promise<T>
95	  resolve(value: T): void
96	  reject(reason: unknown): void
97	}
98	
99	function deferred<T>(): Deferred<T> {
100	  let resolve: (value: T) => void = () => undefined
101	  let reject: (reason: unknown) => void = () => undefined
102	  const promise = new Promise<T>((res, rej) => {
103	    resolve = res
104	    reject = rej
105	  })
106	  return { promise, resolve, reject }
107	}

109	/** 有界等待：到时返回 `'timeout'`，并清掉定时器。 */
110	async function within<T>(promise: Promise<T>, ms: number): Promise<T | 'timeout'> {
111	  let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
112	  const deadline = new Promise<'timeout'>(resolve => {
113	    timer = setTimeout(() => resolve('timeout'), ms)
114	  })
115	  try {
116	    return await Promise.race([promise, deadline])
117	  } finally {
118	    clearTimeout(timer)
119	  }
120	}

122	/** 一条 fiber 启动失败 ⇒ 具名阶段。存储插件的具名阶段原样沿用；存储别的失败统一是「存储打不开」。 */
123	function fiberFailure(name: HostPluginName, error: unknown): HostStartupFailure {
124	  const thrown = describeThrown(error)
125	  if (thrown.type === 'ValidationError')
126	    return new HostStartupFailure('plugin', `the config of ${name} is invalid: ${thrown.message}`, {
127	      item: name,
128	      cause: error,
129	    })
130	  if (name === 'storage-sql') {
131	    if (error instanceof StorageStartupFailure)
132	      return new HostStartupFailure(
133	        error.stage,
134	        error.snapshot === undefined
135	          ? error.message
136	          : `${error.message} (the upgrade snapshot is kept at ${error.snapshot})`,
137	        {
138	          item: name,
139	          cause: error,
140	          ...(error.snapshot === undefined ? {} : { snapshot: error.snapshot }),
141	        },
142	      )
143	    return new HostStartupFailure(
144	      'storage-open',
145	      `the storage could not be opened: ${thrown.type}: ${thrown.message}`,
146	      { item: name, cause: error },
147	    )
148	  }
149	  if (name === 'governance-center-entry' && error instanceof GovernanceCenterClockTimeoutError)
150	    return new HostStartupFailure(
151	      'clock-unreadable',
152	      'the center clock could not be read within the startup bound (OMNE_TENANCY_CLOCK_READY_TIMEOUT)',
153	      { item: name, cause: error },
154	    )
155	  return new HostStartupFailure(
156	    'plugin',
157	    `${name} failed to start: ${thrown.type}: ${thrown.message}`,
158	    {
159	      item: name,
160	      cause: error,
161	    },
162	  )
163	}

165	/** 清单错误时点名缺的服务：插件声明的 inject 里此刻解析不到的那些。 */
166	function missingServices(context: Context, entry: ManifestEntry): string[] {
167	  const inject: unknown = (entry.plugin as { readonly inject?: unknown }).inject
168	  const names = Array.isArray(inject)
169	    ? inject.filter((name): name is string => typeof name === 'string')
170	    : typeof inject === 'object' && inject !== null
171	      ? Object.keys(inject)
172	      : []
173	  return names.filter(name => context.get(name) === undefined)
174	}

181	/**
182	 * 按装载的逆序逐个撤除（不 dispose 根 Context：那会让全部 disposer 并发，clock 收回租约的写可能撞上已关准入的存储）。
183	 * 顺序覆盖真实结算；30秒仅诊断仍在停止，不结束等待或放弃属主。
184	 */
185	async function disposeInReverse(
186	  loaded: readonly Loaded[],
187	  log: Logger,
188	  finalization: MaintenanceFinalization,
189	): Promise<HostDisposal> {
190	  const remaining = [...loaded].reverse()
191	  const failed = new Set<HostPluginName>()
192	  const timer = setTimeout(
193	    () => log.warn({ event: 'still-stopping', unfinished: remaining.map(item => item.name) }),
194	    DISPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS,
195	  )
196	  try {
197	    while (remaining.length > 0) {
198	      const item = remaining[0]!
199	      try {
200	        await item.fiber.dispose()
201	      } catch (error) {
202	        failed.add(item.name)
203	        log.error({
204	          event: 'fiber-dispose-failed',
205	          plugin: item.name,
206	          error: describeThrown(error).type,
207	        })
208	      }
209	      remaining.shift()
210	      log.info({ event: 'fiber-disposed', plugin: item.name })
211	    }
212	  } finally {
213	    clearTimeout(timer)
214	  }
215	  if (
216	    loaded.some(item => item.name === 'governance-center-ops') &&
217	    finalization.controller !== 'clean'
218	  )
219	    failed.add('governance-center-ops')
220	  if (loaded.some(item => item.name === 'storage-sql') && finalization.storage !== 'clean')
221	    failed.add('storage-sql')
222	  const unfinished = [...loaded]
223	    .reverse()
224	    .map(item => item.name)
225	    .filter(name => failed.has(name))
226	  if (unfinished.length > 0)
227	    log.error({
228	      event: 'dispose-incomplete',
229	      unfinished,
230	      controller: finalization.controller,
231	      storage: finalization.storage,
232	    })
233	  return { complete: unfinished.length === 0, unfinished }
234	}

236	/** 写恰一条启动失败记录（阶段、点名的项、错误类型、说明、快照位置），返回同一个失败供抛出。 */
237	function recordFailure(log: Logger, failure: HostStartupFailure): HostStartupFailure {
238	  const cause = failure.cause
239	  log.error({
240	    event: 'startup-failed',
241	    stage: failure.stage,
242	    ...(failure.item === undefined ? {} : { item: failure.item }),
243	    errorType: cause === undefined ? failure.name : describeThrown(cause).type,
244	    message: failure.message,
245	    ...(failure.snapshot === undefined ? {} : { snapshot: failure.snapshot }),
246	  })
247	  return failure
248	}

251	  if (error instanceof HostStartupFailure) return error
252	  const thrown = describeThrown(error)
253	  return new HostStartupFailure('plugin', `unexpected failure: ${thrown.type}: ${thrown.message}`, {
254	    cause: error,
255	  })
256	}

258	/**
259	 * 起治理中心。返回时入口层已开闸（中心「起来了」）；拒绝时已按逆序撤完、确认之前的升级已撤回，
260	 * 并已写恰一条 `startup-failed` 记录。调用方（进程入口）据此退出非零。
261	 */
262	export async function boot(options: BootOptions = {}): Promise<TenancyHost> {
263	  const hooks = options.hooks ?? {}
264	  // 根 Context 先只挂日志：起插件之前的失败与之后的失败走同一条流、同一形状；此时没有任何插件 fiber、未碰数据
265	  const context = new Context()
266	  const log = attachLog(context, options.log ?? stderrSink)
267	
268	  const guard = createUpgradeGuard()
269	  const open = deferred<void>()
270	  // 入口层吸收拒绝；它没装上时拒绝也不能成为未处理的拒绝
271	  open.promise.catch(() => undefined)
272	  try {
273	    const config = await readHostConfig(options.env ?? process.env)
274	    verifyKeyPairing(config.keys)
275	    const backupDirectory = await prepareBackupDirectory(config)
276	    const sourceBuildId = await readBuildId()
277	    const finalization = new MaintenanceFinalization()
278	    const fragments = [...hostMigrationFragments, ...(hooks.extraMigrations ?? [])]
279	    const built = buildManifest(config, {
280	      migrations: composeMigrations(fragments),
281	      checks: [
282	        dataFormatPreflight(composedMigrationNames(fragments)),
283	        clockPreflight(),
284	        governanceCenterPreflight,
285	      ],
286	      guard,
287	      openSignal: open.promise,
288	      maintenance: {
289	        backupDirectory,
290	        sourceBuildId,
291	        migrationNames: composedMigrationNames(fragments),
292	        storageClosed: finalization.storageClosed,
293	        controllerClosed: finalization.controllerClosed,
294	      },
295	    })
296	    const manifest = hooks.manifest?.(built) ?? built
297	    return await assemble(
298	      context,
299	      log,
300	      manifest,
301	      guard,
302	      open,
303	      config.clockReadyTimeoutMs,
304	      hooks,
305	      finalization,
306	    )
307	  } catch (error) {
308	    throw recordFailure(log, asFailure(error))
309	  }
310	}

312	async function assemble(
313	  context: Context,
314	  log: Logger,
315	  manifest: readonly ManifestEntry[],
316	  guard: UpgradeGuard,
317	  open: Deferred<void>,
318	  clockReadyTimeoutMs: number,
319	  hooks: BootHooks,
320	  finalization: MaintenanceFinalization,
321	): Promise<TenancyHost> {
322	  const loaded: Loaded[] = []
323	  const serving = deferred<ServingNotice>()
324	  let stopWatching: (() => void) | undefined
325	
326	  /** 失败收场：拒绝 openSignal → 逆序全撤 → 撤后核查未确认的快照。 */
327	  const abort = async (failure: HostStartupFailure): Promise<HostStartupFailure> => {
328	    open.reject(failure)
329	    stopWatching?.()
330	    await disposeInReverse(loaded, log, finalization)
331	    const pending = await guard.pending()
332	    if (typeof pending === 'object' && failure.stage !== 'restore')
333	      return new HostStartupFailure(
334	        'upgrade-unconfirmed',
335	        `the upgrade is not confirmed: restoring the upgrade snapshot failed, the snapshot is kept at ${pending.pending.location} (startup had failed at ${failure.stage}: ${failure.message})`,
336	        {
337	          snapshot: pending.pending.location,
338	          cause: failure,
339	          ...(failure.item === undefined ? {} : { item: failure.item }),
340	        },
341	      )
342	    return failure
343	  }
344	
345	  let confirmation: UpgradeConfirmation
346	  try {
347	    for (const entry of manifest) {
348	      if (entry.name === 'governance-center-entry') {
349	        // serving 的监听在运维面之后、入口层之前登记：只记录、不做控制、不抛（emit 不隔离监听者）
350	        stopWatching = context.on(SERVING_EVENT, (notice: ServingNotice) => {
351	          try {
352	            serving.resolve(notice)
353	            log.info({
354	              event: 'serving',
355	              centerId: notice.centerId,
356	              version: notice.version,
357	              startedAt: notice.startedAt,
358	            })
359	          } catch {
360	            // 记录失败不影响入口层与运维面
361	          }
362	        })
363	      }
364	      const fiber = context.plugin(entry.plugin, entry.config)
365	      loaded.push({ name: entry.name, fiber })
366	      hooks.observeFiber?.(entry.name, fiber)
367	      // PENDING 是结构判定，不是等待：它需要的服务不在前面装的插件里
368	      if ((fiber.state as number) === FIBER_STATE.PENDING)
369	        throw new HostStartupFailure(
370	          'manifest',
371	          `${entry.name} is PENDING: ${missingServices(context, entry).join(', ') || 'a required service'} not provided by the plugins loaded before it`,
372	          { item: entry.name },
373	        )
374	      try {
375	        await fiber
376	      } catch (error) {
377	        throw fiberFailure(entry.name, error)
378	      }
379	    }
380	    log.info({ event: 'manifest-active', plugins: loaded.map(l => l.name) })
381	
382	    await hooks.beforeConfirm?.(context)
383	    const confirmer = hooks.confirmWith?.(guard) ?? guard
384	    try {
385	      confirmation = await confirmer.confirm()
386	    } catch (error) {
387	      const thrown = describeThrown(error)
388	      throw new HostStartupFailure(
389	        'upgrade-confirm',
390	        `the upgrade confirmation failed: ${thrown.type}: ${thrown.message}`,
391	        { cause: error },
392	      )
393	    }
394	    if (confirmation.snapshotTaken && !confirmation.snapshotRemoved)
395	      throw new HostStartupFailure(
396	        'upgrade-confirm',
397	        'the upgrade confirmation did not remove the snapshot it took',
398	      )
399	    log.info({ event: 'upgrade-confirmed', ...confirmation })
400	    if (confirmation.migrated && !confirmation.snapshotTaken)
401	      log.warn({
402	        event: 'upgrade-irreversible',
403	        gap: 'U-3',
404	        message: '本次升级不可撤回（U-3）：迁移已提交且没有快照，此后的失败不会把数据撤回到升级前',
405	      })
406	  } catch (error) {
407	    throw await abort(asFailure(error))
408	  }
409	
410	  // 确认之后才放行开闸；等不到 serving ⇒ 启动失败、逆序全撤，快照已确认、不恢复（缺口 U-4）
411	  open.resolve()
412	  log.info({ event: 'open-signal' })
413	  const notice = await within(serving.promise, clockReadyTimeoutMs + SERVING_GRACE_MS)
414	  if (notice === 'timeout')
415	    throw await abort(
416	      new HostStartupFailure(
417	        'serving-timeout',
418	        '钟读不到或回拨：重启前先核钟 (the entry did not open after the upgrade was confirmed; the clock could not be read or went backwards — check the clock before restarting)',
419	        { item: 'governance-center-entry' },
420	      ),
421	    )
422	
423	  const fibers: Partial<Record<HostPluginName, Fiber>> = {}
424	  for (const { name, fiber } of loaded) fibers[name] = fiber
425	  let disposal: Promise<HostDisposal> | undefined
426	  return {
427	    context,
428	    fibers,
429	    serving: notice,
430	    confirmation,
431	    dispose() {
432	      disposal ??= (async () => {
433	        stopWatching?.()
434	        const result = await disposeInReverse(loaded, log, finalization)
435	        const pending = await guard.pending()
436	        if (pending !== 'clear') {
437	          const unfinished = [...new Set([...result.unfinished, 'storage-sql' as const])]
438	          log.error({ event: 'dispose-incomplete', unfinished, upgrade: pending })
439	          log.info({ event: 'disposed', complete: false })
440	          return { complete: false, unfinished }
441	        }
442	        log.info({ event: 'disposed', complete: result.complete })
443	        return result
444	      })()
445	      return disposal
446	    },
447	  }
448	}

100	/**
101	 * 一份 PEM 的来源：恰一个——两个都缺 ⇒ 缺；两个都设 ⇒ 二义；文件读不到 ⇒ 读不到；
102	 * `ownerOnly` 时文件对 group／other 可读 ⇒ 权限过宽（DSH 先例 `0600`）。先打开再对同一句柄 `stat`，不查一个路径读另一个文件。
103	 */
104	export async function readPemSource(
105	  env: HostEnv,
106	  variable: string,
107	  ownerOnly: boolean,
108	): Promise<string> {
109	  const inline = present(env, variable)
110	  const fileVariable = `${variable}${FILE_SUFFIX}`
111	  const path = present(env, fileVariable)
112	  if (inline === undefined && path === undefined)
113	    throw configFailure(variable, `missing: set ${variable} or ${fileVariable}`)
114	  if (inline !== undefined && path !== undefined)
115	    throw configFailure(variable, `ambiguous: both ${variable} and ${fileVariable} are set`)
116	  if (inline !== undefined) return inline
117	  if (path === undefined) throw configFailure(variable, 'missing')
118	  let handle
119	  try {
120	    handle = await open(path, 'r')
121	  } catch (error) {
122	    throw configFailure(fileVariable, `the file cannot be opened (${errorCode(error)})`)
123	  }
124	  try {
125	    const info = await handle.stat()
126	    if (!info.isFile()) throw configFailure(fileVariable, 'not a regular file')
127	    if (ownerOnly && (info.mode & 0o044) !== 0)
128	      throw configFailure(
129	        fileVariable,
130	        'the file is readable by group or others; restrict it to its owner (0600)',
131	      )
132	    return await handle.readFile('utf8')
133	  } catch (error) {
134	    if (error instanceof HostStartupFailure) throw error
135	    throw configFailure(fileVariable, `the file cannot be read (${errorCode(error)})`)
136	  } finally {
137	    await handle.close()
138	  }
139	}

141	/** 时长：正整数毫秒（纯数字）或 ISO 8601 时长；判据是 offer-expiry 的 `parseOfferTtl`，不自造第二个解析器。 */
142	function duration(env: HostEnv, name: string): number {
143	  const text = required(env, name)
144	  const parsed = parseOfferTtl(/^[0-9]+$/.test(text) ? Number(text) : text)
145	  if (!isOk(parsed))
146	    throw configFailure(
147	      name,
148	      'not a positive duration (milliseconds, or an ISO 8601 duration such as P7D)',
149	    )
150	  return parsed.ok
151	}
152	
153	function storageSource(env: HostEnv): StorageSource {
154	  const dialect = present(env, ENV.storageDialect) ?? 'sqlite'
155	  if (dialect === 'sqlite') return { dialect, file: required(env, ENV.storageFile) }
156	  if (dialect === 'postgres') return { dialect, connectionString: required(env, ENV.storageUrl) }
157	  throw configFailure(ENV.storageDialect, 'unknown dialect (expected sqlite or postgres)')
158	}
159	
160	/** `host:port`，IPv6 写成 `[addr]:port`；不设默认端口。端口 0 由系统分配（入口层 Config 接受，只用于测试）。 */
161	function listenAddress(env: HostEnv): { readonly host: string; readonly port: number } {
162	  const text = required(env, ENV.entryListen)
163	  const match = /^(?:\[([^\]]+)\]|([^:[\]]+)):([0-9]{1,5})$/.exec(text)
164	  const host = match?.[1] ?? match?.[2]
165	  const port = Number(match?.[3])
166	  if (host === undefined || !Number.isInteger(port) || port > 65_535)
167	    throw configFailure(ENV.entryListen, 'not a host:port address')
168	  return { host, port }
169	}
170	
171	function credentialPolicy(env: HostEnv): unknown {
172	  const text = present(env, ENV.credentialPolicy)
173	  if (text === undefined) return undefined
174	  try {
175	    return JSON.parse(text) as unknown
176	  } catch {
177	    throw configFailure(ENV.credentialPolicy, 'not valid JSON')
178	  }
179	}
180	
181	/**
182	 * 等钟可读的上界必须严格大于时钟的租约宽度：崩溃后快速重启落在旧租约窗口里时钟至多这么久读不到，
183	 * 界不大于它，快速重启就必然启动失败（design「其余 config」）。
184	 */
185	function clockReadyTimeout(env: HostEnv): number {
186	  const value = duration(env, ENV.clockReadyTimeout)
187	  if (value <= LEASE_WIDTH_MS)
188	    throw configFailure(
189	      ENV.clockReadyTimeout,
190	      `must be greater than the clock lease width (${String(LEASE_WIDTH_MS)} ms)`,
191	    )
192	  return value
193	}
194	
195	/** 读全部 config。次序固定，第一个不成立的项即失败；不碰数据、不起 Context 之外的任何东西。 */
196	export async function readHostConfig(env: HostEnv): Promise<HostConfig> {
197	  const storage = storageSource(env)
198	  const keys: DeploymentKeyPems = {
199	    activationSigningKeyPem: await readPemSource(env, ENV.activationSigningKey, true),
200	    activationVerificationKeyPem: await readPemSource(env, ENV.activationVerificationKey, true),
201	    purgeSigningKeyPem: await readPemSource(env, ENV.purgeSigningKey, true),
202	    purgeVerificationKeyPem: await readPemSource(env, ENV.purgeVerificationKey, true),
203	  }
204	  const parameters: DeploymentParameterValues = {
205	    unactivatedRetention: duration(env, ENV.unactivatedRetention),
206	    invitationTtlDefault: duration(env, ENV.invitationTtlDefault),
207	    affiliationRequestTtlDefault: duration(env, ENV.affiliationRequestTtlDefault),
208	    copyNoticeTtlDefault: duration(env, ENV.copyNoticeTtlDefault),
209	    sharingInvitationTtlDefault: duration(env, ENV.sharingInvitationTtlDefault),
210	  }
211	  const teamCreationKeyRetention = duration(env, ENV.teamCreationKeyRetention)
212	  const policy = credentialPolicy(env)
213	  const clockReadyTimeoutMs = clockReadyTimeout(env)
214	  const listen = listenAddress(env)
215	  const certificateChainPem = await readPemSource(env, ENV.entryTlsCertChain, false)
216	  const privateKeyPem = await readPemSource(env, ENV.entryTlsPrivateKey, true)
217	  const opsSocketDirectory = required(env, ENV.opsSocketDirectory)
218	  const backupDirectory = env[ENV.backupDirectory]
219	  if (backupDirectory !== undefined && !isAbsolute(backupDirectory))
220	    throw configFailure(ENV.backupDirectory, 'must be an absolute path')
221	  return {
222	    storage,
223	    keys,
224	    parameters,
225	    teamCreationKeyRetention,
226	    credentialPolicy: policy,
227	    clockReadyTimeoutMs,
228	    entry: { listen, tls: { certificateChainPem, privateKeyPem } },
229	    opsSocketDirectory,
230	    ...(backupDirectory === undefined ? {} : { backupDirectory }),
231	  }
232	}

27	/** 八条 fiber 的名字（= 各插件的 `name`），按装载次序。 */
28	export const HOST_PLUGIN_NAMES = [
29	  'storage-sql',
30	  'clock',
31	  'credential-verification',
32	  'account-identity',
33	  'organization-governance',
34	  'account-registration',
35	  'governance-center-ops',
36	  'governance-center-entry',
37	] as const
38	
39	export type HostPluginName = (typeof HOST_PLUGIN_NAMES)[number]
40	
41	export interface ManifestEntry {
42	  readonly name: HostPluginName
43	  readonly plugin: Plugin
44	  readonly config: unknown
45	}
46	
47	/** 停机排空上界（入口层 `drainTimeoutMs`）：有界网络排空，不代表维护工作结束。 */
48	export const DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000
49	/** 停止诊断阈值：只记录still-stopping，随后继续等待真实撤除。 */
50	export const DISPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
51	/** 兑现 `openSignal` 之后等 `serving` 的余量：上界 = `clockReadyTimeoutMs` + 它（盖住入口层开闸时那一次再读钟）。 */
