53	
54	/** 装配运行时对象：只能由 `boot()` 在装载时构造，不来自环境变量。 */
55	export interface ManifestRuntime {
56	  readonly migrations: MigrationProvider
57	  readonly checks: readonly PreflightCheck[]
58	  readonly guard: UpgradeGuard
59	  readonly openSignal: PromiseLike<unknown>
60	  readonly maintenance: {
61	    readonly backupDirectory: string
62	    readonly sourceBuildId: string | null
63	    readonly migrationNames: readonly string[]
64	    readonly storageClosed: (status: 'clean' | 'error') => void
65	    readonly controllerClosed: (status: 'clean' | 'error') => void
66	  }
67	}
68	
69	/**
70	 * 由已解析的 config 与运行时对象构造清单。密钥只进三个 config：AR←activation 私钥、OG←purge 私钥、AI←两把公钥；
71	 * TLS 材料只进入口层；运维面的 config 里没有任何 PEM、没有任何服务句柄。存储与时钟各恰一份。
72	 */
73	export function buildManifest(
74	  config: HostConfig,
75	  runtime: ManifestRuntime,
76	): readonly ManifestEntry[] {
77	  if (config.storage.dialect !== 'sqlite')
78	    throw new Error(
79	      'tenancy-host: bounded governance currently requires SQLite; PostgreSQL composition is not supported',
80	    )
81	  const storage: StorageSqlConfig = {
82	    dialect: 'sqlite',
83	    file: config.storage.file,
84	    synchronous: 'full',
85	    migrations: runtime.migrations,
86	    upgrade: { checks: [...runtime.checks], guard: runtime.guard },
87	    maintenance: {
88	      workDirectory: join(runtime.maintenance.backupDirectory, '.quarantine'),
89	      onClosed: runtime.maintenance.storageClosed,
90	    },
91	  }
92	  const ops: GovernanceCenterOpsConfig = {
93	    socketDirectory: config.opsSocketDirectory,
94	    // 配对自检通过才走到这里：四份都有来源即「在」，都合形状且两对都配对即「完整」
95	    deploymentKey: { present: true, complete: true },
96	    deploymentParameters: { ...config.parameters },
97	    maintenance: {
98	      backupDirectory: runtime.maintenance.backupDirectory,
99	      sourceBuildId: runtime.maintenance.sourceBuildId,
100	      migrationNames: runtime.maintenance.migrationNames,
101	      snapshotChecks: hostSnapshotChecks,
102	      onClosed: runtime.maintenance.controllerClosed,
103	    },
104	  }
105	  const entry: GovernanceCenterEntryConfig = {
106	    listen: config.entry.listen,
107	    tls: config.entry.tls,
108	    version: HOST_VERSION,
109	    drainTimeoutMs: DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS,
110	    clockReadyTimeoutMs: config.clockReadyTimeoutMs,
111	    openSignal: runtime.openSignal,
112	  }
113	  return [
114	    { name: 'storage-sql', plugin: storageSqlPlugin, config: storage },
115	    { name: 'clock', plugin: clockPlugin, config: {} },
116	    // scrypt 参数取 credential-verification 的缺省（OWASP 最低建议）；本版没有来源变量
117	    { name: 'credential-verification', plugin: credentialsPlugin, config: {} },

123	        // 键在、值为 undefined 才是契约 S-27 的「取不到 ⇒ credential-rejected」

125	        unactivatedRetention: config.parameters.unactivatedRetention,

127	        purgeVerificationKeyPem: config.keys.purgeVerificationKeyPem,
128	      },
129	    },
130	    {
131	      name: 'organization-governance',
132	      plugin: organizationGovernancePlugin,
133	      config: {
134	        invitationTtlDefault: config.parameters.invitationTtlDefault,
135	        affiliationRequestTtlDefault: config.parameters.affiliationRequestTtlDefault,
136	        teamCreationKeyRetention: config.teamCreationKeyRetention,
137	        purgeSigningKeyPem: config.keys.purgeSigningKeyPem,
138	      },
139	    },
140	    {
141	      name: 'account-registration',
142	      plugin: registrationPlugin,
143	      config: { activationSigningKeyPem: config.keys.activationSigningKeyPem },
144	    },
145	    { name: 'governance-center-ops', plugin: governanceCenterOpsPlugin, config: ops },
146	    { name: 'governance-center-entry', plugin: governanceCenterEntryPlugin, config: entry },

1	# Linux service templates
2	
3	These files are installation templates, not an installer. Replace the Node and artifact paths, service user/group, data directory, environment-file path and socket directory together before installing. The packaged Node requirement is 24.21.0. macOS can run the same host commands directly; these units require Linux systemd.
4	
5	Create the dedicated non-root service account and its private data directory (`0700`). Keep code releases outside the data directory. Generate deployment keys once as that account, supply the TLS certificate/key and configure the variables listed in the artifact README. The environment file must be `0600`; all secret files must be readable by the service account and inaccessible to other users. For these templates set `OMNE_TENANCY_OPS_SOCKET_DIR=/run/omne-tenancy`. systemd creates this private runtime directory. `OMNE_TENANCY_BACKUP_DIR` is optional; its default is the canonical database filename plus `.backups`. An explicitly selected backup directory needs an existing parent.
6	
7	Before installation, validate the edited files on the target machine:
8	
9	```sh
10	systemd-analyze verify omne-tenancy.service omne-tenancy-backup.service omne-tenancy-backup.timer
11	```
12	
13	Install the three edited units in `/etc/systemd/system`, then run these administrative commands:
14	
15	```sh
16	systemctl daemon-reload
17	systemctl enable --now omne-tenancy.service
18	systemctl enable --now omne-tenancy-backup.timer
19	systemctl status omne-tenancy.service
20	journalctl -u omne-tenancy.service -u omne-tenancy-backup.service
21	```
22	
23	Run the following commands as the service account, replacing executable paths consistently:
24	
25	```sh
26	/opt/node-v24.21.0/bin/node /opt/omne-tenancy/current/app/dist/cli.js ops --socket-dir /run/omne-tenancy full-health
27	/opt/node-v24.21.0/bin/node /opt/omne-tenancy/current/app/dist/cli.js ops --socket-dir /run/omne-tenancy backup --only-if-due
28	/opt/node-v24.21.0/bin/node /opt/omne-tenancy/current/app/dist/cli.js ops --socket-dir /run/omne-tenancy backup-status
29	```
30	
31	Inspect `backup-status` and the backup unit's journal daily. A timer firing is not a successful backup. The backup unit does not start a stopped center. An unsuccessful or unconfirmed invocation is recorded as a service failure; it has no automatic request retry. Keep enough free space and move completed backups to an independent protected location when available. Backups are not automatically deleted.
32	
33	For local file checking and isolated restoration, select a separate private work directory whose parent already exists, is owned by the same user and has mode `0700`. Place the restore work directory on the target filesystem. The target must be a new directory, even an existing empty directory is refused:
34	
35	```sh
36	node app/dist/cli.js verify --source /absolute/backup.omne-backup --work-dir /absolute/private/verify-work
37	node app/dist/cli.js restore-isolated --source /absolute/backup.omne-backup --target /absolute/private/new-restored --work-dir /absolute/private/restore-work
38	```
39	
40	Restoration produces `data.omne-backup` and reports `businessOpen:false`; it is not a database to pass to `serve`. Keep the isolated work roots and their `.omne-isolated` markers intact. Same-machine backups do not cover destruction of that machine or disk.
41	
42	For an upgrade, verify and extract the new artifact into a new release directory. Stop the service and wait until it is inactive before switching the `current` link. Start the service and check both public connectivity and full health. A `still-stopping` record means shutdown is still waiting; the service has no normal forced-kill deadline. Retaining old code does not authorize opening a migrated database with it. If startup fails, inspect the named failure and upgrade-snapshot location before another attempt.
43	
44	Command exit codes: `0` for a successful operation or current backup status; `2` for missing/overdue status or a declared refusal; `1` for unavailable dependencies, uncertain results, internal/cleanup or output failure; `64` for syntax. A successful full-health command means the reply was received; inspect its individual health fields.

2	import type { MigrationProvider } from 'kysely/migration'
3	import { z } from 'zod'
4	import { isAbsolute } from 'node:path'
5	import type { PreflightCheck } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'
6	import { UpgradeGuard } from './upgrade/guard.ts'
7	
8	const migrationProvider = z.custom<MigrationProvider>(
9	  value =>
10	    typeof value === 'object' &&
11	    value !== null &&
12	    typeof (value as MigrationProvider).getMigrations === 'function',
13	  'migrations must be a Kysely MigrationProvider',
14	)
15	
16	// z.custom 原样放行校验通过的值（不重建）：交给插件体的守卫就是装配手里那一个（A-1，`upgrade.guard-binding`）
17	const upgradeGuard = z.custom<UpgradeGuard>(
18	  value => value instanceof UpgradeGuard,
19	  'upgrade.guard must be created by createUpgradeGuard()',
20	)
21	
22	const preflightCheck = z.custom<PreflightCheck>(
23	  value => typeof value === 'function',
24	  'each upgrade check must be a PreflightCheck function',
25	)
26	
27	/** `{ checks, guard }` 开启升级守卫；`false` 声明不开。带 `migrations` 时必须显式给出其一。 */
28	const upgrade = z.union([
29	  z.literal(false),
30	  z.object({ checks: z.array(preflightCheck), guard: upgradeGuard }).strict(),
31	])

9:维护工作根在存储装载时准备、加排他直到实例close。进程锁复用本包私有空锁库 BEGIN IMMEDIATE/timeout0 的属主机制，路径 `<workRoot>/.owner-lock`，只是协调文件，不当业务数据库打开；连接强引用到close，死进程由OS解锁。离线 openSnapshotInspection(workRoot) 用同一实现，不得和在线共用根并行。根内临时任务名用随机128位独占目录；不自动清理其他任务残余，避免混淆进行中或故障证据。

83	  async issue(
84	    rawIdentifier: unknown,
85	    rawCredential: unknown,
86	  ): Promise<Outcome<IssuedLoginState, IssueFailure>> {
87	    const identifier = parseLoginIdentifier(rawIdentifier)
88	    if (!isOk(identifier)) return INVALID_INPUT
89	    const credentials = this.deps.resolveCredentials()
90	    if (credentials === undefined) {
91	      this.deps.diagnostics.warn('credentials-unavailable', { operation: 'issue' })
92	      return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
93	    }
94	    const presented = credentials.parse(rawCredential)
95	    if (!isOk(presented)) return INVALID_INPUT
96	    const { storage } = this.deps
97	    try {
98	      // 事务外：读快照并对它比对凭据（R-8：scrypt 不进持锁段）
99	      const snapshot = await storage.read(tx => selectAccountByIdentifier(tx, identifier.ok))
100	      if (snapshot === undefined) return IDENTIFIER_OR_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED
101	      const compared = await credentials.verify(
102	        // 材料列由 S-13 产生、S-50 替换，写进去的就是 `credentials.derive` 的返回；本包只存不读它的内部
103	        snapshot.credential_material as CredentialMaterial,

105	      )
106	      if (compared === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
107	      if (compared === 'mismatch') return IDENTIFIER_OR_CREDENTIAL_REJECTED
108	      const snapshotAccount = storedAccountId(snapshot.account_id)
109	      // match 才开写事务：重读「是快照那一行且已激活」，与签发写入同提交
110	      return await storage.write(tx =>
111	        this.#issueCommitted(
112	          tx,
113	          identifier.ok,
114	          snapshotAccount,
115	          storedRevision(snapshot.credential_revision),
116	        ),
117	      )
118	    } catch (error) {
119	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'issue', error)
120	    }
121	  }

183	  // Ordinary methods return only after their own atomic boundary has ended.
184	  async #ordinary<T>(
185	    operation: string,
186	    fn: (scope: LoginParticipation) => Promise<T>,
187	  ): Promise<T | { readonly failure: 'storage-unavailable' }> {
188	    try {
189	      return await this.deps.storage.atomic(unit => fn(this.participate(unit)))
190	    } catch (error) {
191	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, operation, error)
192	    }
193	  }

195	  exchange(presentation: unknown): Promise<Outcome<ExchangedIdentity, VerifyLoginFailure>> {

210	  participate(unit: StorageUnit): LoginParticipation {
211	    const invoke = <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
212	      unit.assertStorage(this.deps.storage)
213	      return unit.run(fn)
214	    }
215	    return {
216	      exchange: presentation =>
217	        invoke(async () => {
218	          const parsed = parseLoginStatePresentation(presentation)
219	          if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
220	          const loginStateId = deriveLoginStateId(parsed.ok)
221	          const judged = await unit.query(tx => judgeLoginState(tx, loginStateId, this.deps.clock))
222	          return 'failure' in judged ? judged : succeed({ loginStateId, accountId: judged.ok })
223	        }),
224	      verify: id =>
225	        invoke(async () => {
226	          const parsed = parseLoginStateId(id)
227	          return isOk(parsed)
228	            ? unit.query(tx => judgeLoginState(tx, parsed.ok, this.deps.clock))
229	            : INVALID_INPUT
230	        }),
231	      revoke: (target, initiator) =>
232	        invoke(async () => {
233	          const targetId = parseLoginStateId(target)
234	          const initiatorId = parseLoginStateId(initiator)
235	          if (!isOk(targetId) || !isOk(initiatorId)) return INVALID_INPUT
236	          const outcome = await unit.mutate(async tx => {
237	            const judged = await judgeLoginState(tx, initiatorId.ok, this.deps.clock)
238	            if ('failure' in judged) return fail('not-authorized')
239	            const db = narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
240	            const row = await db
241	              .selectFrom(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
242	              .selectAll()
243	              .where('login_state_id', '=', targetId.ok)
244	              .executeTakeFirst()
245	            if (row === undefined || storedAccountId(row.account_id) !== judged.ok)
246	              return fail('login-state-not-found')
247	            if (storedFlag(row.revoked)) return { revoked: undefined }
248	            await db
249	              .updateTable(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
250	              .set({ revoked: FLAG_TRUE })
251	              .where('login_state_id', '=', targetId.ok)
252	              .execute()
253	            return { revoked: { loginStateId: targetId.ok, accountId: judged.ok } }
254	          })
255	          if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
256	          const payload = outcome.revoked
257	          if (payload !== undefined)
258	            unit.afterCommit(() => this.deps.notifier.loginRevoked(payload))
259	          return 'ok'
260	        }),
261	      listEffective: caller =>
262	        invoke(async () => {
263	          const parsed = parseLoginStateId(caller)
264	          if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
265	          return unit.query(async tx => {
266	            // One lazily obtained instant for both caller validation and filtering.
267	            let now: ReturnType<typeof trustedNow> | undefined
268	            const clock = { now: () => (now ??= trustedNow(this.deps.clock)) }
269	            const judged = await judgeLoginState(tx, parsed.ok, clock)
270	            if ('failure' in judged) return judged
271	            const account = await selectAccountById(tx, judged.ok)
272	            if (account === undefined) throw new StorageDefect('validated account disappeared')
273	            const rows = await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
274	              .selectFrom(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
275	              .selectAll()
276	              .where('account_id', '=', judged.ok)
277	              .orderBy('issued_at')
278	              .orderBy('login_state_id')
279	              .execute()
280	            const values = rows
281	              .filter(row =>
282	                loginValidAt(row, storedRevision(account.credential_revision), clock.now()),
283	              )
284	              .map(row => ({
285	                loginStateId: storedLoginStateId(row.login_state_id),
286	                ...loginDeadlines(row),
287	              }))
288	            if (!values.some(row => row.loginStateId === parsed.ok))
289	              throw new StorageDefect('effective login list omitted its validated caller')
290	            return succeed(values)
291	          })
292	        }),
293	      finalizeActivity: caller =>
294	        invoke(async () => {
295	          const parsed = parseLoginStateId(caller)
296	          if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
297	          const now = trustedNow(this.deps.clock)
298	          await unit.mutate(async tx => {
299	            const judged = await judgeLoginState(tx, parsed.ok, { now: () => now })
300	            if ('failure' in judged) return
301	            await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
302	              .updateTable(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
303	              .set({ last_activity_at: now })
304	              .where('login_state_id', '=', parsed.ok)
305	              .execute()
306	          })
307	          return 'ok'
308	        }),
309	      commitCredentialChange: ticket =>
310	        invoke(async () => {
311	          const prepared = this.#prepared.get(ticket)
312	          if (prepared === undefined)
313	            throw new StorageDefect('invalid or consumed credential preparation')
314	          this.#prepared.delete(ticket)
315	          return unit.mutate(async tx => {
316	            const account = await selectAccountById(tx, prepared.accountId)
317	            if (
318	              account === undefined ||
319	              storedRevision(account.credential_revision) !== prepared.revision
320	            )
321	              return fail('current-credential-rejected')
322	            const judged = await judgeLoginState(tx, prepared.caller, this.deps.clock)
323	            if ('failure' in judged) return judged
324	            if (judged.ok !== prepared.accountId)
325	              throw new StorageDefect('credential preparation account changed')
326	            if (prepared.revision === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
327	              throw new StorageUnavailable('credential revision overflow')
328	            await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
329	              .updateTable(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
330	              .set({
331	                credential_material: prepared.material,
332	                credential_revision: prepared.revision + 1,
333	              })
334	              .where('account_id', '=', prepared.accountId)
335	              .execute()
336	            return 'ok'
337	          })
338	        }),
339	    }
340	  }
341	
342	  async prepareCredentialChange(
343	    caller: LoginStateId,
344	    current: unknown,
345	    next: unknown,
346	  ): Promise<PrepareCredentialResult> {
347	    const parsed = parseLoginStateId(caller)
348	    if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
349	    const credentials = this.deps.resolveCredentials()
350	    if (credentials === undefined) return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
351	    const oldCredential = credentials.parse(current)
352	    const newCredential = credentials.parse(next)
353	    if (!isOk(oldCredential) || !isOk(newCredential)) return INVALID_INPUT
354	    try {
355	      const snapshot = await this.deps.storage.atomic(unit =>
356	        unit.query(async tx => {
357	          const judged = await judgeLoginState(tx, parsed.ok, this.deps.clock)
358	          if ('failure' in judged) return judged
359	          const row = await selectAccountById(tx, judged.ok)
360	          if (row === undefined) throw new StorageDefect('validated account disappeared')
361	          return succeed(row)
362	        }),
363	      )
364	      if ('failure' in snapshot) return snapshot
365	      const compared = await credentials.verify(
366	        snapshot.ok.credential_material as CredentialMaterial,
367	        oldCredential.ok,
368	      )
369	      if (compared === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
370	      if (compared === 'mismatch') return fail('current-credential-rejected')
371	      const policy = this.deps.credentialPolicy
372	      if (policy === undefined || credentials.checkPolicy(policy, newCredential.ok) !== 'ok')
373	        return fail('credential-rejected')
374	      const material = await credentials.derive(newCredential.ok)
375	      if (material === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
376	      const ticket = Object.freeze({}) as PreparedCredentialChange
377	      this.#prepared.set(ticket, {
378	        accountId: storedAccountId(snapshot.ok.account_id),
379	        caller: parsed.ok,
380	        revision: storedRevision(snapshot.ok.credential_revision),
381	        material,
382	      })
383	      return succeed(ticket)
384	    } catch (error) {
385	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'prepareCredentialChange', error)
386	    }
387	  }
388	
389	  async changeCredential(
390	    caller: LoginStateId,
391	    current: unknown,
392	    next: unknown,
393	  ): Promise<Ack<ChangeCredentialFailure>> {
394	    const prepared = await this.prepareCredentialChange(caller, current, next)
395	    if ('failure' in prepared) return prepared
396	    try {
397	      return await this.#ordinary('changeCredential', scope =>
398	        scope.commitCredentialChange(prepared.ok),
399	      )
400	    } finally {
401	      this.#prepared.delete(prepared.ok)
402	    }
403	  }
404	}

87	    } catch (error) {
88	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'produce', error)
89	    }
90	  }
91	
92	  async #produceOnce(
93	    identifier: LoginIdentifier,
94	    credentials: CredentialsService,
95	    presented: PresentedCredential,
96	  ): Promise<ProduceResult | 'retry'> {
97	    const { storage, clock } = this.deps
98	    // ② 快照：分四类；凭据计算只对快照做，不进写事务（R-8）
99	    const snapshot = classifyAccount(
100	      await storage.read(tx => selectAccountByIdentifier(tx, identifier)),
101	      clock,
102	    )
103	    if (snapshot === 'clock-unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
104	    let reclaim = false
105	    if (snapshot.kind === 'live') {
106	      const compared = await credentials.verify(snapshot.material, presented)
107	      if (compared === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
108	      reclaim = compared === 'match'
109	    }
110	    let material: CredentialMaterial | undefined
111	    if (!reclaim) {
112	      // 认回那一路不判政策；其余路径政策先于占用判定
113	      const policy = this.#checkPolicy(credentials, presented)
114	      if (policy !== 'ok') return policy
115	      if (snapshot.kind === 'none') {
116	        const derived = await credentials.derive(presented)
117	        if (derived === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
118	        material = derived
119	      }
120	    }
121	    // ③ 一次写事务：锁定读，与快照是同一行、同一类才按类收场；否则不写、重来
122	    return storage.write(async tx => {
123	      await tx.lockRow(ACCOUNT_TABLE, { login_identifier: identifier })
124	      const current = classifyAccount(await selectAccountByIdentifier(tx, identifier), clock)
125	      if (current === 'clock-unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
126	      if (!sameOccupancy(snapshot, current)) return 'retry'
127	      switch (current.kind) {
128	        case 'none':
129	          return this.#insertAccount(tx, identifier, material)
130	        case 'activated':
131	          return IDENTIFIER_TAKEN
132	        case 'expired':
133	          if (!current.landed && current.observedAt !== undefined)
134	            await landExpiry(tx, current.accountId, current.observedAt)
135	          return {
136	            failure: 'identifier-held-by-expired-record',
137	            expiredRecord: current.accountId,
138	          } as const
139	        case 'live':
140	          return reclaim ? succeed(current.accountId) : IDENTIFIER_TAKEN
141	      }
142	    })
143	  }
144	
145	  async #insertAccount(
146	    tx: WriteTx,
147	    identifier: LoginIdentifier,
148	    material: CredentialMaterial | undefined,
149	  ): Promise<ProduceResult | 'retry'> {
150	    // 快照为「无」时一定已经派生过材料；到这里还没有是本包的缺陷
151	    if (material === undefined) throw defect('produce: no derived material on the insert path')
152	    const producedAt = this.deps.clock.now()
153	    if (producedAt === 'unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
154	    const accountId = newAccountId()
155	    try {
156	      await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
157	        .insertInto(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
158	        .values({
159	          account_id: accountId,
160	          login_identifier: identifier,
161	          credential_material: material,
162	          credential_revision: 0,
163	          activated: FLAG_FALSE,
164	          produced_at: producedAt,
165	          retention_deadline: addDuration(producedAt, this.deps.unactivatedRetention),
166	          expired_at: null,
167	        })
168	        .execute()
169	    } catch (error) {
170	      if (error instanceof UniqueViolation) {
171	        // 同一标识在快照之后被另一次提交占用：本事务不写，从快照重来
172	        if (error.constraint === ACCOUNT_LOGIN_IDENTIFIER_UNIQUE) return 'retry'
173	        if (error.constraint === ACCOUNT_PKEY) {
174	          this.deps.diagnostics.error('account-id-collision', {})
175	          return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
176	        }
177	      }
178	      throw error
179	    }
180	    return succeed(accountId)
181	  }

183	  #checkPolicy(
184	    credentials: CredentialsService,
185	    presented: PresentedCredential,
186	  ): 'ok' | { readonly failure: 'credential-rejected'; readonly reason: string } {
187	    const policy = this.deps.credentialPolicy
188	    // 取不到（缺省或形状不合）⇒ credential-rejected，不退化为不校验（S-27）
189	    if (policy === undefined) {
190	      this.deps.diagnostics.warn('credential-policy-unavailable', { cause: 'absent' })
191	      return { failure: 'credential-rejected', reason: POLICY_UNAVAILABLE_REASON }
192	    }
193	    const checked = credentials.checkPolicy(policy, presented)
194	    if (checked === 'ok') return 'ok'
195	    if (checked === 'unavailable') {
196	      this.deps.diagnostics.warn('credential-policy-unavailable', { cause: 'malformed' })
197	      return { failure: 'credential-rejected', reason: POLICY_UNAVAILABLE_REASON }
198	    }
199	    return { failure: 'credential-rejected', reason: checked.rejected }
200	  }

202	  // ---- S-14 ----
203	
204	  async activate(rawAccountId: unknown, warrant: unknown): Promise<Ack<ActivateFailure>> {
205	    const parsed = parseAccountId(rawAccountId)
206	    if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
207	    const accountId = parsed.ok
208	    const { storage, clock, activationKey } = this.deps
209	    try {
210	      const outcome = await storage.write(
211	        async (
212	          tx,
213	        ): Promise<{ readonly failure: ActivateFailure } | { readonly changed: boolean }> => {
214	          await tx.lockRow(ACCOUNT_TABLE, { account_id: accountId })
215	          const row = await selectAccountById(tx, accountId)
216	          // 次序：表示层 → 存在性 → 依据核验 → 状态判定；依据先于状态，坏掉的依据链不被「反正过期了」盖掉
217	          if (row === undefined) return fail('account-not-found')
218	          if (verifyHandoffWarrant(activationKey, 'activation', accountId, warrant) !== 'ok')
219	            return fail('warrant-invalid')
220	          if (storedFlag(row.activated)) return { changed: false }
221	          const expiry = await settleExpiry(tx, row, clock)
222	          if (expiry === 'clock-unavailable') return fail('storage-unavailable')
223	          if (expiry === 'expired') return fail('account-record-expired')
224	          await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
225	            .updateTable(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
226	            .set({ activated: FLAG_TRUE })
227	            .where('account_id', '=', accountId)
228	            .execute()
229	          return { changed: true }
230	        },
231	      )
232	      if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
233	      if (outcome.changed) this.deps.notifier.accountActivated({ accountId })
234	      return 'ok'
235	    } catch (error) {
236	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'activate', error)
237	    }
238	  }
239	
240	  // ---- S-18 ----
241	
242	  async read(rawAccountId: unknown): Promise<Outcome<AccountReading, ReadFailure>> {
243	    try {
244	      return await this.deps.storage.atomic(unit => this.participate(unit).read(rawAccountId))
245	    } catch (error) {
246	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'read', error)
247	    }
248	  }
249	
250	  participate(unit: StorageUnit): import('./surface.ts').AccountParticipation {
251	    const invoke = <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> => {
252	      unit.assertStorage(this.deps.storage)
253	      return unit.run(fn)
254	    }
255	    return {
256	      read: raw =>
257	        invoke(async () => {
258	          const parsed = parseAccountId(raw)
259	          if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
260	          return unit.mutate(async tx => {
261	            const row = await selectAccountById(tx, parsed.ok)
262	            if (row === undefined) return fail('account-not-found')
263	            if (storedFlag(row.activated)) return succeed(ACTIVATED_READING)
264	            const expiry = await settleExpiry(tx, row, this.deps.clock)
265	            if (expiry === 'clock-unavailable') return STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE
266	            return succeed(expiry === 'expired' ? EXPIRED_READING : UNEXPIRED_READING)
267	          })
268	        }),
269	      resolveActivatedIdentifier: raw =>
270	        invoke(async () => {
271	          const parsed = parseLoginIdentifier(raw)
272	          if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
273	          return unit.query(async tx => {
274	            const row = await selectAccountByIdentifier(tx, parsed.ok)
275	            return row !== undefined && storedFlag(row.activated)
276	              ? succeed(storedAccountId(row.account_id))
277	              : fail('account-not-found')
278	          })
279	        }),
280	    }
281	  }
282	
283	  // ---- S-38 ----
284	
285	  async purge(rawAccountId: unknown, warrant: unknown): Promise<Ack<PurgeFailure>> {
286	    const parsed = parseAccountId(rawAccountId)
287	    if (!isOk(parsed)) return INVALID_INPUT
288	    const accountId = parsed.ok
289	    const { storage, clock, purgeKey } = this.deps
290	    try {
291	      const outcome = await storage.write(
292	        async (
293	          tx,
294	        ): Promise<
295	          { readonly failure: PurgeFailure } | { readonly deleted: LoginIdentifier | undefined }
296	        > => {
297	          await tx.lockRow(ACCOUNT_TABLE, { account_id: accountId })
298	          // 次序：表示层 → 存在性（分流，不产生失败值）→ 依据核验 → 状态判定；幂等的 ok 也要等依据通过
299	          const row = await selectAccountById(tx, accountId)
300	          if (verifyHandoffWarrant(purgeKey, 'purge', accountId, warrant) !== 'ok')
301	            return fail('purge-warrant-invalid')
302	          if (row === undefined) return { deleted: undefined }
303	          if (storedFlag(row.activated)) return fail('not-expired')
304	          const expiry = await settleExpiry(tx, row, clock)
305	          if (expiry === 'clock-unavailable') return fail('storage-unavailable')
306	          if (expiry === 'live') return fail('not-expired')
307	          try {
308	            // 删除一行即释放标识：标识就是这一行的一列，唯一约束建在它上面
309	            await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
310	              .deleteFrom(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
311	              .where('account_id', '=', accountId)
312	              .execute()
313	          } catch (error) {
314	            if (error instanceof ReferenceViolation && error.kind === 'delete-restricted') {
315	              // 还有别的表（本版：个人组织行）引用它；本包不知道也不该知道是谁。清除链按抖动型重扫
316	              this.deps.diagnostics.warn('purge-delete-restricted', {
317	                cause: describeError(error),
318	              })
319	              return fail('storage-unavailable')
320	            }
321	            throw error
322	          }
323	          return { deleted: storedLoginIdentifier(row.login_identifier) }
324	        },
325	      )
326	      if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
327	      if (outcome.deleted !== undefined)
328	        this.deps.notifier.accountExpired({ accountId, loginIdentifier: outcome.deleted })
329	      return 'ok'
330	    } catch (error) {
331	      return storageUnavailable(this.deps.diagnostics, 'purge', error)
332	    }
333	  }
334	}
335	
336	const ACTIVATED_READING: AccountReading = { activated: true, retentionExpired: false }
337	const EXPIRED_READING: AccountReading = { activated: false, retentionExpired: true }
338	const UNEXPIRED_READING: AccountReading = { activated: false, retentionExpired: false }
339	
340	function newAccountId(): AccountId {
341	  const parsed = parseAccountId(generateOpaqueIdentifier())
342	  if (!isOk(parsed)) throw defect('generated AccountId failed its own lexical check')
343	  return parsed.ok
344	}

2	// 认证换代时本插件不重跑，治理不受波及（节点设计「S-15 归本节点，credentials 作可选依赖、在调用时解析」）。
3	// 无连接池/后台任务；消费者须排空含事务外凭据准备的业务后撤除，不能以运输连接关闭代替业务静止。
4	import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
5	import { z } from 'zod'
6	import {
7	  CREDENTIALS_SERVICE,
8	  type CredentialsService,
9	} from '@omne-harness-lite/credential-verification'
10	import { isOk, loadVerificationKey } from '@omne-harness-lite/identity-values'
11	import { definePlugin, resolveOptional } from '@omne-harness-lite/kernel-basis'
12	import type { Clock, Duration } from '@omne-harness-lite/offer-expiry'
13	import type { AtomicStorage } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'
14	import { AccountsImpl } from './accounts.ts'
15	import type { ServiceDeps } from './deps.ts'
16	import { contextNotifier, loggerDiagnostics } from './diagnostics.ts'
17	import { LoginsImpl } from './logins.ts'
18	import { cryptoRandomSource } from './presentation.ts'
19	import { ACCOUNTS_SERVICE, type AccountIdentityConfig, LOGINS_SERVICE } from './surface.ts'
20	
21	const verificationKeyPem = z
22	  .string()
23	  .refine(pem => isOk(loadVerificationKey(pem)), 'not an Ed25519 public key (PEM SPKI)')
24	
25	/**
26	 * 加载时校验：`unactivatedRetention` 为正整数毫秒、两把公钥存在且是 Ed25519 公钥。
27	 * 不过 ⇒ fiber FAILED、不 provide 任何服务（basis `plugin-throw-fails-fiber`）——一份漏配的部署不半开着跑。
28	 * `credentialPolicy` 缺省不是启动失败：契约把「取不到」定为 S-13 的 `credential-rejected`。
29	 */
30	export const AccountIdentityConfigSchema: z.ZodType<AccountIdentityConfig, unknown> = z
31	  .object({
32	    // 键缺席与值为 undefined 同义：契约 S-27「缺席不是启动失败」
33	    credentialPolicy: z.unknown().optional(),
34	    unactivatedRetention: z
35	      .number()
36	      .int()
37	      .positive()
38	      .max(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
39	      .transform(ms => ms as Duration),
40	    activationVerificationKeyPem: verificationKeyPem,
41	    purgeVerificationKeyPem: verificationKeyPem,
42	  })
43	  .strict()
44	
45	export const accountIdentityPlugin = definePlugin<AccountIdentityConfig>({
46	  name: 'account-identity',
47	  inject: ['storage', 'clock'],
48	  Config: AccountIdentityConfigSchema,
49	  apply(ctx: Context, config) {
50	    const activationKey = loadVerificationKey(config.activationVerificationKeyPem)
51	    const purgeKey = loadVerificationKey(config.purgeVerificationKeyPem)
52	    if (!isOk(activationKey) || !isOk(purgeKey)) {
53	      // config 校验已挡住；到这里说明校验与装载不一致，按启动失败处理
54	      throw new Error('account-identity: verification keys failed to load after validation')
55	    }
56	    const storage = ctx.get('storage') as AtomicStorage
57	    if (typeof storage.atomic !== 'function')
58	      throw new Error('account-identity: explicit atomic storage is required')
59	    const diagnostics = loggerDiagnostics(ctx.logger('account-identity'))
60	    const deps: ServiceDeps = {
61	      storage,
62	      clock: ctx.get('clock') as Clock,
63	      resolveCredentials: () => resolveOptional<CredentialsService>(ctx, CREDENTIALS_SERVICE),
64	      credentialPolicy: config.credentialPolicy,
65	      unactivatedRetention: config.unactivatedRetention,
66	      activationKey: activationKey.ok,
67	      purgeKey: purgeKey.ok,
68	      notifier: contextNotifier(ctx, diagnostics),
69	      diagnostics,
70	      // 插件体不传别的随机源：生产路径恒为 node:crypto
71	      random: cryptoRandomSource,
72	    }
73	    ctx.provide(ACCOUNTS_SERVICE, new AccountsImpl(deps))
74	    ctx.provide(LOGINS_SERVICE, new LoginsImpl(deps))
75	  },
76	})

1	// 记录读取与两处共用的判定：账号行的占用分类（S-13）、过期事实的首次落盘（S-13／S-14／S-18／S-38）、
2	// 登录状态的判定（S-17 与 S-44 共用同一个函数——「不是第二份判据」由此兑现）。
3	import type { CredentialMaterial } from '@omne-harness-lite/credential-verification'
4	import type { AccountId, LoginIdentifier, LoginStateId } from '@omne-harness-lite/identity-values'
5	import { type Clock, type Instant, compareInstants } from '@omne-harness-lite/offer-expiry'
6	import { StorageUnavailable, narrow, type ReadTx, type WriteTx } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'
7	import {
8	  ACCOUNT_TABLE,
9	  type AccountIdentityDb,
10	  type AccountRow,
11	  LOGIN_STATE_TABLE,
12	  storedAccountId,
13	  storedFlag,
14	  storedInstant,
15	  storedRevision,
16	  type LoginStateRow,
17	} from './schema.ts'

19	export function selectAccountByIdentifier(
20	  tx: ReadTx,
21	  identifier: LoginIdentifier,
22	): Promise<AccountRow | undefined> {
23	  return narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
24	    .selectFrom(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
25	    .selectAll()
26	    .where('login_identifier', '=', identifier)
27	    .executeTakeFirst()
28	}

30	export function selectAccountById(
31	  tx: ReadTx,
32	  accountId: AccountId,
33	): Promise<AccountRow | undefined> {
34	  return narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
35	    .selectFrom(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
36	    .selectAll()
37	    .where('account_id', '=', accountId)
38	    .executeTakeFirst()
39	}

41	/** 一条账号行在某一刻的占用类别（S-13 前置①）。 */
42	export type Occupancy =
43	  | { readonly kind: 'none' }
44	  | { readonly kind: 'activated'; readonly accountId: AccountId }
45	  /** 已过留存期限：`landed` 为假时是本次首次观测，`observedAt` 是要落盘的时刻。 */
46	  | {
47	      readonly kind: 'expired'
48	      readonly accountId: AccountId
49	      readonly landed: boolean
50	      readonly observedAt: Instant | undefined
51	    }
52	  | { readonly kind: 'live'; readonly accountId: AccountId; readonly material: CredentialMaterial }
53	
54	/** 时间源只在「未激活且尚未落盘过期事实」时才被读；读不到 ⇒ `'clock-unavailable'`，不按任何一边猜。 */
55	export function classifyAccount(
56	  row: AccountRow | undefined,
57	  clock: Clock,
58	): Occupancy | 'clock-unavailable' {
59	  if (row === undefined) return { kind: 'none' }
60	  const accountId = storedAccountId(row.account_id)
61	  if (storedFlag(row.activated)) return { kind: 'activated', accountId }
62	  if (row.expired_at !== null)
63	    return { kind: 'expired', accountId, landed: true, observedAt: undefined }
64	  const now = clock.now()
65	  if (now === 'unavailable') return 'clock-unavailable'
66	  if (compareInstants(now, storedInstant(row.retention_deadline)) > 0) {
67	    return { kind: 'expired', accountId, landed: false, observedAt: now }
68	  }
69	  // 材料列由 S-13 产生、S-50 替换，写进去的就是 `credentials.derive` 的返回；本包只存不读它的内部（SC-CV-1）
70	  return { kind: 'live', accountId, material: row.credential_material as CredentialMaterial }
71	}
72	
73	/** 快照与提交内现读是不是「同一行、同一类」（S-30 第 4 行的确认条件）。 */
74	export function sameOccupancy(a: Occupancy, b: Occupancy): boolean {
75	  if (a.kind !== b.kind) return false
76	  if (a.kind === 'none' || b.kind === 'none') return true
77	  return a.accountId === b.accountId
78	}
79	
80	export type ExpirySettlement = 'expired' | 'live' | 'clock-unavailable'
81	
82	/**
83	 * 「已过留存期限」是首次观测时落盘的单调事实：已落盘 ⇒ 不再读时钟；未落盘且此刻已过 ⇒ 在同一提交内写 `expired_at`。
84	 * 调用方须已对该行锁定读（R-3），且该行未激活（已激活的行不参与期限判定，S-18 性质 1）。
85	 */
86	export async function settleExpiry(
87	  tx: WriteTx,
88	  row: AccountRow,
89	  clock: Clock,
90	): Promise<ExpirySettlement> {
91	  if (row.expired_at !== null) return 'expired'
92	  const now = clock.now()
93	  if (now === 'unavailable') return 'clock-unavailable'
94	  if (compareInstants(now, storedInstant(row.retention_deadline)) <= 0) return 'live'
95	  await landExpiry(tx, storedAccountId(row.account_id), now)
96	  return 'expired'
97	}
98	
99	/** 落盘过期事实：只对「未激活且尚未落盘」的行生效——`activated` 与 `expired_at` 的互斥由写路径守，不由 CHECK。 */
100	export async function landExpiry(tx: WriteTx, accountId: AccountId, now: Instant): Promise<void> {
101	  await narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
102	    .updateTable(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
103	    .set({ expired_at: now })
104	    .where('account_id', '=', accountId)
105	    .where('activated', '=', 0)
106	    .where('expired_at', 'is', null)
107	    .execute()
108	}
109	
110	export const LOGIN_ABSOLUTE_MS = 28_800_000
111	export const LOGIN_IDLE_MS = 3_600_000
112	
113	export function loginDeadlines(row: LoginStateRow): {
114	  issuedAt: Instant
115	  lastActivityAt: Instant
116	  absoluteExpiresAt: Instant
117	  idleExpiresAt: Instant
118	} {
119	  const issuedAt = storedInstant(row.issued_at)
120	  const lastActivityAt = storedInstant(row.last_activity_at)
121	  const absolute = issuedAt + LOGIN_ABSOLUTE_MS
122	  const idle = lastActivityAt + LOGIN_IDLE_MS
123	  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(absolute) || !Number.isSafeInteger(idle))
124	    throw new StorageUnavailable('login deadline overflow')
125	  return {
126	    issuedAt,
127	    lastActivityAt,
128	    absoluteExpiresAt: absolute as Instant,
129	    idleExpiresAt: idle as Instant,
130	  }
131	}
132	
133	export function trustedNow(clock: Clock): Instant {
134	  const now = clock.now()
135	  if (now === 'unavailable') throw new StorageUnavailable('login clock unavailable')
136	  return now
137	}
138	
139	export function loginValidAt(row: LoginStateRow, revision: number, now: Instant): boolean {
140	  if (storedFlag(row.revoked) || storedRevision(row.credential_revision) !== revision) return false
141	  const limits = loginDeadlines(row)
142	  return now < limits.absoluteExpiresAt && now < limits.idleExpiresAt
143	}
144	
145	/** Caller holds the common transaction boundary. This function never opens a read connection. */
146	export async function judgeLoginState(
147	  tx: ReadTx,
148	  loginStateId: LoginStateId,
149	  clock: Clock,
150	): Promise<{ readonly ok: AccountId } | { readonly failure: 'login-state-rejected' }> {
151	  const db = narrow<AccountIdentityDb>(tx)
152	  const state = await db
153	    .selectFrom(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
154	    .selectAll()
155	    .where('login_state_id', '=', loginStateId)
156	    .executeTakeFirst()
157	  if (state === undefined || storedFlag(state.revoked)) return LOGIN_STATE_REJECTED
158	  const accountId = storedAccountId(state.account_id)
159	  const account = await selectAccountById(tx, accountId)
160	  if (
161	    account === undefined ||
162	    !storedFlag(account.activated) ||
163	    storedRevision(state.credential_revision) !== storedRevision(account.credential_revision)
164	  )
165	    return LOGIN_STATE_REJECTED
166	  return loginValidAt(state, storedRevision(account.credential_revision), trustedNow(clock))
167	    ? { ok: accountId }
168	    : LOGIN_STATE_REJECTED
169	}
170	
171	const LOGIN_STATE_REJECTED = { failure: 'login-state-rejected' } as const

33	/** 账号记录（S-4 的四样 + 三个存储属性）。**没有第二个 AccountId 类型的列**（S-11／S-35）。 */

99	const boundedLoginMigration: Migration = {
100	  async up(db) {
101	    // SQLite's migrator does not wrap DDL. This fragment needs its own atomic
102	    // boundary so the complete column set also entails the legacy-data update.
103	    if (!db.isTransaction) {
104	      await db.transaction().execute(tx => boundedLoginMigration.up(tx))
105	      return
106	    }
107	    // The host requires fragments to be idempotent. A completed migration must
108	    // neither add columns again nor revoke logins issued after the upgrade.
109	    const tables = await db.introspection.getTables()
110	    const present = [
111	      [ACCOUNT_TABLE, 'credential_revision'],
112	      [LOGIN_STATE_TABLE, 'credential_revision'],
113	      [LOGIN_STATE_TABLE, 'last_activity_at'],
114	    ].map(
115	      ([table, column]) =>
116	        tables.find(entry => entry.name === table)?.columns.some(entry => entry.name === column) ??
117	        false,
118	    )
119	    if (present.every(Boolean)) return
120	    if (present.some(Boolean)) throw new StorageDefect('incomplete bounded login migration')
121	    await db.schema
122	      .alterTable(ACCOUNT_TABLE)
123	      .addColumn('credential_revision', 'bigint', c => c.notNull().defaultTo(0))
124	      .execute()
125	    await db.schema
126	      .alterTable(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
127	      .addColumn('credential_revision', 'bigint', c => c.notNull().defaultTo(0))
128	      .execute()
129	    await db.schema
130	      .alterTable(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)
131	      .addColumn('last_activity_at', 'bigint', c => c.notNull().defaultTo(0))
132	      .execute()
133	    await db
134	      .updateTable(LOGIN_STATE_TABLE)

142	  { name: 'account_identity', migration: accountIdentityTables },
143	  { name: 'account_identity_bounded_logins', migration: boundedLoginMigration },

146	export function storedRevision(value: number | string): number {
147	  const revision = typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value
148	  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(revision) || revision < 0)
149	    throw new StorageDefect('stored credential revision is not a nonnegative safe integer')
150	  return revision
151	}

153	// ---- 从存储读回的值：本包自己写进去的，形状不对即存储缺陷，不是调用方的输入错误 ----
154	
155	export function storedFlag(value: StoredFlag): boolean {
156	  if (value === true || value === 1) return true
157	  if (value === false || value === 0) return false
158	  throw new StorageDefect('stored flag is neither 0 nor 1')
159	}
160	
161	export function storedInstant(value: StoredInstant): Instant {
162	  const parsed = instantFromEpochMs(typeof value === 'string' ? Number(value) : value)
163	  if (!isOk(parsed)) throw new StorageDefect('stored instant is not an integer millisecond value')
164	  return parsed.ok
165	}
166	
167	export function storedAccountId(value: string): AccountId {
168	  const parsed = parseAccountId(value)
169	  if (!isOk(parsed)) throw new StorageDefect('stored account_id is not an opaque identifier')
170	  return parsed.ok
171	}
172	
173	export function storedLoginStateId(value: string): LoginStateId {
174	  const parsed = parseLoginStateId(value)
175	  if (!isOk(parsed)) throw new StorageDefect('stored login_state_id is not an opaque identifier')
176	  return parsed.ok
177	}
178	
179	export function storedLoginIdentifier(value: string): LoginIdentifier {
180	  const parsed = parseLoginIdentifier(value)
181	  if (!isOk(parsed)) throw new StorageDefect('stored login_identifier is not an opaque identifier')
182	  return parsed.ok
183	}

185	export const FLAG_TRUE = 1
186	export const FLAG_FALSE = 0

2	import type { CredentialsService } from '@omne-harness-lite/credential-verification'
3	import type { VerificationKey } from '@omne-harness-lite/identity-values'
4	import type { Clock, Duration } from '@omne-harness-lite/offer-expiry'
5	import { StorageUnavailable, type AtomicStorage } from '@omne-harness-lite/storage'
6	import { type Diagnostics, type Notifier, describeError } from './diagnostics.ts'
7	import type { RandomSource } from './presentation.ts'
8	
9	export interface ServiceDeps {
10	  /** 必需 inject 的 `storage`。 */
11	  readonly storage: AtomicStorage
12	  /** 必需 inject 的 `clock`。 */
13	  readonly clock: Clock
14	  /** 可选依赖 `credentials`，**每次调用时解析**：缺席 ⇒ 凭据步骤判不出来（`storage-unavailable`），不是判为不合规。 */
15	  readonly resolveCredentials: () => CredentialsService | undefined
16	  /** S-26：形状不透明，原样交给 `credentials.checkPolicy`；`undefined` 即「取不到」。 */
17	  readonly credentialPolicy: unknown
18	  /** S-39：加载时已校验为正。 */
19	  readonly unactivatedRetention: Duration
20	  readonly activationKey: VerificationKey
21	  readonly purgeKey: VerificationKey
22	  readonly notifier: Notifier
23	  readonly diagnostics: Diagnostics
24	  /** 出示物的随机源；插件体不传，恒为 `node:crypto.randomBytes`。 */
25	  readonly random: RandomSource
26	}
27	
28	/**
29	 * 存储「不可用」收成契约的 `storage-unavailable` 并记一条诊断；其余异常（`StorageDefect`、本包缺陷……）原样上抛——
30	 * 没有 catch-all。唯一冲突与引用违反须在此之前由操作自己按约束名分支处理。
31	 */
32	export function storageUnavailable(
33	  diagnostics: Diagnostics,
34	  operation: string,
35	  error: unknown,
36	): { readonly failure: 'storage-unavailable' } {
37	  if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) {
38	    diagnostics.warn('storage-unavailable', { operation, cause: describeError(error) })
39	    return { failure: 'storage-unavailable' }
40	  }
41	  throw error
42	}

55	export interface Decision {

61	/** 信封恰这四个成员（S-4）。 */
62	const ENVELOPE_MEMBERS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
63	  'protocolVersion',
64	  'presentedLoginState',
65	  'operation',
66	  'payload',
67	])

69	const JSON_LIMITS = { depth: RECEIVE_LIMITS.jsonDepth, members: RECEIVE_LIMITS.objectMembers }
70	
71	function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
72	  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
73	}

75	/** 信封顶层某个成员在请求体里出现的次数（读取器只保留第一次，其余报在重复里）。 */
76	function occurrences(
77	  envelope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
78	  duplicates: readonly DuplicateMember[],
79	  name: string,
80	): number {
81	  const present = Object.hasOwn(envelope, name) ? 1 : 0
82	  return present + duplicates.filter(d => d.path.length === 0 && d.name === name).length
83	}

85	/** 路由上的一次收场：一份答复字节 + 记录里的那几格。 */
86	interface Settled {
87	  readonly bytes: Buffer
88	  readonly answer: string
89	  readonly observed?: Observed
90	  readonly defect?: true
91	}
92	
93	function entry(answer: EntryAnswer, observed?: Observed): Settled {
94	  return observed === undefined
95	    ? { bytes: entryAnswerBytes(answer), answer }
96	    : { bytes: entryAnswerBytes(answer), answer, observed }
97	}
98	
99	function defect(call: Call, value: string): Settled {
100	  return {
101	    bytes: entryAnswerBytes('unavailable'),
102	    answer: 'unavailable',
103	    observed: { call, value },
104	    defect: true,
105	  }
106	}

108	export async function decide(body: Buffer, context: DecisionContext): Promise<Decision> {
109	  const reading = readJsonText(body, JSON_LIMITS)
110	  // 超出嵌套深度或成员数上界 ⇒ 关连接不写（S-7），不是 version-mismatch
111	  if (reading.kind === 'exceeds-limit')
112	    return { bytes: undefined, record: { stage: 'version', answer: 'none' } }
113	  // 看不懂的请求答 version-mismatch：不知道它是哪一版、要办哪件事（S-7 四级、S-10 ①）
114	  if (reading.kind === 'unreadable' || !isPlainObject(reading.value)) {
115	    return finish({ stage: 'version' }, entry('version-mismatch'))
116	  }
117	  const envelope = reading.value
118	  const duplicates = reading.duplicates
119	  const count = (name: string) => occurrences(envelope, duplicates, name)
120	
121	  // 0 公开体检：恰一个 `operation` 成员且等于 S-18 的路由标识；其余成员一律不看（https-json/1 S-9）
122	  if (count('operation') === 1 && envelope['operation'] === PUBLIC_HEALTH_ROUTE) {
123	    return {
124	      bytes: context.publicHealth,
125	      record: { stage: 'public-health', answer: 'public-health' },
126	    }
127	  }
128	
129	  // ① 版本：缺席、重复、不是字符串或不被接受 ⇒ version-mismatch；出示物一眼都不看
130	  const protocolVersion = envelope['protocolVersion']
131	  if (
132	    count('protocolVersion') !== 1 ||
133	    typeof protocolVersion !== 'string' ||
134	    !ACCEPTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS.includes(protocolVersion)
135	  ) {
136	    return finish({ stage: 'version' }, entry('version-mismatch'))
137	  }
138	
139	  // ①′ 信封：`operation` 缺席、重复或不在路由表内，或有表外成员 ⇒ invalid-input（认人之前）
140	  const route = count('operation') === 1 ? routeFor(envelope['operation']) : undefined
141	  if (route === undefined || Object.keys(envelope).some(name => !ENVELOPE_MEMBERS.has(name))) {
142	    return finish({ stage: 'envelope' }, entry('invalid-input'))
143	  }
144	
145	  const payload = payloadOf(route, envelope, duplicates, count('payload'))
146	  if (route.exempt) return exempt(route, payload, context.services)
147	  // Lookup-free rejection must not depend on starting a storage transaction.
148	  const presentations = count('presentedLoginState')
149	  const rejection =
150	    presentations === 0
151	      ? 'absent'
152	      : presentations > 1
153	        ? 'multiple'
154	        : !isOk(parseLoginStatePresentation(envelope['presentedLoginState']))
155	          ? 'malformed'
156	          : undefined
157	  if (rejection !== undefined)
158	    return finish(
159	      { stage: 'authenticate', route: route.id, rejection },
160	      entry('login-state-rejected'),
161	    )
162	  if (route.credentialChange)
163	    return changeCredential(route, envelope, presentations, payload, context)
164	  return committed(context, route, services =>
165	    authenticated(route, envelope, presentations, payload, services),
166	  )
167	}

169	/** Only the boundary owner can convert a rollback into a network decision. */
170	class RequestRollback extends Error {
171	  constructor(readonly decision: Decision) {
172	    super('request must roll back')
173	    this.name = 'RequestRollback'
174	  }
175	}

177	async function committed(
178	  context: DecisionContext,
179	  route: AuthenticatedRoute,
180	  work: (services: AuthenticatedServices) => Promise<Decision>,
181	): Promise<Decision> {
182	  let rolledBack: Decision | undefined
183	  try {
184	    return await context.storage.atomic(async unit => {
185	      try {
186	        const services: AuthenticatedServices = {
187	          accounts: context.services.accounts.participate(unit),
188	          logins: context.services.logins.participate(unit),
189	          organizations: context.services.organizations.participate(unit),
190	          memberships: context.services.memberships.participate(unit),
191	          offers: context.services.offers.participate(unit),
192	        }
193	        const decision = await work(services)
194	        if (decision.record.defect || decision.record.answer === 'unavailable')
195	          throw new RequestRollback(decision)
196	        return decision
197	      } catch (error) {
198	        // A participant may have poisoned the unit with its original exception.
199	        // Keep a prior observed defect for reporting after the rollback.
200	        if (error instanceof RequestRollback) rolledBack = error.decision
201	        throw error
202	      }
203	    })
204	  } catch (error) {
205	    if (rolledBack !== undefined) return rolledBack
206	    if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable)
207	      return finish(
208	        { stage: 'operation', route: route.id },
209	        entry('unavailable', { call: 'operation', value: 'storage-unavailable' }),
210	      )
211	    return finish({ stage: 'operation', route: route.id }, defect('operation', thrownValue(error)))
212	  }
213	}

215	async function changeCredential(
216	  route: AuthenticatedRoute,
217	  envelope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
218	  presentations: number,
219	  payload: Payload | undefined,
220	  context: DecisionContext,
221	): Promise<Decision> {
222	  const at = { stage: 'authenticate' as const, route: route.id }
223	  let recognized: Authentication
224	  try {
225	    recognized = await authenticate(
226	      envelope['presentedLoginState'],
227	      presentations,
228	      context.services.logins,
229	    )
230	  } catch (error) {
231	    return finish(
232	      at,
233	      error instanceof StorageUnavailable
234	        ? entry('unavailable')
235	        : defect('authenticate', thrownValue(error)),
236	    )
237	  }
238	  switch (recognized.kind) {
239	    case 'rejected':
240	      return finish({ ...at, rejection: recognized.rejection }, entry('login-state-rejected'))
241	    case 'unavailable':
242	      return finish(at, entry('unavailable', recognized.observed))
243	    case 'defect':
244	      return finish(at, defect(recognized.observed.call, recognized.observed.value))
245	    case 'caller':
246	      break
247	  }
248	  const base = {
249	    stage: 'payload' as const,
250	    route: route.id,
251	    account: accountCorrelation(recognized.caller.accountId),
252	  }
253	  if (payload === undefined) return finish(base, entry('invalid-input'))
254	  try {
255	    if (
256	      !isParsedOk(context.services.credentials.parse(payload['currentCredential'])) ||
257	      !isParsedOk(context.services.credentials.parse(payload['newCredential']))
258	    )
259	      return finish(base, entry('invalid-input'))
260	  } catch (error) {
261	    return finish(base, defect('credentials', thrownValue(error)))
262	  }
263	  let prepared: Awaited<ReturnType<EntryServices['logins']['prepareCredentialChange']>>
264	  try {
265	    prepared = await context.services.logins.prepareCredentialChange(
266	      recognized.caller.loginStateId,
267	      payload['currentCredential'],
268	      payload['newCredential'],
269	    )
270	  } catch (error) {
271	    return finish(
272	      base,
273	      error instanceof StorageUnavailable
274	        ? entry('unavailable')
275	        : defect('operation', thrownValue(error)),
276	    )
277	  }
278	  if (!isPlainObject(prepared)) return finish(base, defect('operation', 'malformed-preparation'))
279	  if ('failure' in prepared) return finish(base, mapFailure(route, prepared.failure, payload))
280	  if (!('ok' in prepared) || !isPlainObject(prepared.ok))
281	    return finish(base, defect('operation', 'malformed-preparation'))
282	  // Final stage starts with the owner's G check, never a second exchange.
283	  return committed(context, route, services =>
284	    authenticatedCaller(route, payload, services, recognized.caller, prepared.ok),
285	  )
286	}

288	/** 载荷那一步（S-10）：`payload` 恰一个、里面任意深度没有重复成员（https-json/1 S-8）、合 `Payload_<路由>`。 */
289	function payloadOf(
290	  route: Route,
291	  envelope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
292	  duplicates: readonly DuplicateMember[],
293	  payloadCount: number,
294	): Payload | undefined {
295	  if (payloadCount !== 1) return undefined
296	  if (duplicates.some(d => d.path[0] === 'payload')) return undefined
297	  const payload = envelope['payload']
298	  if (!isPlainObject(payload)) return undefined
299	  return conformsTo(`Payload_${route.schema}`, payload) ? payload : undefined
300	}

302	/** 免认人的两条路由（S-19）：出示物带了也不看；载荷不合格 ⇒ invalid-input、从不交进去。 */
303	async function exempt(
304	  route: ExemptRoute,
305	  payload: Payload | undefined,
306	  services: EntryServices,
307	): Promise<Decision> {
308	  const base = { stage: 'payload' as const, route: route.id }
309	  if (payload === undefined || !isOk(parseLoginIdentifier(payload['loginIdentifier']))) {
310	    return finish(base, entry('invalid-input'))
311	  }
312	  // 凭据材料的表示层用凭据方案 owner 的同一条解析规则（`credentials.parse`，只调它）
313	  let parsed: unknown
314	  try {
315	    parsed = services.credentials.parse(payload['credential'])
316	  } catch (error) {
317	    return finish(base, defect('credentials', thrownValue(error)))
318	  }
319	  if (!isParsedOk(parsed)) return finish(base, entry('invalid-input'))
320	  try {
321	    const settled = await invoke(route, payload, undefined, () => route.invoke(services, payload))
322	    return finish({ stage: 'operation', route: route.id }, settled)
323	  } catch (error) {
324	    return finish(
325	      { stage: 'operation', route: route.id },
326	      error instanceof StorageUnavailable
327	        ? entry('unavailable')
328	        : defect('operation', thrownValue(error)),
329	    )
330	  }
331	}

333	function isParsedOk(parsed: unknown): boolean {

335	}

337	async function authenticated(
338	  route: AuthenticatedRoute,
339	  envelope: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
340	  presentations: number,
341	  payload: Payload | undefined,
342	  services: AuthenticatedServices,
343	): Promise<Decision> {
344	  // ② 认人
345	  const recognized = await authenticate(
346	    envelope['presentedLoginState'],
347	    presentations,
348	    services.logins,
349	  )
350	  const at = { stage: 'authenticate' as const, route: route.id }
351	  switch (recognized.kind) {
352	    case 'rejected':
353	      return finish({ ...at, rejection: recognized.rejection }, entry('login-state-rejected'))
354	    case 'unavailable':
355	      return finish(at, entry('unavailable', recognized.observed))
356	    case 'defect':
357	      return finish(at, defect(recognized.observed.call, recognized.observed.value))
358	    case 'caller':

364	async function authenticatedCaller(
365	  route: AuthenticatedRoute,
366	  payload: Payload | undefined,
367	  services: AuthenticatedServices,
368	  caller: Caller,
369	  credentialChange?: PreparedCredentialChange,
370	): Promise<Decision> {
371	  const account = accountCorrelation(caller.accountId)
372	
373	  // 载荷：认出人之后才看输入
374	  if (payload === undefined) {
375	    return finish({ stage: 'payload', route: route.id, account }, entry('invalid-input'))
376	  }
377	
378	  // 身份推导：只有要行事 TenantId 的路由才现读 OG S-36
379	  let tenant: TenantId | undefined
380	  if (route.derivesTenant(payload)) {
381	    const derivation = await deriveTenant(services, caller)
382	    if (derivation.kind !== 'tenant') {
383	      return finish({ stage: 'derive', route: route.id, account }, derivation.settled)
384	    }
385	    tenant = derivation.tenant
386	  }
387	  if (payload['expectedTenant'] !== undefined) {
388	    const expected = parseTenantId(payload['expectedTenant'])
389	    if (!isOk(expected) || tenant === undefined)
390	      return finish(
391	        { stage: 'derive', route: route.id, account },
392	        defect('derive', 'missing-expected-identity'),
393	      )
394	    if (!tenantIdEquals(expected.ok, tenant))
395	      return finish(
396	        { stage: 'derive', route: route.id, account },
397	        {
398	          bytes: routeFailureBytes('expectedTenantMismatch'),
399	          answer: 'failure:expectedTenantMismatch',
400	        },
401	      )
402	  }
403	  if (route.requiresSuperAdministrator) {
404	    if (tenant === undefined)
405	      return finish({ stage: 'gate', route: route.id, account }, defect('gate', 'missing-tenant'))
406	    const standing = await services.memberships.standing(tenant)
407	    if ('failure' in standing) {
408	      return finish(
409	        { stage: 'gate', route: route.id, account },
410	        standing.failure === 'unavailable'
411	          ? entry('unavailable')
412	          : defect('gate', 'invalid-standing'),
413	      )
414	    }
415	    const parsed = parseMembershipStanding(standing)
416	    if (!isOk(parsed))
417	      return finish(
418	        { stage: 'gate', route: route.id, account },
419	        defect('gate', 'malformed-standing'),
420	      )
421	    if (parsed.ok.standing !== 'effective' || parsed.ok.role !== 'superAdministrator')
422	      return finish(
423	        { stage: 'gate', route: route.id, account },
424	        { bytes: routeFailureBytes('notAuthorized'), answer: 'failure:notAuthorized' },
425	      )
426	  }
427	  const identities =
428	    tenant === undefined ? { account } : { account, tenant: tenantCorrelation(tenant) }
429	
430	  // 补授权：只对四条读路由，全部读完、不短路
431	  if (route.gate !== undefined) {
432	    let organizations: readonly unknown[]
433	    try {
434	      organizations = route.gate(payload)
435	    } catch (error) {
436	      return finish(
437	        { stage: 'gate', route: route.id, ...identities },
438	        defect('gate', thrownValue(error)),
439	      )
440	    }
441	    const verdict = await gate(services, caller, organizations)
442	    if (verdict !== undefined) {
443	      return finish({ stage: 'gate', route: route.id, ...identities }, verdict)
444	    }
445	  }
446	
447	  // ③ 办事
448	  const input = {
449	    payload,
450	    caller,
451	    tenant,
452	    ...(credentialChange === undefined ? {} : { credentialChange }),
453	  }
454	  const settled = await invoke(route, payload, caller, () => route.invoke(services, input))
455	  if (settled.answer === 'result') {
456	    const finalized = await services.logins.finalizeActivity(caller.loginStateId)
457	    if (finalized !== 'ok')
458	      return finish(
459	        { stage: 'operation', route: route.id, ...identities },
460	        defect('operation', 'activity-finalization-invalid'),
461	      )
462	  }
463	  return finish({ stage: 'operation', route: route.id, ...identities }, settled)
464	}

466	type Derivation =
467	  | { readonly kind: 'tenant'; readonly tenant: TenantId }
468	  | { readonly kind: 'settled'; readonly settled: Settled }

470	/** S-12：现读 OG S-36，参数是认人所得 `LoginStateId`。 */
471	async function deriveTenant(services: AuthenticatedServices, caller: Caller): Promise<Derivation> {
472	  let reply: unknown
473	  try {
474	    reply = await services.memberships.currentTenant(caller.loginStateId)
475	  } catch (error) {
476	    if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) throw error
477	    return { kind: 'settled', settled: defect('derive', thrownValue(error)) }
478	  }
479	  const normalized = normalize('outcome', reply)
480	  if (normalized.kind === 'malformed') {
481	    return { kind: 'settled', settled: defect('derive', 'outside-failure-set') }
482	  }
483	  if (normalized.kind === 'failure') {
484	    switch (normalized.name) {
485	      // 其间被撤销（S-33）：与在第 ② 步被拒逐字相同
486	      case 'loginStateNotValid':
487	        return { kind: 'settled', settled: entry('login-state-rejected') }
488	      case 'unavailable':
489	        return {
490	          kind: 'settled',
491	          settled: entry('unavailable', { call: 'derive', value: normalized.name }),
492	        }
493	      default:
494	        // `invalidInput` 本版到不了：交进去的是认人所得，错不在来者
495	        return { kind: 'settled', settled: defect('derive', normalized.name) }
496	    }
497	  }
498	  const tenant = parseTenantId(normalized.value)
499	  if (!isOk(tenant)) return { kind: 'settled', settled: defect('derive', 'malformed-tenant') }
500	  // 矛盾清单 ③：返回的 TenantId 的 account 分量不等于认人所得 AccountId
501	  if (tenant.ok.account !== caller.accountId) {
502	    return { kind: 'settled', settled: defect('derive', 'account-mismatch') }
503	  }
504	  return { kind: 'tenant', tenant: tenant.ok }
505	}

507	/**
508	 * S-13 补授权：对每个组织现读 OG S-26（(该组织, 认人所得 AccountId)），逐个 await、全部读完，
509	 * 按合成表行序取第一条成立的：任一缺陷 ⇒ 缺陷；任一判不了 ⇒ unavailable（哪怕另一个已读出无效）；
510	 * 任一无效 ⇒ `notAuthorized`、不调被投影的操作；全部有效 ⇒ 过（`undefined`）。
511	 */
512	async function gate(
513	  services: AuthenticatedServices,
514	  caller: Caller,
515	  organizations: readonly unknown[],
516	): Promise<Settled | undefined> {
517	  const verdicts: ('defect' | 'unavailable' | 'ineffective' | 'effective')[] = []
518	  let observedDefect: string | undefined
519	  for (const organization of organizations) {
520	    let reply: unknown
521	    try {
522	      reply = await services.memberships.standing({ organization, account: caller.accountId })
523	    } catch (error) {
524	      if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) {
525	        if (observedDefect !== undefined) return defect('gate', observedDefect)
526	        throw error
527	      }
528	      // An escaping participant exception poisons this unit; no further reads.
529	      return defect('gate', observedDefect ?? thrownValue(error))
530	    }
531	    const verdict = standingVerdict(reply)
532	    verdicts.push(verdict)
533	    if (verdict === 'defect') observedDefect ??= 'outside-failure-set'
534	  }
535	  if (verdicts.includes('defect')) return defect('gate', observedDefect ?? 'outside-failure-set')
536	  if (verdicts.includes('unavailable'))
537	    return entry('unavailable', { call: 'gate', value: 'unavailable' })
538	  if (verdicts.includes('ineffective'))
539	    return { bytes: routeFailureBytes('notAuthorized'), answer: 'failure:notAuthorized' }
540	  return undefined
541	}
542	
543	function standingVerdict(reply: unknown): 'defect' | 'unavailable' | 'ineffective' | 'effective' {
544	  if (isPlainObject(reply) && Object.hasOwn(reply, 'failure')) {
545	    // `invalidInput`：交进去的组织已按 IV 的形状核过，领域仍判它不合形状，错不在来者
546	    return reply['failure'] === 'unavailable' && Object.keys(reply).length === 1
547	      ? 'unavailable'
548	      : 'defect'
549	  }
550	  const standing = parseMembershipStanding(reply)
551	  if (!isOk(standing)) return 'defect'
552	  return standing.ok.standing
553	}
554	
555	type Normalized =
556	  | { readonly kind: 'ok'; readonly value: unknown }
557	  | { readonly kind: 'failure'; readonly name: string }
558	  | { readonly kind: 'malformed' }
559	
560	/** 把参与方的返回按它的约定归成「成功值／具名失败／集合外」；返回了却没有值也是集合外。 */
561	function normalize(shape: ReplyShape, reply: unknown): Normalized {
562	  switch (shape) {
563	    case 'terminal':
564	      if (typeof reply !== 'string') return { kind: 'malformed' }
565	      return reply === 'registered'
566	        ? { kind: 'ok', value: reply }
567	        : { kind: 'failure', name: reply }
568	    case 'ack':
569	      if (reply === 'ok') return { kind: 'ok', value: reply }
570	      return failureOf(reply)
571	    case 'standing':
572	      if (isPlainObject(reply) && Object.hasOwn(reply, 'standing'))
573	        return { kind: 'ok', value: reply }
574	      return failureOf(reply)
575	    case 'outcome':
576	      if (isPlainObject(reply) && Object.hasOwn(reply, 'ok'))
577	        return { kind: 'ok', value: reply['ok'] }
578	      return failureOf(reply)
579	  }
580	}
581	
582	function failureOf(reply: unknown): Normalized {
583	  if (isPlainObject(reply) && typeof reply['failure'] === 'string') {
584	    return { kind: 'failure', name: reply['failure'] }
585	  }
586	  return { kind: 'malformed' }
587	}
588	
589	/** ③：调被投影的那一个领域操作，按 S-14 映射它的答复。 */
590	async function invoke(
591	  route: Route,
592	  payload: Payload,
593	  caller: Caller | undefined,
594	  call: () => Promise<unknown> | unknown,
595	): Promise<Settled> {
596	  let reply: unknown
597	  try {
598	    reply = await call()
599	  } catch (error) {
600	    if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) throw error
601	    return defect('operation', thrownValue(error))
602	  }
603	  const normalized = normalize(route.reply, reply)
604	  if (normalized.kind === 'malformed') return defect('operation', 'outside-failure-set')
605	  if (normalized.kind === 'failure') return mapFailure(route, normalized.name, payload)
606	  let wire: unknown
607	  try {
608	    wire = route.toWire(normalized.value, payload)
609	    // 矛盾清单 ③（只 OG S-36 一条路由有）
610	    if (
611	      !route.exempt &&
612	      caller !== undefined &&
613	      route.contradicts?.(normalized.value, caller) === true
614	    ) {
615	      return defect('operation', 'account-mismatch')
616	    }
617	  } catch {
618	    return defect('operation', 'result-contradicts-schema')
619	  }
620	  // 矛盾清单 ①：成功返回不合 `Result_<路由>`（含 OG S-27、AI S-37 的空列表——那两条 Schema 要求至少一项）
621	  if (!conformsTo(`Result_${route.schema}`, wire))
622	    return defect('operation', 'result-contradicts-schema')
623	  return { bytes: routeSuccessBytes(wire), answer: 'result' }
624	}
625	
626	function mapFailure(route: Route, name: string, payload: Payload): Settled {
627	  const table = route.failures
628	  if (table.pass.includes(name))
629	    return { bytes: routeFailureBytes(name), answer: `failure:${name}` }
630	  if (table.rejected?.includes(name) === true) return entry('login-state-rejected')
631	  if (table.unavailable?.includes(name) === true) {
632	    return entry('unavailable', { call: 'operation', value: name })
633	  }
634	  if (table.representation?.includes(name) === true) {
635	    // 交给领域的输入里有来自载荷的项 ⇒ invalid-input；全是入口层产出的值 ⇒ 错不在来者，缺陷
636	    return Object.keys(payload).some(key => key !== 'expectedTenant')
637	      ? entry('invalid-input')
638	      : defect('operation', name)
639	  }
640	  // 结构上到不了的具名值，以及失败集合之外的任何名字
641	  return defect(
642	    'operation',
643	    table.unreachable?.includes(name) === true ? name : 'outside-failure-set',
644	  )
645	}
646	
647	function finish(
648	  base: Omit<RequestRecord, 'answer' | 'observed' | 'defect'>,
649	  settled: Settled,
650	): Decision {
651	  const record: RequestRecord = {
652	    ...base,
653	    answer: settled.answer,
654	    ...(settled.observed === undefined ? {} : { observed: settled.observed }),
655	    ...(settled.defect === true ? { defect: true } : {}),
656	  }
657	  return { bytes: settled.bytes, record }
658	}

141	// ---- 投影：领域值 → 线上值（S-12：成员按管它的定义的书写次序） ----
142	
143	function record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> {
144	  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) {
145	    throw new TypeError('expected an object')
146	  }
147	  return value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>
148	}
149	
150	function list(value: unknown): readonly unknown[] {
151	  if (!Array.isArray(value)) throw new TypeError('expected an array')
152	  return value
153	}
154	
155	function instant(value: unknown): string {
156	  if (typeof value !== 'number') throw new TypeError('expected an instant')
157	  return formatInstant(value)
158	}
159	
160	/** IV `TenantId`：organization、account。 */
161	function tenantWire(value: unknown): unknown {
162	  const tenant = record(value)
163	  return { organization: tenant['organization'], account: tenant['account'] }
164	}
165	
166	/** IV `MembershipStanding` 两支。 */
167	function standingWire(value: unknown): unknown {
168	  const standing = record(value)
169	  if (standing['standing'] === 'effective') return { standing: 'effective', role: standing['role'] }
170	  if (standing['standing'] === 'ineffective') return { standing: 'ineffective' }
171	  throw new TypeError('expected a membership standing')
172	}
173	
174	/** IV `ScopeLayerIdentity` 两支。 */
175	function scopeLayerWire(value: unknown): unknown {
176	  const layer = record(value)
177	  if (layer['layer'] === 'organization') {
178	    return { layer: 'organization', organization: layer['organization'] }
179	  }
180	  if (layer['layer'] === 'tenant') return { layer: 'tenant', tenant: tenantWire(layer['tenant']) }
181	  throw new TypeError('expected a scope layer identity')
182	}
183	
184	/** OE `OfferTiming`：issuedAt、expiresAt。 */
185	function timingWire(value: unknown): unknown {
186	  const timing = record(value)
187	  return { issuedAt: instant(timing['issuedAt']), expiresAt: instant(timing['expiresAt']) }
188	}
189	
190	/** `OrganizationView`：「无上级」⇒ `parentOrganization` 不出现。 */
191	function organizationWire(value: unknown): unknown {
192	  const organization = record(value)
193	  const parent = organization['parent']
194	  if (parent === undefined) throw new TypeError('expected parent or null')
195	  return parent === null
196	    ? { organization: organization['id'], organizationKind: organization['kind'] }
197	    : {
198	        organization: organization['id'],
199	        organizationKind: organization['kind'],
200	        parentOrganization: parent,
201	      }
202	}
203	
204	/** `InvitationView`。 */
205	function invitationWire(value: unknown): unknown {
206	  const invitation = record(value)
207	  return {
208	    invitation: invitation['id'],
209	    issuerOrganization: invitation['issuer'],
210	    invitedAccount: invitation['invitedAccount'],
211	    role: invitation['role'],
212	    offerTiming: timingWire(invitation['timing']),
213	    offerState: invitation['state'],
214	  }
215	}

221	    affiliationRequest: request['id'],

223	    recipientOrganization: request['recipient'],

74	/** 等钟可读时的轮询间隔。 */
75	const CLOCK_POLL_MS = 100
76	
77	function readClock(clock: Clock): Instant | undefined {
78	  try {
79	    const now = clock.now()
80	    return now !== 'unavailable' && Number.isSafeInteger(now) ? now : undefined
81	  } catch {
82	    return undefined
83	  }
84	}

86	/** 本 fiber 已被撤除（插件体执行期间状态是 LOADING，所以看 uid，不看 ACTIVE）。 */
87	function fiberDisposed(ctx: Context): boolean {
88	  return ctx.fiber.uid === null
89	}
90	
91	/**
92	 * 插件体里等钟可读（启动成功以钟可读为条件，S-34）：按间隔轮询，上界 `timeoutMs`；
93	 * 等待期间本 fiber 被撤 ⇒ 清掉定时器、停止（不抛出）。
94	 */
95	function waitForClock(
96	  ctx: Context,
97	  clock: Clock,
98	  timeoutMs: number,
99	): Promise<Instant | 'timeout' | 'disposed'> {
100	  return new Promise(resolve => {
101	    let tick: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined
102	    const deadline = setTimeout(() => {
103	      clearTimeout(tick)
104	      resolve('timeout')
105	    }, timeoutMs)
106	    const attempt = () => {
107	      if (fiberDisposed(ctx)) {
108	        clearTimeout(deadline)
109	        resolve('disposed')
110	        return
111	      }
112	      const now = readClock(clock)
113	      if (now !== undefined) {
114	        clearTimeout(deadline)
115	        resolve(now)
116	        return
117	      }
118	      tick = setTimeout(attempt, CLOCK_POLL_MS)
119	    }
120	    attempt()
121	  })
122	}

171	    this.#centerId = centerId
172	    this.#version = config.version
173	    this.#clockReadyTimeoutMs = config.clockReadyTimeoutMs
174	  }
175	
176	  /** 四条通知都是 emit：处理者抛出只记 error，不改变入口层的行为（basis `emit-listener-throw-propagates`）。 */
177	  #notify(emitting: () => void, name: string): void {
178	    try {
179	      emitting()
180	    } catch (error) {
181	      this.#logger.error('a listener of %s threw %s', name, thrownValue(error))
182	    }
183	  }
184	
185	  #servingNotice(startedAt: Instant): ServingNotice {
186	    return { centerId: this.#centerId, version: this.#version, startedAt }
187	  }
188	
189	  /** `openSignal` 兑现：读钟 → emit serving → 开闸。读不到按同一间隔轮询，上界 `clockReadyTimeoutMs`。 */
190	  startOpening(): void {
191	    if (this.#disposing || this.#face.gate !== 'closed' || this.#openDeadline !== undefined) return
192	    this.#openDeadline = setTimeout(() => this.#abandonOpening(), this.#clockReadyTimeoutMs)
193	    this.#tryOpen()
194	  }
195	
196	  #tryOpen(): void {
197	    this.#openTick = undefined
198	    // 每一拍先核：本 fiber 已撤或闸已不是 closed ⇒ 停止，不开门、不发通知
199	    if (this.#disposing || fiberDisposed(this.#ctx) || this.#face.gate !== 'closed') {
200	      this.#stopOpening()
201	      return
202	    }
203	    // 重跑时 openSignal 早已兑现，续延可能先于 fiber 进入 ACTIVE：等它就绪再开
204	    const now = fiberIsActive(this.#ctx) ? readClock(this.#clock) : undefined
205	    if (now === undefined) {
206	      this.#openTick = setTimeout(() => this.#tryOpen(), CLOCK_POLL_MS)
207	      return
208	    }
209	    this.#stopOpening()
210	    this.#startedAt = now
211	    const notice = this.#servingNotice(now)
212	    this.#notify(() => this.#ctx.emit(serving, notice), serving)
213	    this.#face.open()
214	  }
215	
216	  /** 开门那一刻钟超界读不到：闸 closed → retired、释放端口、记一条原因为钟的 error，不发任何通知（N-12）。 */
217	  #abandonOpening(): void {
218	    this.#openDeadline = undefined
219	    if (this.#openTick !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.#openTick)
220	    this.#openTick = undefined
221	    if (this.#disposing || this.#face.gate !== 'closed') return
222	    this.#logger.error(
223	      'the center did not open: the clock could not be read within clockReadyTimeoutMs (cause: clock)',
224	    )
225	    this.#face.retire().catch((error: unknown) => {
226	      this.#logger.error('releasing the listener failed: %s', thrownValue(error))
227	    })
228	  }
229	
230	  #stopOpening(): void {
231	    if (this.#openTick !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.#openTick)
232	    if (this.#openDeadline !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.#openDeadline)
233	    this.#openTick = undefined
234	    this.#openDeadline = undefined
235	  }
236	
237	  /** 运维面装载时的握手：闸是 serving ⇒ 重发同一份 `serving`。 */
238	  onListening(): void {
239	    if (this.#face.gate !== 'serving' || this.#startedAt === undefined) return
240	    const notice = this.#servingNotice(this.#startedAt)
241	    this.#notify(() => this.#ctx.emit(serving, notice), serving)
242	  }
243	
244	  /** 每个请求一条工程记录；缺陷另发一次 `defect`（运维面据此计 `defectCount`）。 */
245	  record(record: RequestRecord): void {
246	    if (record.defect === true) {
247	      this.#logger.error('request %o', record)
248	      if (!this.#noticesClosed) this.#notify(() => this.#ctx.emit(defect), defect)
249	    } else {
250	      this.#logger.info('request %o', record)
251	    }
252	  }
253	
254	  /**
255	   * 撤除（一个 effect 内有序）。已开门：闸 serving → draining 并 emit stopped → 停止接受 → 有界等在途 → 关闭；
256	   * 未开门：闸置 retired、关闭已接的连接、释放端口，不等在途、不发 stopped。
257	   */
258	  async dispose(drainTimeoutMs: number): Promise<void> {
259	    this.#disposing = true
260	    this.#stopOpening()
261	    try {
262	      if (this.#face.gate === 'serving') {
263	        this.#face.beginDraining()
264	        this.#notify(() => this.#ctx.emit(stopped), stopped)
265	        await this.#face.drain(drainTimeoutMs)
266	      } else {
267	        await this.#face.retire()
268	      }
269	    } finally {
270	      await Promise.allSettled([...this.#business])
271	      this.#noticesClosed = true
272	    }
273	  }
274	}
