276	export const governanceCenterEntryPlugin = definePlugin<GovernanceCenterEntryConfig>({
277	  name: 'governance-center-entry',
278	  inject: [
279	    'storage',
280	    'clock',
281	    'credentials',
282	    'logins',
283	    'accounts',
284	    'registration',
285	    'organizations',
286	    'memberships',
287	    'offers',
288	  ],
289	  Config: GovernanceCenterEntryConfigSchema,
290	  async apply(ctx: Context, config) {
291	    const logger = ctx.logger('governance-center-entry')
292	    // 服务实例经 inject 取得（`ctx.get` 不带类型）；按各 owner 公开的服务面类型收下
293	    const clock: Clock = ctx.get('clock')
294	    const storage: AtomicStorage = ctx.get('storage')
295	    if (typeof storage.atomic !== 'function') throw new TypeError('entry2 requires AtomicStorage')
296	    const services: EntryServices = {
297	      accounts: ctx.get('accounts'),
298	      logins: ctx.get('logins'),
299	      registration: ctx.get('registration'),
300	      credentials: ctx.get('credentials'),
301	      organizations: ctx.get('organizations'),
302	      memberships: ctx.get('memberships'),
303	      offers: ctx.get('offers'),
304	    }
305	
306	    let runtime: EntryRuntime | undefined
307	    let publicHealth: Buffer | undefined
308	    const face = await ClientFace.bind({
309	      host: config.listen.host,
310	      port: config.listen.port,
311	      tls: config.tls,
312	      limits: RECEIVE_LIMITS,
313	      answer: body => {
314	        const current = runtime
315	        const health = publicHealth
316	        if (current === undefined || health === undefined || !current.accepting)
317	          return Promise.resolve(undefined)
318	        return current.run(async () => {
319	          try {
320	            const decision = await decide(body, { services, publicHealth: health, storage })
321	            current.record(decision.record)
322	            return decision.bytes
323	          } catch (error) {
324	            current.record({
325	              stage: 'operation',
326	              answer: 'unavailable',
327	              observed: { call: 'operation', value: thrownValue(error) },
328	              defect: true,
329	            })
330	            return entryAnswerBytes('unavailable')
331	          }
332	        })
333	      },
334	      closedWithoutAnswer: reason =>
335	        logger.debug('connection closed without an answer: %s', reason),
336	      serverError: error => logger.error('client face server error: %s', error.name),
337	    })
338	    // 紧接着登记撤除；登记时本 fiber 已被撤（INACTIVE_EFFECT）⇒ 自己释放端口再重抛
339	    try {
340	      ctx.effect(
341	        () => async () => {
342	          if (runtime === undefined) await face.retire()
343	          else await runtime.dispose(config.drainTimeoutMs)
344	        },
345	        'governance-center-entry listener',
346	      )
347	    } catch (error) {
348	      await face.retire()
349	      throw error
350	    }
351	
352	    // 读或铸中心标识（S-28）：失败四支各抛具名错误 ⇒ FAILED，已登记的 effect 随之释放端口
353	    const identity = await readOrMintCenterId(storage)
354	
355	    // 启动成功以钟可读为条件（S-34）：超界 ⇒ 启动失败，说明点名是钟
356	    const ready = await waitForClock(ctx, clock, config.clockReadyTimeoutMs)
357	    if (ready === 'disposed') return
358	    if (ready === 'timeout') throw new GovernanceCenterClockTimeoutError()
359	
360	    publicHealth = publicHealthBytes(identity.centerId, config.version)
361	    const current = new EntryRuntime(ctx, logger, face, clock, identity.centerId, config)
362	    runtime = current
363	    ctx.on(listening, () => current.onListening())
364	    // 开门挂在 openSignal 上，插件体不 await 它（否则本 fiber 停在 LOADING，装配等不到全部 ACTIVE）；
365	    // 拒绝 ⇒ 闸保持关着、不记不发，由续延吸收，不留未处理的拒绝
366	    Promise.resolve(config.openSignal).then(
367	      () => current.startOpening(),
368	      () => undefined,
369	    )
370	  },
371	})

42	async function standing(
43	  deps: OperationContext,

71	/** 把 `target`（此刻是有效超管）从有效超管集合里拿掉之后，组织里还剩不剩有效超管。在调用方的写事务里现读。 */
72	async function leavesASuperAdministrator(d: Db, target: TenantId): Promise<boolean> {

76	async function changeRole(
77	  deps: OperationContext,
78	  initiatorInput: unknown,
79	  targetInput: unknown,
80	  roleInput: unknown,
81	): Promise<Ack<ChangeRoleFailure>> {
82	  const initiator = parseTenantId(initiatorInput)
83	  const target = parseTenantId(targetInput)
84	  const role = parseTenantRole(roleInput)
85	  if (!isOk(initiator) || !isOk(target) || !isOk(role)) return fail('invalidInput')
86	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
87	    // S-17：同组织成员写入序列化（R-3a，写事务开头锁组织行；sqlite 下由 BEGIN IMMEDIATE 兑现）
88	    await tx.lockRow('organization', { organization_id: target.ok.organization })
89	    const d = db(tx)
90	    const current = await readMembership(d, target.ok)
91	    if (current === undefined || !current.effective) return fail('membershipNotEffective')
92	    // ② 之后仍 ≥ 1 位有效超管；与写入同一提交（④：不得先查后写）。
93	    // 这一条排在发起者授权之前：两位超管同时降级／移除对方时，后成的一方此刻已不是超管，
94	    // 契约 S-29／S-48 与 flows §3.3 要它拿到与单次被拒相同的 wouldLeaveNoSuperAdministrator，而不是 notAuthorized
95	    if (current.role === 'superAdministrator' && role.ok !== 'superAdministrator') {
96	      if (!(await leavesASuperAdministrator(d, target.ok))) {
97	        return fail('wouldLeaveNoSuperAdministrator')
98	      }
99	    }
100	    const authorized =
101	      initiator.ok.organization === target.ok.organization &&
102	      (await isSuperAdministrator(d, initiator.ok))
103	    if (!authorized) return fail('notAuthorized')
104	    // ⑦ 幂等：已持有该角色 ⇒ ok，无二次效果、不发事件
105	    if (current.role === role.ok) return succeed(false)
106	    await d
107	      .updateTable('membership')
108	      .set({ role: role.ok })
109	      .where('organization_id', '=', target.ok.organization)
110	      .where('account_id', '=', target.ok.account)
111	      .execute()
112	    return succeed(true)
113	  })
114	  if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
115	  if (outcome.ok) deps.notify('role.changed', { tenant: target.ok, role: role.ok })
116	  return 'ok'
117	}

119	async function remove(
120	  deps: OperationContext,
121	  initiatorInput: unknown,
122	  targetInput: unknown,
123	): Promise<Ack<RemoveMemberFailure>> {
124	  const initiator = parseTenantId(initiatorInput)
125	  const target = parseTenantId(targetInput)
126	  if (!isOk(initiator) || !isOk(target)) return fail('invalidInput')
127	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
128	    await tx.lockRow('organization', { organization_id: target.ok.organization })
129	    const d = db(tx)
130	    // ③ 结构性禁止先于授权：由 OrganizationKind 决定、与发起者无关（S-15）——超管在个人组织里也没有这个动作
131	    const organization = await readOrganization(d, target.ok.organization)
132	    if (organization?.kind === 'personal') return fail('personalOrganizationMemberCannotLeave')
133	    const current = await readMembership(d, target.ok)
134	    // ⑦ 幂等：已无效 ⇒ membershipNotEffective，无二次效果
135	    if (current === undefined || !current.effective) return fail('membershipNotEffective')
136	    // 之后仍 ≥ 1 位有效超管，先于授权判（理由同 changeRole：并发移除对方的后成者拿单次被拒的那个值）
137	    if (current.role === 'superAdministrator' && !(await leavesASuperAdministrator(d, target.ok))) {
138	      return fail('wouldLeaveNoSuperAdministrator')
139	    }
140	    // ② 本人（退出）或该组织的超级管理员（移除）
141	    const self = tenantIdEquals(initiator.ok, target.ok)
142	    const authorized =
143	      self ||
144	      (initiator.ok.organization === target.ok.organization &&
145	        (await isSuperAdministrator(d, initiator.ok)))
146	    if (!authorized) return fail('notAuthorized')
147	    // S-38：只把这条记录置为无效；不删持有、不铸新身份、不发清理指令
148	    await d
149	      .updateTable('membership')
150	      .set({ effective: 0 })
151	      .where('organization_id', '=', target.ok.organization)
152	      .where('account_id', '=', target.ok.account)
153	      .execute()
154	    return succeed(undefined)
155	  })
156	  if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
157	  deps.notify('membership.changed', { tenant: target.ok, effective: false })
158	  return 'ok'
159	}

161	type LoginVerdict =

163	  | { readonly failure: 'loginStateNotValid' | 'invalidInput' | 'unavailable' }

165	/**

169	async function verifyLogin(

172	): Promise<LoginVerdict> {

174	  if ('ok' in verdict) return verdict
175	  switch (verdict.failure) {
176	    case 'login-state-rejected':
177	      return { failure: 'loginStateNotValid' }
178	    case 'invalid-input':
179	      return { failure: 'invalidInput' }
180	    case 'storage-unavailable':

186	  deps: OperationContext,
187	  loginStateId: LoginStateId,
188	): Promise<Outcome<TenantId, CurrentTenantFailure>> {
189	  const verdict = await verifyLogin(deps, loginStateId)
190	  if ('failure' in verdict) return verdict
191	  const account = verdict.ok
192	  return deps.query(async tx => {
193	    const d = db(tx)
194	    const selection = await d
195	      .selectFrom('current_tenant_selection')
196	      .select(['organization_id', 'account_id'])
197	      .where('login_state_id', '=', loginStateId)
198	      .executeTakeFirst()
199	    if (selection !== undefined) {

205	      return succeed(tenant.ok)

207	    // 「尚未做过任何切换」是已读出的事实 ⇒ 初值 = (个人组织, 该账号)（S-14 第 1 条）。读失败走不到这里（⑧）。

211	      deps.logger.error('current tenant: verified account %s has no personal organization', account)
212	      return fail('unavailable')
213	    }
214	    return succeed({ organization: personal.id, account })
215	  })
216	}

255	  deps: OperationContext,
256	  tenantInput: unknown,

267	    const authorized = includeIneffective.ok
268	      ? callerStanding.standing === 'effective' && callerStanding.role === 'superAdministrator'

275	    if (!includeIneffective.ok) query = query.where('effective', '=', 1)
276	    const rows = await query.orderBy('account_id').execute()
277	    return succeed(
278	      rows.map(row => {
279	        const record = decodeMembership(row)
280	        return { tenant: record.tenant, role: record.role, effective: record.effective }
281	      }),
282	    )
283	  })
284	}

287	 * S-14 ⑤ 卫生工作：按页走完全部选择记录，对每条调 `logins.verify`；`login-state-rejected` ⇒ 删；
288	 * `storage-unavailable` ⇒ 本轮跳过该条；记录里的串解析不过或 AI 答 `invalid-input` 是缺陷，记 error 日志、跳过。
289	 * 本节点里 `parseLoginStateId` 只剩这一处调用点（以它为键的记录是 AI v2 S-30 第 10 行许可的来源）。
290	 * 自己这边的存储读不到 ⇒ 本轮结束（不进失败集合，下一轮再来）。触发与节奏归装配（G-13）。
291	 */
292	async function sweepStaleSelections(deps: Deps, batch: number): Promise<void> {
293	  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(batch) || batch <= 0) {
294	    throw new RangeError(`sweepStaleSelections: batch must be a positive integer, got ${batch}`)
295	  }
296	  let after: string | undefined
297	  for (;;) {
298	    let page: readonly string[]
299	    try {
300	      page = await deps.storage.read(async tx => {
301	        let query = db(tx)
302	          .selectFrom('current_tenant_selection')
303	          .select('login_state_id')
304	          .orderBy('login_state_id')
305	          .limit(batch)
306	        if (after !== undefined) query = query.where('login_state_id', '>', after)
307	        return (await query.execute()).map(row => row.login_state_id)
308	      })
309	    } catch (error) {
310	      if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) {
311	        deps.logger.info('sweep of stale tenant selections stopped: storage unavailable')
312	        return
313	      }
314	      throw error
315	    }
316	    for (const key of page) {
317	      const parsed = parseLoginStateId(key)
318	      if (!isOk(parsed)) {
319	        deps.logger.error('sweep: stored login_state_id %o is malformed; skipped', key)
320	        continue
321	      }
322	      try {
323	        await deps.storage.atomic(unit =>
324	          withParticipation(deps, unit, async context => {
325	            const verdict = await context.logins.verify(parsed.ok)
326	            if ('ok' in verdict) return
327	            if (verdict.failure === 'storage-unavailable')
328	              throw new StorageUnavailable('login validity unavailable')
329	            if (verdict.failure === 'invalid-input') {
330	              deps.logger.error('sweep: login state %s was rejected as invalid input; skipped', key)
331	              return
332	            }
333	            await context.mutate(async tx => {
334	              await db(tx)
335	                .deleteFrom('current_tenant_selection')
336	                .where('login_state_id', '=', parsed.ok)
337	                .execute()
338	            })
339	          }),
340	        )
341	      } catch (error) {
342	        if (!(error instanceof StorageUnavailable)) throw error
343	        deps.logger.info('sweep of stale tenant selections stopped: storage unavailable')
344	        return
345	      }
346	    }
347	    if (page.length < batch) return
348	    after = page[page.length - 1]
349	  }
350	}

51	export async function withParticipation<T>(
52	  deps: Deps,
53	  unit: StorageUnit,
54	  work: (context: OperationContext) => Promise<T>,
55	): Promise<T> {
56	  unit.assertStorage(deps.storage)
57	  return unit.run(async () => {
58	    const result = await work({
59	      query: fn => unit.query(fn),
60	      mutate: fn => unit.mutate(fn),
61	      accounts: deps.accounts.participate(unit),
62	      logins: deps.logins.participate(unit),
63	      clock: deps.clock,
64	      config: deps.config,
65	      logger: deps.logger,
66	      notify: (name, payload) => unit.afterCommit(() => deps.notify(name, payload)),
67	    })
68	    // Clock/dependency unavailability is also fatal to any earlier staged effects.
69	    if (
70	      typeof result === 'object' &&
71	      result !== null &&
72	      'failure' in result &&
73	      result.failure === 'unavailable'
74	    ) {
75	      throw new StorageUnavailable('organization-governance: required observation unavailable')
76	    }
77	    return result
78	  })
79	}

82	export async function withOperation<T>(
83	  deps: Deps,
84	  work: (context: OperationContext) => Promise<T>,
85	): Promise<T | { readonly failure: 'unavailable' }> {
86	  try {
87	    return await deps.storage.atomic(unit => withParticipation(deps, unit, work))
88	  } catch (error) {

99	 * `storage-unavailable` ⇒ `unavailable`（没有结论）；`invalid-input` ⇒ `invalidInput`——本节点已先做过同一条
100	 * IV S-31 的表示层校验，这一支对类型正确的调用到不了，前提失效时收场仍是 `invalidInput`（与 S-4 第三行同一口径）。

112	    case 'storage-unavailable':
113	      return { failure: 'unavailable' }
114	    case 'invalid-input':
115	      return { failure: 'invalidInput' }
116	  }
117	}

176	async function issueInvitation(
177	  deps: OperationContext,
178	  issuerInput: unknown,
179	  targetInput: unknown,
180	  roleInput?: unknown,
181	  ttlInput?: unknown,
182	): Promise<Outcome<InvitationId, IssueInvitationFailure>> {
183	  const issuer = parseTenantId(issuerInput)
184	  const target = parseAccountId(targetInput)
185	  if (!isOk(issuer) || !isOk(target)) return fail('invalidInput')
186	  // 指定角色缺省为普通成员；给了就按集合闭合判（IV S-32）
187	  let role: TenantRole = 'member'
188	  if (roleInput !== undefined) {
189	    const parsedRole = parseTenantRole(roleInput)
190	    if (!isOk(parsedRole)) return fail('invalidInput')
191	    role = parsedRole.ok
192	  }
193	  const ttl = resolveTtl(ttlInput, deps.config.invitationTtlDefault)
194	  if (ttl === 'invalidOfferDuration') return fail('invalidOfferDuration')
195	
196	  // ③ 结构性禁止先于授权（S-15），② 授权再先于账号读面：失败值的次序与读面给的判定一致
197	  const precheck = await deps.query(async tx => {
198	    const d = db(tx)
199	    const organization = await readOrganization(d, issuer.ok.organization)
200	    if (organization?.kind === 'personal') return fail('issuerIsPersonalOrganization')
201	    if (!(await isSuperAdministrator(d, issuer.ok))) return fail('notAuthorized')
202	    return succeed(undefined)
203	  })
204	  if ('failure' in precheck) return precheck
205	
206	  // 账号读面在本节点的事务之外调（不嵌套）
207	  const facts = await readAccountFacts(deps, target.ok)
208	  if ('failure' in facts) return facts
209	  if (!facts.ok.activated) return fail('accountNotActivated')
210	
211	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
212	    const d = db(tx)
213	    // 授权在写入的同一提交里再现读一次（S-18）
214	    if (!(await isSuperAdministrator(d, issuer.ok))) return fail('notAuthorized')
215	    const existing = await readMembership(d, {
216	      organization: issuer.ok.organization,
217	      account: target.ok,
218	    })
219	    if (existing?.effective === true) return fail('alreadyAnEffectiveMember')
220	    const now = deps.clock.now()
221	    if (now === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
222	    const timing = timingFrom(now, ttl)
223	    if (timing === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
224	    if (!isOk(timing)) return fail('invalidOfferDuration')
225	    const id = mintIdentifier('InvitationId')
226	    await d
227	      .insertInto('invitation')
228	      .values({
229	        invitation_id: id,
230	        issuer_organization: issuer.ok.organization,
231	        invited_account: target.ok,
232	        role,
233	        issued_at: timing.ok.issuedAt,
234	        expires_at: timing.ok.expiresAt,
235	        settled: null,
236	      })
237	      .execute()
238	    return succeed(id)
239	  })
240	  if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
241	  // ⑨ 必发（通知）：提交之后派发一次
242	  deps.notify('invitation.issued', {
243	    invitationId: outcome.ok,
244	    issuer: issuer.ok.organization,
245	    invitedAccount: target.ok,
246	  })
247	  return outcome
248	}

250	async function withdrawInvitation(
251	  deps: OperationContext,
252	  issuerInput: unknown,
253	  invitationInput: unknown,
254	): Promise<Ack<WithdrawInvitationFailure>> {
255	  const issuer = parseTenantId(issuerInput)
256	  const id = parseInvitationId(invitationInput)
257	  if (!isOk(issuer) || !isOk(id)) return fail('invalidInput')
258	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
259	    await tx.lockRow('invitation', { invitation_id: id.ok })
260	    const d = db(tx)
261	    const record = await readInvitationRecord(d, id.ok)
262	    // 不属发起者的组织 ⇒ 同一个 DoesNotExist，不泄漏存在性
263	    if (record === undefined || record.issuer !== issuer.ok.organization) {
264	      return fail('invitationDoesNotExist')
265	    }
266	    if (!(await isSuperAdministrator(d, issuer.ok))) return fail('notAuthorized')
267	    // ④ 提交内先现读一次过期判定（OE S-8 反方向：已过期的不得再写终结记录）
268	    const step = withdrawStep(
269	      record.settled ??
270	        invitationState(record, deps.clock.now(), await existenceOne(d, record.issuer)),
271	    )
272	    if (step === 'alreadyConcluded' || step === 'unavailable') return fail(step)
273	    if (step === 'write') {
274	      await d
275	        .updateTable('invitation')
276	        .set({ settled: 'withdrawn' })
277	        .where('invitation_id', '=', record.id)
278	        .execute()
279	    }
280	    return succeed(undefined)
281	  })
282	  return 'failure' in outcome ? outcome : 'ok'
283	}

285	async function acceptInvitation(
286	  deps: OperationContext,
287	  accountInput: unknown,
288	  invitationInput: unknown,
289	): Promise<Outcome<TenantId, AcceptInvitationFailure>> {
290	  const account = parseAccountId(accountInput)
291	  const id = parseInvitationId(invitationInput)
292	  if (!isOk(account) || !isOk(id)) return fail('invalidInput')
293	
294	  // 三段，不把账号读面嵌进本节点的存储事务：① 读邀请 → ② 账号已激活 → ③ 序列化的写提交内全部重判
295	  const located = await deps.query(async tx => {
296	    const record = await readInvitationRecord(db(tx), id.ok)
297	    if (record === undefined) return fail('invitationDoesNotExist')
298	    if (record.invitedAccount !== account.ok) return fail('notTheInvitedAccount')
299	    return succeed(record.issuer)
300	  })
301	  if ('failure' in located) return located
302	  const issuer = located.ok
303	
304	  const facts = await readAccountFacts(deps, account.ok)
305	  if ('failure' in facts) return facts
306	  // 已激活不回退（AI S-20）：读到已激活即可提交
307	  if (!facts.ok.activated) return fail('accountNotActivated')
308	
309	  const tenant: TenantId = { organization: issuer, account: account.ok }
310	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
311	    // ④ 受 S-17 序列化（R-3a）：成员写入前锁组织行；邀请行锁住防与撤回交错
312	    await tx.lockRow('organization', { organization_id: issuer })
313	    await tx.lockRow('invitation', { invitation_id: id.ok })
314	    const d = db(tx)
315	    const record = await readInvitationRecord(d, id.ok)
316	    if (record === undefined) return fail('invitationDoesNotExist')
317	    if (record.invitedAccount !== account.ok) return fail('notTheInvitedAccount')
318	    // ② 过期在写入的同一提交内重新求值（OE S-10）；三种来路折成一个布尔再映射（OE S-13）
319	    const state =
320	      record.settled ??
321	      invitationState(record, deps.clock.now(), await existenceOne(d, record.issuer))
322	    if (state === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
323	    if (!acceptable(state)) return fail('offerNoLongerValid')
324	    const existing = await readMembership(d, tenant)
325	    if (existing?.effective === true) return fail('alreadyAnEffectiveMember')
326	    // S-39：同一个主键上置回有效——回来的是同一条记录、同一个 TenantId；角色取本次邀请指定的，不继承
327	    await d
328	      .insertInto('membership')
329	      .values({
330	        organization_id: tenant.organization,
331	        account_id: tenant.account,
332	        effective: 1,
333	        role: record.role,
334	      })
335	      .onConflict(oc =>
336	        oc
337	          .columns(['organization_id', 'account_id'])
338	          .doUpdateSet({ effective: 1, role: record.role }),
339	      )
340	      .execute()
341	    await d
342	      .updateTable('invitation')
343	      .set({ settled: 'accepted' })
344	      .where('invitation_id', '=', record.id)
345	      .execute()
346	    return succeed(tenant)
347	  })
348	  if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
349	  deps.notify('membership.changed', { tenant, effective: true })
350	  return outcome
351	}

355	async function issueAffiliationRequest(
356	  deps: OperationContext,
357	  initiatorInput: unknown,
358	  recipientInput: unknown,
359	  directionInput: unknown,
360	  ttlInput?: unknown,
361	): Promise<Outcome<AffiliationRequestId, IssueAffiliationRequestFailure>> {
362	  const initiator = parseTenantId(initiatorInput)
363	  const recipient = parseOrganizationId(recipientInput)
364	  const direction = parseDirection(directionInput)
365	  if (!isOk(initiator) || !isOk(recipient) || !isOk(direction)) return fail('invalidInput')
366	  const ttl = resolveTtl(ttlInput, deps.config.affiliationRequestTtlDefault)
367	  if (ttl === 'invalidOfferDuration') return fail('invalidOfferDuration')
368	  // 指向自己：两个不透明标识逐码点比较即可判出，不读任何记录；值与 S-32 判环同一个
369	  if (recipient.ok === initiator.ok.organization) return fail('wouldFormACycle')
370	
371	  return deps.mutate(async tx => {
372	    const d = db(tx)
373	    const own = await readOrganization(d, initiator.ok.organization)
374	    if (own?.kind === 'personal') return fail('personalOrganizationTakesNoPartInAffiliation')
375	    const other = await readOrganization(d, recipient.ok)
376	    if (other === undefined) return fail('organizationDoesNotExist')
377	    if (other.kind === 'personal') return fail('personalOrganizationTakesNoPartInAffiliation')
378	    if (!(await isSuperAdministrator(d, initiator.ok))) return fail('notAuthorized')
379	    // 一般的环与「己方已有上级」不在这里判，留给接受那一刻（S-30 正文）
380	    const now = deps.clock.now()
381	    if (now === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
382	    const timing = timingFrom(now, ttl)
383	    if (timing === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
384	    if (!isOk(timing)) return fail('invalidOfferDuration')
385	    const id = mintIdentifier('AffiliationRequestId')
386	    await d
387	      .insertInto('affiliation_request')
388	      .values({
389	        affiliation_request_id: id,
390	        initiator: initiator.ok.organization,
391	        recipient: recipient.ok,
392	        direction: direction.ok,
393	        issued_at: timing.ok.issuedAt,
394	        expires_at: timing.ok.expiresAt,
395	        settled: null,
396	      })
397	      .execute()
398	    return succeed(id)
399	  })
400	}

402	async function withdrawAffiliationRequest(
403	  deps: OperationContext,
404	  initiatorInput: unknown,
405	  requestInput: unknown,
406	): Promise<Ack<WithdrawAffiliationRequestFailure>> {
407	  const initiator = parseTenantId(initiatorInput)
408	  const id = parseAffiliationRequestId(requestInput)
409	  if (!isOk(initiator) || !isOk(id)) return fail('invalidInput')
410	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
411	    await tx.lockRow('affiliation_request', { affiliation_request_id: id.ok })
412	    const d = db(tx)
413	    const record = await readAffiliationRequestRecord(d, id.ok)
414	    // 只对发起方成立；接收方撤不了别人发来的请求，同样收成 DoesNotExist
415	    if (record === undefined || record.initiator !== initiator.ok.organization) {
416	      return fail('affiliationRequestDoesNotExist')
417	    }
418	    if (!(await isSuperAdministrator(d, initiator.ok))) return fail('notAuthorized')
419	    const step = withdrawStep(
420	      record.settled ??
421	        requestState(record, deps.clock.now(), await existenceOne(d, record.recipient)),
422	    )
423	    if (step === 'alreadyConcluded' || step === 'unavailable') return fail(step)
424	    if (step === 'write') {
425	      await d
426	        .updateTable('affiliation_request')
427	        .set({ settled: 'withdrawn' })
428	        .where('affiliation_request_id', '=', record.id)
429	        .execute()
430	    }
431	    return succeed(undefined)
432	  })
433	  return 'failure' in outcome ? outcome : 'ok'
434	}

436	/** 由方向定下级与新上级（S-30 ①）。 */
437	function childAndParent(record: AffiliationRequestRecord): {
438	  readonly child: OrganizationId
439	  readonly newParent: OrganizationId
440	} {
441	  return record.direction === 'recipientAsParent'
442	    ? { child: record.initiator, newParent: record.recipient }
443	    : { child: record.recipient, newParent: record.initiator }
444	}

447	 * S-7：上级组织属性的两条写路径之一（接受隶属请求填值）。另一条是 organizations 里解除隶属的 `clearParent`。
448	 */
449	async function setParent(d: Db, child: OrganizationId, newParent: OrganizationId): Promise<void> {
450	  await d
451	    .updateTable('organization')
452	    .set({ parent: newParent })
453	    .where('organization_id', '=', child)
454	    .execute()

457	async function acceptAffiliationRequest(
458	  deps: OperationContext,
459	  acceptorInput: unknown,
460	  requestInput: unknown,
461	): Promise<Ack<AcceptAffiliationRequestFailure>> {
462	  const acceptor = parseTenantId(acceptorInput)
463	  const id = parseAffiliationRequestId(requestInput)
464	  if (!isOk(acceptor) || !isOk(id)) return fail('invalidInput')
465	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async (tx: WriteTx) => {
466	    // R-3b：隶属写部署级序列化——链跨多个组织，按组织加锁不够
467	    await tx.lockSentinel(AFFILIATION_SENTINEL)
468	    await tx.lockRow('affiliation_request', { affiliation_request_id: id.ok })
469	    const d = db(tx)
470	    const record = await readAffiliationRequestRecord(d, id.ok)
471	    if (record === undefined) return fail('affiliationRequestDoesNotExist')
472	    // ③ 结构性禁止先于授权（S-15）：由两端的 OrganizationKind 决定，与接受者无关
473	    const initiatorOrg = await readOrganization(d, record.initiator)
474	    const recipientOrg = await readOrganization(d, record.recipient)
475	    if (initiatorOrg?.kind === 'personal' || recipientOrg?.kind === 'personal') {
476	      return fail('personalOrganizationTakesNoPartInAffiliation')
477	    }
478	    // ② 接受者是接收方组织的超级管理员（单方面指定不允许，哪怕发起方是上级）
479	    const authorized =
480	      acceptor.ok.organization === record.recipient && (await isSuperAdministrator(d, acceptor.ok))
481	    if (!authorized) return fail('notAuthorized')
482	    // ④① 过期重判，指向对象只有接收方组织
483	    const state = requestState(
484	      record,
485	      deps.clock.now(),
486	      recipientOrg === undefined ? 'absent' : 'exists',
487	    )
488	    if (state === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
489	    if (!acceptable(state)) return fail('offerNoLongerValid')
490	    const { child, newParent } = childAndParent(record)
491	    const childOrg = child === record.initiator ? initiatorOrg : recipientOrg
492	    if (childOrg === undefined) {
493	      // 团队组织本版没有终结路径；下级组织读得到却不存在是缺陷
494	      throw new Error(
495	        `organization-governance: affiliation request ${record.id} names a missing organization`,
496	      )
497	    }
498	    // ④② 下级尚无上级
499	    if (childOrg.parent !== null) return fail('alreadyHasAParentOrganization')
500	    // ④③ 判环两半：newParent 不是 child 自己，且 child 不在 newParent 的上级链上；
501	    // 链在同一提交内逐行读出，任一行读不到 ⇒ unavailable，不判「不成环」
502	    if (child === newParent) return fail('wouldFormACycle')
503	    const chain = ancestorChain(newParent, await loadParentSnapshot(d, [newParent]))
504	    if ('failure' in chain) {
505	      if (chain.failure === 'cycle') throw new ParentChainCycle(newParent)
506	      return fail('unavailable')
507	    }
508	    if (chain.ok.includes(child)) return fail('wouldFormACycle')
509	    // ④④⑤ 写上级属性 ＋ 终结记录；不产生任何租户（没有通向成员写入的路）
510	    await setParent(d, child, newParent)
511	    await d
512	      .updateTable('affiliation_request')
513	      .set({ settled: 'accepted' })
514	      .where('affiliation_request_id', '=', record.id)
515	      .execute()
516	    return succeed(undefined)
517	  })
518	  return 'failure' in outcome ? outcome : 'ok'
519	}

523	async function readInvitation(
524	  deps: OperationContext,
525	  callerInput: OfferReader,
526	  invitationInput: unknown,
527	): Promise<Outcome<InvitationReading, ReadInvitationFailure>> {
528	  const caller = parseOfferReader(callerInput)

535	    // ② 两类人，与判别式一一对应；不满足 ⇒ DoesNotExist（不泄漏存在性）
536	    const allowed =
537	      caller.ok.kind === 'account'
538	        ? caller.ok.accountId === record.invitedAccount
539	        : caller.ok.tenantId.organization === record.issuer &&
540	          (await isSuperAdministrator(d, caller.ok.tenantId))
541	    if (!allowed) return fail('invitationDoesNotExist')
542	    const state =
543	      record.settled ??
544	      invitationState(record, deps.clock.now(), await existenceOne(d, record.issuer))
545	    if (state === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
546	    return succeed(invitationReading(record, state))
547	  })

575	/**
576	 * 列表面的共同求值：一次读事务、一次 `now`、一次批量存在性读；逐项 `deriveState`；
577	 * 任一项求不出派生状态 ⇒ 整个调用 `unavailable`（不返回残缺列表）；默认过滤在求值之后做。
578	 */
579	function evaluateAll<R, V>(
580	  records: readonly R[],
581	  stateOf: (record: R) => OfferState | 'unavailable',
582	  reading: (record: R, state: OfferState) => V,
583	  includeSettled: boolean,
584	): readonly V[] | 'unavailable' {
585	  const out: V[] = []
586	  for (const record of records) {
587	    const state = stateOf(record)
588	    if (state === 'unavailable') return 'unavailable'
589	    if (includeSettled || state === 'pending') out.push(reading(record, state))
590	  }
591	  return out
592	}

624	async function listReceivedInvitations(
625	  deps: OperationContext,
626	  accountInput: unknown,
627	  includeSettledInput?: unknown,
628	): Promise<Outcome<readonly InvitationReading[], ListReceivedInvitationsFailure>> {
629	  const account = parseAccountId(accountInput)
630	  const includeSettled = parseIncludeSwitch(includeSettledInput)
631	  if (!isOk(account) || !isOk(includeSettled)) return fail('invalidInput')
632	  // ② 无授权前置：输入的 AccountId 就是调用者本人（入口层核实，S-42）；返回的全部内容以它为界
633	  return deps.query(async tx => {
634	    const d = db(tx)
635	    const records = await invitationsWhere(d, 'invited_account', account.ok)
636	    const now = deps.clock.now()
637	    const existence = await existenceOf(
638	      d,
639	      records.filter(r => r.settled === null).map(r => r.issuer),
640	    )
641	    const result = evaluateAll(
642	      records,
643	      r => invitationState(r, now, existence.get(r.issuer) ?? 'unavailable'),
644	      invitationReading,
645	      includeSettled.ok,
646	    )
647	    return result === 'unavailable' ? fail('unavailable') : succeed(result)
648	  })
649	}

652	  deps: OperationContext,
653	  tenantInput: unknown,

655	): Promise<Outcome<IssuedOffers, ListIssuedFailure>> {
656	  const caller = parseTenantId(tenantInput)

681	    )

98	async function createPersonal(
99	  deps: OperationContext,
100	  accountIdInput: unknown,
101	): Promise<Outcome<CreatedOrganization, CreatePersonalFailure>> {
102	  const parsed = parseAccountId(accountIdInput)
103	  if (!isOk(parsed)) return fail('invalidInput')
104	  const account = parsed.ok
105	
106	  // ② 两条账号判定（存在、未过期）；幂等那一路同样要过（⑦）。
107	  const facts = await readAccountFacts(deps, account)
108	  if ('failure' in facts) return facts
109	  if (facts.ok.retentionExpired) return fail('accountRecordExpired')
110	
111	  return deps.mutate(async tx => {
112	    const d = db(tx)
113	    const existing = await readOrganizationOwnedBy(d, account)
114	    if (existing !== undefined) return succeed(created(existing.id, account))
115	    const now = deps.clock.now()
116	    if (now === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
117	    const id = mintIdentifier('OrganizationId')
118	    try {
119	      await insertOrganizationWithSuperAdministrator(d, {
120	        id,
121	        kind: 'personal',
122	        ownerAccount: account,
123	        creator: account,
124	        createdAt: now,
125	      })
126	    } catch (error) {
127	      // R-6：账号行已不在（被清除链先删）⇒ 引用约束在插入时拒绝 ⇒ 这一刻账号不存在
128	      if (error instanceof ReferenceViolation && error.kind === 'missing-target') {
129	        return fail('accountDoesNotExist')
130	      }
131	      // 至多一个个人组织：并发插入撞唯一索引 ⇒ 提交内重读返回既有的那一个（⑦ 幂等，不是拒绝）
132	      if (
133	        error instanceof UniqueViolation &&
134	        error.constraint === 'organization_owner_account_unique'
135	      ) {
136	        const winner = await readOrganizationOwnedBy(d, account)
137	        if (winner !== undefined) return succeed(created(winner.id, account))
138	      }
139	      throw error
140	    }
141	    return succeed(created(id, account))
142	  })
143	}

145	async function createTeam(
146	  deps: OperationContext,
147	  creatorInput: unknown,
148	  creationKeyInput?: unknown,
149	): Promise<Outcome<CreatedOrganization, CreateTeamFailure>> {
150	  const parsedCreator = parseAccountId(creatorInput)
151	  if (!isOk(parsedCreator)) return fail('invalidInput')
152	  const creator = parsedCreator.ok
153	  // 创建键：缺席 = 本次不去重（S-16 表第三行）；给了就按 IV S-31 的词法判形状
154	  let creationKey: string | undefined
155	  if (creationKeyInput !== undefined) {
156	    const parsedKey = parseOpaqueIdentifier(creationKeyInput, 'CreationKey')
157	    if (!isOk(parsedKey)) return fail('invalidInput')
158	    creationKey = parsedKey.ok
159	  }
160	
161	  const facts = await readAccountFacts(deps, creator)
162	  if ('failure' in facts) return facts
163	  if (!facts.ok.activated) return fail('accountNotActivated')
164	
165	  return deps.mutate(async tx => {
166	    const d = db(tx)
167	    const now = deps.clock.now()
168	    if (now === 'unavailable') return fail('unavailable')
169	    const id = mintIdentifier('OrganizationId')
170	    if (creationKey !== undefined) {
171	      const replay = await registerCreationKey(d, tx, {
172	        creator,
173	        creationKey,
174	        organization: id,
175	        now,
176	        retention: deps.config.teamCreationKeyRetention,
177	      })
178	      // 同创建者、同键、仍在保留期内 ⇒ 首次创建的那一个，无二次效果（⑦）
179	      if (replay !== undefined) return succeed(created(replay, creator))
180	    }
181	    await insertOrganizationWithSuperAdministrator(d, {
182	      id,
183	      kind: 'team',
184	      ownerAccount: null,
185	      creator,
186	      createdAt: now,
187	    })
188	    return succeed(created(id, creator))
189	  })
190	}

192	/**
193	 * 键登记与组织行同一提交（S-21 ④）。返回已登记且仍在保留期内的 `OrganizationId`（重放），
194	 * 或 `undefined`（本次登记成功，调用方接着建组织）。读不到登记以异常上抛 ⇒ `unavailable`，**不得当作没见过**（⑧）。
195	 * 保留期边界：`now ≤ registeredAt + retention` 算在期内；过期后同键 ⇒ 新组织，登记改指新组织。
196	 * 先登记、后建组织：并发的同键创建撞主键 ⇒ 重读认回胜者，不留第二个组织。
197	 */
198	async function registerCreationKey(
199	  d: Db,
200	  tx: WriteTx,
201	  entry: {
202	    readonly creator: AccountId
203	    readonly creationKey: string
204	    readonly organization: OrganizationId
205	    readonly now: Instant
206	    readonly retention: Duration
207	  },
208	): Promise<OrganizationId | undefined> {
209	  const lookup = async () =>
210	    d
211	      .selectFrom('team_creation_key')
212	      .select(['organization_id', 'registered_at'])
213	      .where('creator_account', '=', entry.creator)
214	      .where('creation_key', '=', entry.creationKey)
215	      .executeTakeFirst()
216	  const withinRetention = (registeredAt: unknown) =>
217	    entry.now <=
218	    addDuration(decodeInstant('team_creation_key', 'registered_at', registeredAt), entry.retention)
219	  await tx.lockRow('team_creation_key', {
220	    creator_account: entry.creator,
221	    creation_key: entry.creationKey,
222	  })
223	  const hit = await lookup()
224	  if (hit !== undefined) {
225	    if (withinRetention(hit.registered_at)) {
226	      const organization = parseOrganizationId(hit.organization_id)
227	      if (!isOk(organization)) throw new Error('team_creation_key.organization_id is malformed')
228	      return organization.ok
229	    }
230	    await d
231	      .updateTable('team_creation_key')
232	      .set({ organization_id: entry.organization, registered_at: entry.now })
233	      .where('creator_account', '=', entry.creator)
234	      .where('creation_key', '=', entry.creationKey)
235	      .execute()
236	    return undefined
237	  }
238	  try {
239	    await d
240	      .insertInto('team_creation_key')
241	      .values({
242	        creator_account: entry.creator,
243	        creation_key: entry.creationKey,
244	        organization_id: entry.organization,
245	        registered_at: entry.now,
246	      })
247	      .execute()
248	  } catch (error) {
249	    if (error instanceof UniqueViolation && error.constraint === 'team_creation_key_pkey') {
250	      const winner = await lookup()
251	      const organization =
252	        winner === undefined ? undefined : parseOrganizationId(winner.organization_id)
253	      if (organization !== undefined && isOk(organization)) return organization.ok
254	    }
255	    throw error
256	  }
257	  return undefined
258	}

260	async function read(
261	  deps: OperationContext,
262	  organizationInput: unknown,
263	): Promise<Outcome<OrganizationReading, ReadOrganizationFailure>> {
264	  const parsed = parseOrganizationId(organizationInput)
265	  if (!isOk(parsed)) return fail('invalidInput')
266	  return deps.query(async tx => {
267	    const record = await readOrganization(db(tx), parsed.ok)
268	    if (record === undefined) return fail('organizationDoesNotExist')
269	    return succeed({ id: record.id, kind: record.kind, parent: record.parent })
270	  })
271	}

273	async function dissolveAffiliation(
274	  deps: OperationContext,
275	  initiatorInput: unknown,
276	  childInput: unknown,
277	): Promise<Ack<DissolveAffiliationFailure>> {
278	  const initiator = parseTenantId(initiatorInput)
279	  const child = parseOrganizationId(childInput)
280	  if (!isOk(initiator) || !isOk(child)) return fail('invalidInput')
281	  const outcome = await deps.mutate(async tx => {
282	    await tx.lockSentinel(AFFILIATION_SENTINEL)
283	    const d = db(tx)
284	    const record = await readOrganization(d, child.ok)
285	    // ② 任一方组织的超级管理员，单方面即可（不需要一份隶属请求）
286	    const parties =
287	      record === undefined ? [] : [record.id, ...(record.parent === null ? [] : [record.parent])]
288	    const authorized =
289	      parties.includes(initiator.ok.organization) && (await isSuperAdministrator(d, initiator.ok))
290	    if (!authorized) return fail('notAuthorized')
291	    if (record === undefined || record.parent === null) return fail('noSuchAffiliation')
292	    await clearParent(d, record.id)
293	    return succeed({ child: record.id, formerParent: record.parent })
294	  })
295	  if ('failure' in outcome) return outcome
296	  deps.notify('affiliation.dissolved', outcome.ok)
297	  return 'ok'
298	}

300	/**
301	 * S-7：上级组织属性的两条写路径之一（解除）。另一条是 offers 里接受隶属请求的 `setParent`；
302	 * 除这两处外没有任何写 `organization.parent` 的语句（创建时一律写 null），tests/static.spec.ts 守。
303	 */
304	async function clearParent(d: Db, child: OrganizationId): Promise<void> {
305	  await d
306	    .updateTable('organization')
307	    .set({ parent: null })
308	    .where('organization_id', '=', child)
309	    .execute()
310	}

312	async function ancestorChain(
313	  deps: OperationContext,
314	  organizationInput: unknown,
315	): Promise<Outcome<readonly OrganizationId[], AncestorChainFailure>> {
316	  const parsed = parseOrganizationId(organizationInput)
317	  if (!isOk(parsed)) return fail('invalidInput')
318	  return deps.query(async tx => {
319	    const d = db(tx)
320	    if ((await readOrganization(d, parsed.ok)) === undefined) {
321	      return fail('organizationDoesNotExist')
322	    }
323	    const chain = ancestorChainOf(parsed.ok, await loadParentSnapshot(d, [parsed.ok]))
324	    if ('ok' in chain) return succeed(chain.ok)
325	    if (chain.failure === 'cycle') throw new ParentChainCycle(parsed.ok)
326	    return fail('unavailable')
327	  })
328	}

330	async function shareAncestor(
331	  deps: OperationContext,
332	  aInput: unknown,
333	  bInput: unknown,
334	): Promise<Outcome<boolean, AncestorChainFailure>> {
335	  const a = parseOrganizationId(aInput)
336	  const b = parseOrganizationId(bInput)
337	  if (!isOk(a) || !isOk(b)) return fail('invalidInput')
338	  return deps.query(async tx => {
339	    const d = db(tx)
340	    if (
341	      (await readOrganization(d, a.ok)) === undefined ||
342	      (await readOrganization(d, b.ok)) === undefined
343	    ) {
344	      return fail('organizationDoesNotExist')
345	    }
346	    // 含自身求交由 identity-values 的纯函数做，不从 ancestorChain 的返回值自己求交（S-34）
347	    const result = shareAncestorOf(a.ok, b.ok, await loadParentSnapshot(d, [a.ok, b.ok]))
348	    if ('ok' in result) return succeed(result.ok)
349	    if (result.failure === 'cycle') throw new ParentChainCycle(a.ok)
350	    return fail('unavailable')
351	  })
352	}

354	function scopeLayers(tenantInput: unknown): Outcome<ScopeLayers, ScopeLayersFailure> {
355	  const parsed = parseTenantId(tenantInput)
356	  if (!isOk(parsed)) return fail('invalidInput')
357	  const tenant: TenantId = parsed.ok
358	  return succeed({
359	    organization: { layer: 'organization', organization: tenant.organization },
360	    tenant: { layer: 'tenant', tenant },
361	  })
362	}

364	export function createOrganizationsService(deps: Deps): OrganizationsService {
365	  return {
366	    createPersonal: accountId => withOperation(deps, context => createPersonal(context, accountId)),
367	    createTeam: (creator, creationKey) =>
368	      withOperation(deps, context => createTeam(context, creator, creationKey)),
369	    read: organizationId => withOperation(deps, context => read(context, organizationId)),
370	    dissolveAffiliation: (initiator, child) =>
371	      withOperation(deps, context => dissolveAffiliation(context, initiator, child)),
372	    ancestorChain: organizationId =>
373	      withOperation(deps, context => ancestorChain(context, organizationId)),
374	    shareAncestor: (a, b) => withOperation(deps, context => shareAncestor(context, a, b)),
375	    scopeLayers,
376	    participate: unit => ({
377	      createTeam: (creator, creationKey) =>
378	        withParticipation(deps, unit, context => createTeam(context, creator, creationKey)),

381	      dissolveAffiliation: (initiator, child) =>

383	      ancestorChain: organizationId =>

385	      shareAncestor: (a, b) =>

387	      scopeLayers: tenant => withParticipation(deps, unit, async () => scopeLayers(tenant)),
388	    }),

390	}

1	import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
2	import { Agent, request } from 'node:https'
3	import { TLSSocket } from 'node:tls'
4	import type { IncomingMessage } from 'node:http'
5	import { captureConfiguration, type PublicHealthOptions } from './config.ts'
6	import type { HealthUnavailableReason } from './protocol.ts'
7	
8	type Response = {
9	  readonly kind: 'response'
10	  readonly body: Buffer
11	  readonly status: number | undefined
12	}
13	type Unavailable = { readonly kind: 'unavailable'; readonly reason: HealthUnavailableReason }
14	type WireResult = Response | Unavailable
15	export type TransportOutcome = WireResult & { readonly sendAttempted: boolean }
16	
17	const HEADER_LIMIT = 16 * 1024
18	const BODY_LIMIT = 64 * 1024
19	const TRUST_ERROR_CODES = new Set([
20	  'CERT_HAS_EXPIRED',
21	  'CERT_NOT_YET_VALID',
22	  'DEPTH_ZERO_SELF_SIGNED_CERT',
23	  'SELF_SIGNED_CERT_IN_CHAIN',
24	  'UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT',
25	  'UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY',
26	  'UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE',
27	  'ERR_TLS_CERT_ALTNAME_INVALID',
28	  'CERT_REVOKED',
29	  'CERT_SIGNATURE_FAILURE',
30	])
31	
32	/** D038/D045: one captured request, no retry, owned until actual close. */
33	export async function sendRequest(
34	  options: PublicHealthOptions,
35	  body: Buffer,
36	): Promise<TransportOutcome> {
37	  const config = captureConfiguration(options)
38	  const signal = config.signal
39	  if (signal?.aborted === true)
40	    return { kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'cancelled', sendAttempted: false }
41	
42	  return new Promise<TransportOutcome>((resolve, reject) => {
43	    const agent = new Agent({ keepAlive: false, maxCachedSessions: 0, proxyEnv: {} })
44	    let socket: TLSSocket | undefined
45	    let socketClosed = true
46	    let requestClosed = false
47	    let outcome: WireResult | undefined
48	    let sendAttempted = false
49	    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
50	    // ClientRequest.close 不等于 IncomingMessage.close；另等实际 socket.close。
51	    const maybeResolve = (): void => {
52	      if (outcome !== undefined && requestClosed && socketClosed)
53	        resolve({ ...outcome, sendAttempted })
54	    }
55	    const complete = (result: WireResult): void => {
56	      if (outcome !== undefined) return
57	      outcome = result
58	      clearTimeout(timer)
59	      signal?.removeEventListener('abort', cancel)
60	      req.destroy()
61	      socket?.destroy()
62	      agent.destroy()
63	      maybeResolve()
64	    }
65	    const cancel = (): void => complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'cancelled' })
66	    let req: ReturnType<typeof request>
67	    try {
68	      req = request(config.url, {
69	        agent,
70	        method: 'POST',
71	        minVersion: 'TLSv1.3',
72	        rejectUnauthorized: config.pin === undefined,
73	        ...(config.ca === undefined ? {} : { ca: config.ca }),
74	        maxHeaderSize: HEADER_LIMIT,
75	        headers: {
76	          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
77	          'Content-Length': body.length,
78	          Connection: 'close',
79	        },
80	      })
81	    } catch (error) {
82	      agent.destroy()
83	      reject(error)
84	      return
85	    }
86	    req.once('close', () => {
87	      requestClosed = true
88	      if (outcome === undefined) complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'connection' })
89	      maybeResolve()
90	    })
91	    req.on('error', (error: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
92	      complete({
93	        kind: 'unavailable',
94	        reason: TRUST_ERROR_CODES.has(error.code ?? '') ? 'trust' : 'connection',
95	      })
96	    })
97	    req.on('information', () => complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' }))
98	    req.on('upgrade', (_response, upgraded) => {
99	      upgraded.destroy()
100	      complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' })
101	    })
102	    req.once('socket', connected => {
103	      if (!(connected instanceof TLSSocket)) {
104	        connected.destroy()
105	        complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'connection' })
106	        return
107	      }
108	      socket = connected
109	      socketClosed = connected.closed
110	      connected.once('close', () => {
111	        socketClosed = true
112	        maybeResolve()
113	      })
114	      if (outcome !== undefined) {
115	        connected.destroy()
116	        return
117	      }
118	      connected.once('secureConnect', () => {
119	        if (outcome !== undefined) return
120	        if (config.pin !== undefined) {
121	          const certificate = connected.getPeerX509Certificate()
122	          const actual =
123	            certificate === undefined
124	              ? undefined
125	              : createHash('sha256')
126	                  .update(certificate.publicKey.export({ type: 'spki', format: 'der' }))
127	                  .digest('hex')
128	          if (actual !== config.pin) {
129	            complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'trust' })
130	            return
131	          }
132	        }
133	        // 唯一写入点：TLS及所选信任核实之后；没有 flushHeaders 或自动重发。
134	        sendAttempted = true
135	        try {
136	          req.end(body)
137	        } catch {
138	          complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'connection' })
139	        }
140	      })
141	    })
142	    req.once('response', response => collectResponse(response, complete))
143	    timer = setTimeout(() => complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'timeout' }), config.timeoutMs)
144	    signal?.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true })
145	    // 覆盖订阅前发生的取消；取消也可能发生在 socket 分配之前。
146	    if (signal?.aborted === true) cancel()
147	  })
148	}
149	
150	function collectResponse(response: IncomingMessage, complete: (value: WireResult) => void): void {
151	  response.on('error', () => complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' }))
152	  response.once('aborted', () => complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' }))
153	  const length = response.headers['content-length']
154	  if (
155	    response.httpVersion !== '1.1' ||
156	    typeof length !== 'string' ||
157	    !/^\d+$/.test(length) ||
158	    response.headers['transfer-encoding'] !== undefined
159	  ) {
160	    complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' })
161	    return
162	  }
163	  const expected = Number(length)
164	  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(expected) || expected > BODY_LIMIT) {
165	    complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-limit' })
166	    return
167	  }
168	  let size = 0
169	  const chunks: Buffer[] = []
170	  response.on('data', (chunk: Buffer) => {
171	    size += chunk.length
172	    if (size > BODY_LIMIT) complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-limit' })
173	    else chunks.push(chunk)
174	  })
175	  response.once('end', () => {
176	    if (!response.complete || size !== expected) {
177	      complete({ kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-framing' })
178	      return
179	    }
180	    complete({ kind: 'response', body: Buffer.concat(chunks), status: response.statusCode })
181	  })
182	}

2	export interface PublicHealthReply {
3	  readonly reachable: true
4	  readonly centerId: string
5	  readonly version: string
6	}
7	
8	export type EntryAnswer =
9	  'version-mismatch' | 'login-state-rejected' | 'invalid-input' | 'unavailable'
10	
11	export type HealthUnavailableReason =
12	  | 'connection'
13	  | 'trust'
14	  | 'timeout'
15	  | 'cancelled'
16	  | 'response-framing'
17	  | 'response-limit'
18	  | 'response-invalid'
19	
20	export type PublicHealthOutcome =
21	  | { readonly kind: 'health'; readonly reply: PublicHealthReply }
22	  | { readonly kind: 'entry-answer'; readonly answer: EntryAnswer }
23	  | { readonly kind: 'unavailable'; readonly reason: HealthUnavailableReason }
24	
25	export const PUBLIC_HEALTH_BODY = Buffer.from(
26	  '{"operation":"composition.governance-center-entry/v1#S-18"}',
27	)
28	const VERSION_MISMATCH = Buffer.from('"version-mismatch"')
29	
30	/** 仅在 HTTP/1.1 成帧完成且未超限之后调用。 */
31	export function decodeHealthReply(body: Buffer, status: number | undefined): PublicHealthOutcome {
32	  if (body.equals(VERSION_MISMATCH)) return { kind: 'entry-answer', answer: 'version-mismatch' }
33	  if (status !== 200) return { kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-invalid' }
34	  let value: unknown
35	  try {
36	    value = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(body))
37	  } catch {
38	    return { kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-invalid' }
39	  }
40	  if (value === 'login-state-rejected' || value === 'invalid-input' || value === 'unavailable')
41	    return { kind: 'entry-answer', answer: value }
42	  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value))
43	    return { kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-invalid' }
44	  if (
45	    Object.keys(value).length !== 3 ||
46	    !('reachable' in value) ||
47	    value.reachable !== true ||
48	    !('centerId' in value) ||
49	    typeof value.centerId !== 'string' ||
50	    !/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(value.centerId) ||
51	    !('version' in value) ||
52	    typeof value.version !== 'string' ||
53	    value.version.length === 0
54	  )
55	    return { kind: 'unavailable', reason: 'response-invalid' }
56	  return {
57	    kind: 'health',
58	    reply: { reachable: true, centerId: value.centerId, version: value.version },
59	  }
60	}

71	export async function readRow(tx: ReadTx): Promise<Reading> {

75	    .select(['name', 'type'])
76	    .where('name', 'not like', 'sqlite_%')

79	    objects.length !== 1 ||
80	    objects[0]?.name !== 'client_local_state' ||
81	    objects[0].type !== 'table'

85	  const rows = await db.selectFrom('client_local_state').selectAll().execute()
86	  if (rows.length !== 1) return { kind: 'failed', reason: 'invalid-record' }
87	  const row = rows[0]!
88	  if (Number.isSafeInteger(row.format_version) && row.format_version > 1)
89	    return { kind: 'failed', reason: 'unsupported-format' }
90	  const keys = ['singleton', 'format_version', 'store_id', 'revision', 'operation_id', 'value_json']
91	  if (
92	    Object.keys(row).length !== keys.length ||
93	    !keys.every(k => Object.hasOwn(row, k)) ||
94	    row.singleton !== 1 ||
95	    row.format_version !== 1 ||
96	    typeof row.store_id !== 'string' ||

98	    !Number.isSafeInteger(row.revision) ||

101	      ? row.operation_id !== null
102	      : typeof row.operation_id !== 'string' || row.operation_id.length === 0) ||

123	/** Internal constructor for storage/fdatasync fault tests; not a package export. */
124	export class LocalState implements ClientLocalState {

128	  #closing: Promise<void> | undefined

130	    readonly storage: StateStorage,
131	    private readonly syncDirectory: () => Promise<void>,
132	    private readonly closeDirectory: () => Promise<void>,
133	  ) {}
134	
135	  #admit<T>(work: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
136	    if (this.#closed) return Promise.reject(new ClientStateUsageDefect('closed'))
137	    const job = work()
138	    this.#jobs.add(job)
139	    void job.then(
140	      () => this.#jobs.delete(job),
141	      () => this.#jobs.delete(job),
142	    )
143	    return job
144	  }
145	
146	  #snapshot(reading: Extract<Reading, { kind: 'row' }>): LocalSnapshot {
147	    const token = Object.freeze(Object.create(null)) as SnapshotToken
148	    const snapshot: LocalSnapshot = Object.freeze({
149	      storeId: reading.row.store_id,
150	      revision: reading.row.revision,
151	      operationId: reading.row.operation_id,
152	      value: reading.value,
153	      token,
154	    })
155	    this.#proofs.set(token, snapshot)
156	    return snapshot
157	  }

159	  read(): Promise<ReadOutcome> {
160	    return this.#admit(async () => {
161	      try {
162	        const read = await this.storage.read(readRow)
163	        return read.kind === 'failed'
164	          ? { kind: 'failed', reason: read.reason }
165	          : { kind: 'read', snapshot: this.#snapshot(read) }
166	      } catch (error) {
167	        if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable) return { kind: 'failed', reason: 'unavailable' }
168	        throw error
169	      }
170	    })
171	  }

173	  compareAndReplace(
174	    token: SnapshotToken,
175	    value: unknown,
176	    operationId: string,
177	  ): Promise<ReplaceOutcome> {

179	      const original = this.#proofs.get(token)
180	      if (original === undefined) throw new ClientStateUsageDefect('invalid-snapshot')

182	      if (

192	          unit.mutate(async tx => {
193	            const current = await readRow(tx)
194	            if (current.kind === 'failed') return { kind: 'not-installed', reason: current.reason }
195	            const snapshot = this.#snapshot(current)
196	            if (
197	              snapshot.storeId !== original.storeId ||
198	              snapshot.revision !== original.revision ||
199	              snapshot.value?.center.centerId !== original.value?.center.centerId ||
200	              !sameLogin(snapshot.value, original.value)
201	            )
202	              return { kind: 'conflict', current: snapshot }
203	            if (
204	              !validTransition(snapshot.value, input.value) ||
205	              snapshot.operationId === operationId
206	            )
207	              return { kind: 'not-installed', reason: 'invalid-input' }
208	            if (snapshot.revision === Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)
209	              return { kind: 'not-installed', reason: 'unavailable' }
210	            const next: Row = {
211	              ...current.row,
212	              revision: snapshot.revision + 1,
213	              operation_id: operationId,
214	              value_json: input.json,
215	            }
216	            await narrow<Database>(tx)
217	              .updateTable('client_local_state')
218	              .set(next)
219	              .where('singleton', '=', 1)
220	              .execute()
221	            return {
222	              kind: 'installed',
223	              snapshot: this.#snapshot({ kind: 'row', row: next, value: input.value }),
224	            }
225	          }),
226	        )
227	        if (outcome.kind === 'installed') await this.syncDirectory()
228	        return outcome
229	      } catch (error) {
230	        if (error instanceof StorageUnavailable || unavailableIo(error))
231	          return { kind: 'unconfirmed' }
232	        throw error
233	      }
234	    })
235	  }
236	
237	  close(): Promise<void> {
238	    if (this.#closing !== undefined) return this.#closing
239	    this.#closed = true
240	    this.#closing = (async () => {
241	      await Promise.allSettled([...this.#jobs])
242	      try {
243	        await this.storage.close()
244	      } finally {
245	        await this.closeDirectory()
246	      }
247	    })()
248	    return this.#closing
249	  }
250	}

135	export function sameLogin(a: LocalRecord | null, b: LocalRecord | null): boolean {

146	export function freeze<T>(value: T): T {

150	  }

154	export const MAX_RECORD_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024
155	export function capture(

157	):
158	  | { kind: 'value'; value: LocalRecord | null; json: string }

160	  | { kind: 'limit' } {

40	/** Internal constructor for deterministic faults; public construction fixes transport. */
41	export class Client implements GovernanceClientOperations {
42	  #runtime: Runtime | undefined
43	  readonly #uses = new Set<Use>()
44	  readonly #inputs = new Set<Prepared>()
45	  readonly #jobs = new Set<Promise<unknown>>()
46	  #opening = 0
47	  #entering = 0
48	  #closed = false
49	  #closing: Promise<void> | undefined
50	  constructor(runtime: Runtime) {
51	    this.#runtime = runtime
52	  }
53	
54	  #track<T>(job: Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
55	    this.#jobs.add(job)
56	    job.then(
57	      () => this.#jobs.delete(job),
58	      () => this.#jobs.delete(job),
59	    )
60	    return job
61	  }
62	  openUse(): Promise<OpenUseOutcome> {
63	    if (this.#closed) return Promise.reject(new ClientUseUsageDefect('closed'))
64	    if (this.#entering !== 0) return Promise.resolve({ kind: 'blocked', reason: 'busy' })
65	    this.#opening++
66	    return this.#track(
67	      this.#open().finally(() => {
68	        this.#opening--
69	      }),
70	    )
71	  }
72	  async #open(): Promise<OpenUseOutcome> {
73	    const runtime = this.#runtime
74	    if (runtime === undefined) throw new ClientUseUsageDefect('closed')
75	    const frame = reportFrame(undefined)
76	    const snapshot = await readLocal(runtime, frame)
77	    if (snapshot === undefined)
78	      return {
79	        kind: 'blocked',
80	        reason: frame.defect === undefined ? frame.admission.reason! : 'defect',
81	      }
82	    // close may have run while CLS was reading. Never hand out an untracked use.
83	    if (this.#closed) return { kind: 'blocked', reason: 'reenter-required' }
84	    if (snapshot.value === null) return { kind: 'blocked', reason: 'not-configured' }
85	    if (snapshot.value.login === undefined) return { kind: 'blocked', reason: 'not-logged-in' }
86	    const use = new Use(runtime, snapshot, () => this.#uses.delete(use))
87	    this.#uses.add(use)
88	    return freeze({ kind: 'use', use, origin: origin(snapshot.value) })
89	  }
90	  runAction(input: unknown): Promise<ActionReport> {
91	    return this.#run(input)
92	  }
93	  runPrepared(input: unknown, prompt: InputPrompt): Promise<ActionReport> {
94	    if (this.#closed) return Promise.reject(new ClientUseUsageDefect('closed'))
95	    const prepared = Prepared.capture(input, prompt)
96	    if (prepared === undefined) {
97	      const frame = reportFrame(undefined)
98	      block(frame, 'invalid-input')
99	      return Promise.resolve(finish(frame))
100	    }
101	    this.#inputs.add(prepared)
102	    return this.#run(prepared.intent, prepared).finally(() => {
103	      prepared.release()
104	      this.#inputs.delete(prepared)
105	    })
106	  }
107	  #run(input: unknown, prepared?: Prepared): Promise<ActionReport> {
108	    if (this.#closed) return Promise.reject(new ClientUseUsageDefect('closed'))
109	    // Capture synchronously; callers cannot change payloads after admission.
110	    const action = prepared?.intent ?? captureAction(input)
111	    const frame = reportFrame(action)
112	    if (action === undefined) {
113	      block(frame, 'invalid-input')
114	      return Promise.resolve(finish(frame))
115	    }
116	    if (action.action === 'invoke' || action.action === 'logout') {
117	      return this.#track(
118	        (async () => {
119	          const opened = await this.openUse()
120	          if (opened.kind === 'blocked') {
121	            block(frame, opened.reason)
122	            return finish(frame)
123	          }
124	          try {
125	            const result = await (prepared === undefined
126	              ? opened.use.run(action)
127	              : (opened.use as Use).runCaptured(prepared))
128	            return freeze({ ...result, use: result.use === 'active' ? 'ended' : result.use })
129	          } finally {
130	            await opened.use.close()
131	          }
132	        })(),
133	      )
134	    }
135	    if (action.action !== 'health' && (this.#uses.size !== 0 || this.#opening !== 0)) {
136	      block(frame, 'busy')
137	      return Promise.resolve(finish(frame))
138	    }
139	    // Reserve the entering phase before the first await, so openUse cannot race it.
140	    if (action.action !== 'health') this.#entering++
141	    return this.#track(
142	      preUseAction(this.#runtime!, action, frame, prepared)
143	        .then(() => finish(frame))
144	        .finally(() => {
145	          if (action.action !== 'health') this.#entering--
146	        }),
147	    )
148	  }
149	  close(): Promise<void> {
150	    if (this.#closing !== undefined) return this.#closing
151	    this.#closed = true
152	    for (const input of this.#inputs) input.cancel()
153	    // Stop all use admission now; waiting on root jobs alone leaves TUI handles open.
154	    const closingUses = [...this.#uses].map(use => use.close())
155	    this.#closing = Promise.allSettled([...closingUses, ...this.#jobs]).then(() => {
156	      this.#uses.clear()
157	      this.#runtime = undefined
158	    })
159	    return this.#closing
160	  }
161	}

66	      }
67	      frame.remote = {
68	        status: 'success',

90	export async function preUseAction(

93	    | Exclude<ActionIntent, { action: 'invoke' } | { action: 'health' | 'logout' }>

102	  frame.origin = {
103	    centerId: record?.center.centerId ?? null,
104	    accountId: null,
105	    loginStateHandle: null,
106	  }
107	  if (
108	    prepared !== undefined &&
109	    (action.action === 'configure' || (action.action === 'health' && record !== null))

111	    if (

119	  }

126	      runtime.state,
127	      before,
128	      {
129	        ...record,
130	        center: { centerId, endpoint: action.endpoint, trust: action.trust },
131	        cache: record?.cache ?? [],
132	      },
133	      frame,
134	    )

136	  }
137	  if (record === null) {
138	    block(frame, 'not-configured')

140	  }
141	  if (prepared !== undefined && !prepared.continueAllowed(frame)) return

159	    })

161	  } catch {
162	    defect(frame, 'operation')

164	  }
165	  if (result.kind !== 'reply' || !('result' in result.reply)) return

168	    const login = result.reply.result

170	      !object(login) ||

172	      typeof login['loginStateHandle'] !== 'string'
173	    ) {
174	      defect(frame, 'operation')
175	      return
176	    }
177	    await settle(
178	      runtime.state,
179	      before,
180	      {
181	        center: record.center,
182	        login: { presentation: login['loginState'], handle: login['loginStateHandle'] },
183	        cache: [],
184	      },
185	      frame,
186	    )
187	  }
188	}

420	      status = 70
421	    }
422	  }

42	  constructor(runtime: Runtime, snapshot: LocalSnapshot, onClose: () => void) {

68	  /** Root and use share this captured interaction, including its cancellation signal. */

72	  #run(input: unknown, prepared?: Prepared): Promise<ActionReport> {

110	      },

174	    }

329	          data: frame.remote.reply!,

331	        }
332	        if (isRead) {
333	          const copy = this.#readCopy(operation, payload, target.reply.result, frame)
334	          if (copy !== undefined) {
335	            additions.push(copy)

337	              ...frame.view,
338	              acquiredAt: copy.acquiredAt,
339	              ...(copy.tenant === undefined ? {} : { tenant: copy.tenant }),
340	            }
341	          }
342	        }

351	      if (copy !== undefined) this.#copyView(frame, copy)
352	    }
353	    await this.#save(before, record, additions, clear, frame)
354	  }
355	
356	  async #save(
357	    before: LocalSnapshot,
358	    record: SelectedRecord,
359	    additions: readonly CachedRead[],
360	    clear: boolean,
361	    frame: ReportFrame,
362	  ): Promise<void> {
363	    // Failure to represent the observation time prevents this combined replacement.
364	    // The in-use invalidation knowledge and already known remote fact still stand.
365	    if (frame.local.status === 'not-installed' && !clear) return
366	    const value: LocalRecord = clear
367	      ? { center: record.center, cache: [] }
368	      : this.#knowledge.prepare(
369	          {
370	            ...record,
371	            login: {
372	              ...record.login,
373	              ...(this.#account === undefined ? {} : { accountId: this.#account }),
374	            },
375	          },
376	          additions,
377	        )
378	    if (canonical(value) === canonical(record)) return
379	    const current = await settle(this.#environment.state, before, value, frame)
380	    if (frame.local.status === 'installed') this.#knowledge.installed(additions)
381	    if (current !== undefined && !this.#sameSelection(current)) this.#reenter = true
382	  }
383	}

9	    typeof value['organization'] === 'string' &&
10	    typeof value['account'] === 'string'
11	    ? { organization: value['organization'], account: value['account'] }
12	    : undefined
13	}
14	export function cacheContext(
15	  operation: string,
16	  payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
17	  account: string,
18	): Tenant | undefined {
19	  const expected = tenant(payload['expectedTenant'])
20	  if (expected !== undefined) return expected
21	  if (operation === og(22) && typeof payload['organization'] === 'string')
22	    return { organization: payload['organization'], account }
23	  if (operation === og(26) || operation === og(35)) {
24	    const queried = tenant(payload['tenant'])
25	    if (queried !== undefined) return { organization: queried.organization, account }
26	  }
27	  return undefined
28	}
29	function key(
30	  copy: Pick<CachedRead, 'centerId' | 'accountId' | 'tenant' | 'operation' | 'payload'>,
31	): string {
32	  return canonical([
33	    copy.centerId,
34	    copy.accountId,
35	    copy.tenant ?? null,
36	    copy.operation,
37	    copy.payload,
38	  ])
39	}
40	function dependencies(copy: CachedRead): readonly string[] {
41	  if (copy.tenant !== undefined) return [copy.tenant.organization]
42	  const context = cacheContext(copy.operation, copy.payload, copy.accountId)
43	  if (context !== undefined) return [context.organization]
44	  if (copy.operation === og(34) && Array.isArray(copy.payload['organizations']))
45	    return copy.payload['organizations'].filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string')
46	  return []
47	}
48	function administratorRead(copy: CachedRead): boolean {
49	  return (
50	    (copy.operation === og(55) && copy.payload['callerIdentityKind'] === 'tenant') ||
51	    [og(56), og(58), og(60)].includes(copy.operation) ||
52	    (copy.operation === og(59) && copy.payload['includeIneffective'] === true)
53	  )
54	}

56	/** Per-use knowledge; never a server authorization gate. */
57	export class CacheKnowledge {
58	  readonly #rules = new Map<string, Rule>()
59	  readonly #installedExceptions = new Map<string, string>()
60	
61	  #invalidate(id: string, rule: Rule, current: readonly CachedRead[]): void {
62	    this.#rules.set(id, rule)
63	    for (const copy of current) if (rule(copy)) this.#installedExceptions.delete(key(copy))
64	    // Exceptions may have disappeared from disk through another process's CAS.
65	    // Retaining them would allow a later stale write to reintroduce the exception.
66	    for (const [k, encoded] of this.#installedExceptions) {
67	      const copy: CachedRead = JSON.parse(encoded)
68	      if (rule(copy)) this.#installedExceptions.delete(k)
69	    }
70	  }
71	
72	  applicable(copy: CachedRead): boolean {
73	    return (
74	      ![...this.#rules.values()].some(rule => rule(copy)) ||
75	      this.#installedExceptions.get(key(copy)) === canonical(copy)
76	    )
77	  }
78	
79	  find(
80	    record: LocalRecord,
81	    operation: string,
82	    payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
83	    account: string,
84	  ): CachedRead | undefined {
85	    const context = cacheContext(operation, payload, account)
86	    if (context !== undefined && context.account !== account) return undefined
87	    const query = {
88	      centerId: record.center.centerId,
89	      accountId: account,
90	      operation,
91	      payload,
92	      ...(context === undefined ? {} : { tenant: context }),
93	    }
94	    return record.cache.find(copy => key(copy) === key(query) && this.applicable(copy))
95	  }
96	
97	  /** Apply authoritative observations even when a timestamp or persistence later fails. */
98	  observe(
99	    record: LocalRecord,
100	    operation: string,
101	    payload: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,
102	    reply: { readonly result: unknown } | { readonly failure: string },
103	    account: string,
104	  ): void {
105	    const group = (operations: readonly string[]) =>
106	      this.#invalidate(
107	        canonical(['group', operations]),
108	        c => operations.includes(c.operation),
109	        record.cache,
110	      )
111	    const organization = (id: string, onlyAdministrator = false) =>
112	      this.#invalidate(
113	        canonical(['organization', id, onlyAdministrator]),
114	        c => dependencies(c).includes(id) && (!onlyAdministrator || administratorRead(c)),
115	        record.cache,
116	      )
117	    if ('failure' in reply) {
118	      // Write payloads cannot name a cached reading and may carry credentials.
119	      // Never retain them as query rules beyond their action's lifetime.
120	      if (READ_OPERATIONS.has(operation)) {
121	        const query = canonical(payload)
122	        this.#invalidate(
123	          canonical(['query', operation, query]),
124	          c => c.operation === operation && canonical(c.payload) === query,
125	          record.cache,
126	        )
127	      }
128	      if (reply.failure === 'expectedTenantMismatch') group([og(36)])
129	      if (reply.failure === 'membershipNotEffective') {
130	        const target = tenant(payload['targetTenant'])
131	        if (target?.account === account) organization(target.organization)
132	      }
133	      if (reply.failure === 'notAuthorized') {
134	        const context = cacheContext(operation, payload, account)
135	        if (context !== undefined) organization(context.organization)
136	        else if (operation === og(34) && Array.isArray(payload['organizations'])) {
137	          for (const id of payload['organizations']) if (typeof id === 'string') organization(id)
138	        }
139	      }
140	      return
141	    }
142	    if (operation === og(26)) {
143	      const queried = tenant(payload['tenant'])
144	      if (
145	        queried?.account === account &&
146	        object(reply.result) &&
147	        reply.result['standing'] === 'effective' &&
148	        reply.result['role'] === 'member'
149	      )
150	        organization(queried.organization, true)
151	    }
152	    if (READ_OPERATIONS.has(operation)) return
153	    if (operation === og(21)) group([og(27)])
154	    if ([og(23), og(24), og(25), og(61), ENTRY50].includes(operation))
155	      group([og(55), og(57), og(58)])
156	    if ([og(25), og(28), og(29)].includes(operation)) group([og(26), og(27), og(59)])
157	    if (operation === og(28) || operation === og(29)) {
158	      const target = tenant(payload['targetTenant'])
159	      if (target?.account === account)
160	        organization(target.organization, operation === og(28) && payload['role'] === 'member')
161	    }
162	    if ([og(30), og(31), og(32), og(33), og(62)].includes(operation))
163	      group([og(34), og(56), og(58), og(60)])
164	    if (operation === og(32) || operation === og(33)) group([og(22)])
165	    if (operation === og(37)) group([og(36)])
166	    if (operation === AI16) group([AI37])
167	  }
168	
169	  prepare(record: LocalRecord, additions: readonly CachedRead[]): LocalRecord {
170	    const replacementKeys = new Set(additions.map(key))
171	    return {
172	      ...record,
173	      cache: [
174	        ...record.cache.filter(c => this.applicable(c) && !replacementKeys.has(key(c))),
175	        ...additions,
176	      ],
177	    }
178	  }
179	  installed(additions: readonly CachedRead[]): void {
180	    for (const copy of additions) this.#installedExceptions.set(key(copy), canonical(copy))
181	  }
182	  clear(): void {
183	    this.#rules.clear()
184	    this.#installedExceptions.clear()
185	  }
186	}
